Wazibeka iinkunzi zeenkomo kwiziqingatha zesibingelelo, ecaleni kwesibingelelo, ukuze ziyithwale. Yayenza isibingelelo ibe yenziwe ngeebhodi, ingamanzi.
Wayenza ibhotile yokuhlambela yentsimbi, nesiseko sayo sentsimbi, ngeembono zentsimbi zabafazi abasebenza ekungeneni kwetenki yokuhlangana.
Wayenza ke indlu yangasemva; ubude becala lasempumalanga buyimitha ezimashumi mane anesihlanu, ngeethayile zelinen ethambileyo ethe tyaba.
Iindonga zayo zazimashumi mabini, neziseko zazo zaba zilishumi elinambini zentsimbi; iziqhoboshi zawo zasesilivere, nezigqubuthelo zaloo zinto.
Icala lasempuma, ubude bayo buyimitha ezimashumi mane anesihlanu; amakhonkco awo amashumi mabini, neziseko zawo zentsimbi zilishumi elinambini; namakhonkco esilivere, neengxowa-mali zazo ezikhonkco.
Kwisiphelo sasentshonalanga ububanzi bawo beyimitha ezimashumi mabini anesixhenxe, nezitayile zazo zilishumi, neziseko zazo zilishumi; iziqhoboshi zesilivere, namakhonkco eethayile.
Isiphelo sasentshonalanga, esiya kutshona kwelanga, saba yimitha ezimashumi mabini anambini ububanzi.
Kwicala elinye lomngxunya kwakukho izityalo eziphakamileyo, ezimalunga neemitha ezisixhenxe ubude, ezinemiqadi emithathu neziseko ezintathu.
Elinye icala lomngxunya wendlu yangasemva, kwakukho namatye amabini amashumi asixhenxe anesibhozo ubude, namakhonkco amathathu, neziseko ezintathu.
Zonke iintyatyambo zendlu yangasemva, ezijikelezayo, zaziyenziwe ngelinen ethambileyo ethe tyaba.
Iziseko zemiqadi zaba yintsimbi; amakhonkco, nezibophelelo zemiqadi zaba yisilivere; iziqhobosheli zazo zaba zigqityiwe ngesilivere; zonke iimiqadi zendlu yangasemva zazizibophelelo zesilivere.

Umgquba wesango lokungena kwindlu yangasemva, waba yenziwe ngezinto ezibomvu, nezingwevu, nezingwevu, nelinen ethambileyo ethe tyaba, ibe ngumsebenzi womzobi; ubude bayo buyimitha ezisixhenxe, ubude bayo buyimitha ezisibhozo, befana neetafile zendlu yangasemva.
Iindonga zayo zazinesine, neziseko zazo zizine zentsimbi; iziqhoboshi zazo nezigqubuthelo zazo zaba yisilivere; iintonga zawo zaba zigqityiwe ngesilivere.
Zonke izibonda zetentile yendawo engcwele, neyendlu yangasemva ijikelezayo, zazintsimbi.
Ezi zizinto eziliqela zazo zonke izinto ezisetyenziswayo endlwini engcwele, itabernakele yomnqophiso; babhalwa ngokomthetho kaMoses ngabaLevi, phantsi kolawulo luka-Ithamari unyana kaAron, ukumkani.
UBesaleyeli, unyana kaUri, unyana kaHure, wesizwe sikaYuda, wenza zonke izinto awiselayo iNkosi kuMoses.

Waye naye uAhaliyabhi, unyana ka-Ahisamakhi, wesizwe sikaDan; waba ngumzobi, waba ngumyili wezinto ezilula, wathunga izimbo ezintle ngentsimbi eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nentsimbi engwevu, nentsimbi emthubi, nelinen.
Igolide yonke enikiweyo, eyasetyenziswa ekwenzeni umsebenzi wendawo engcwele, yayilinganiselwa ngamashumi amabini anesihlanu eetoni ngobunzima bendawo engcwele.
Ke kaloku, isilivere abathe banikela ngayo abo babalwayo ebantwini, yaba ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu asixhenxe eetoni, ngokwesiqingatha selitha yendawo engcwele.

Ibeka enye, ishekeli ephindwe kabini, kulowo mntu ngamnye, ngokwesiqingatha seshekeli yendawo engcwele; ngaye wonke lowo wabalwa, oneminyaka engama-mashumi mabini ubudala nangaphezulu, waba ngamawaka amakhulu amathandathu, anamawaka amathathu, anamakhulu amahlanu, anamanci mahlanu.
Iitoni ezilishumi elinambini zesilivere zasetyenziswa ukubumba iziseko zendawo engcwele, neziseko zesikhuselo; ziitoni ezimakhulu amabini, itoni nganye ibe ziitoni ezimashumi mathathu anesine.
Iikhilogram ezilishumi elinambini zesilivere, eziseleyo, wazenza izikhonkwane zemiqadi, ukuze zigubungele iintonga zemiqadi, waza wazenza izibonda zazo.
Ubunzima bobhedu olunikezelwe njengomnikelo, bekuba ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu asixhenxe eetoni.
Wazenza ngazo iziseko zokungena kwetenki yokuhlangana, nesibingelelo sentsimbi, nomgquba wayo wentsimbi, nezixhobo zayo zonke;
iziseko zendlu yangasemva ejikelezayo, neziseko zokungena kuloo ndawo; nazo zonke izibonda zetentile yendlu engcwele, nendlu yangasemva ejikelezayo.

Bayenza iimpahla ezithe tyaba, zokukhonza endlwini engcwele, ngezinto eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nezibomvu, nezingwevu; bazenza neingubo ezingcwele zikaAron, njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Wayenza i-ephod uBhesaleyeli ngegolide, nentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nemibala engwevu, neyesilivere, nelinen enomsonto.
Bayitshisa igolide ibe ziibhodi ezincinci, bayenza ibe yimisonto, ukuze bayifake kwizinto eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nezingwevu, nezibomvu, nelinen ethambileyo, njengemisebenzi yomsebenzi owaziyo.
Zazenza iziqhoboshi zesifuba se-ephod, zidityaniswe neekona zayo zombini, ukuze iqhagamshelwe ngazo.

Umsesane wayo, owenziwe ngobugcisa obufana nalo, waba nganye nayo; wayenziwe ngegolide, nentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nemibala emibomvu, nengwevu, nelinen esongiweyo; njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Zazibeka iithayile ze-onyx, zazingcaphukisa ngegolide, zazigquma phezu kwazo amagama oonyana bakaSirayeli, njengokungquma komenzi wezinto ezigqityiweyo.
Zazibophelela kumatye emilenze ye-ephod, zibe ngamatye okukhumbula oonyana bakaSirayeli; njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo umthetho uMoses.
Yayenza intloko, yenziwe ngomsebenzi wobugcisa, njenge-ephod, ngegolide, nentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nemibala emibomvu, nengwevu, nelinen esonakalisiweyo.
Yayimilenze emibini, iphindwe kabini, ibe ngamasentimitha amabini anamashumi amathathu ubude, namasentimitha amabini anamakhulu amathathu ububanzi.
Zazibeka phezu kwayo imigca emine yamatye abalulekileyo; kumgca wokuqala kwakukho i-ruby, ne-topaz, ne-beryl.
Kumgca wesibini kwakukho i-turquoise, ne-sapphire, ne-emerald.
Umgca wesithathu ube yi-hyacinth, ne-agate, ne-amethyst.
Kumgca wesixhenxe kwakukho i-chrysolite, ne-onyx, ne-jasper; zabekwa kwiingxowa zegolide.
Iithayile zazilishumi elinambini, ngamagama oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngamnye ngalinye; iithayile nganye yaluka njengesitshixo, ngegama layo, ngokwezizwe ezilishumi elinambini.
Zazenza iinkunzi zeenkomo zegolide ecacileyo, zithe nkqo njengentambo.
Zazilungisa iziqhoboshi zegolide ezimbini, neziqingatha ezibini zegolide; zazibeka ezo ziqingatha kwiikona zombini eziphezulu zesifuba.
Zazibophelela iinkunzi zeenkomo ezibini zegolide kwiziqhoboshi ezimbini, ezingentla kwesifuba.
Ezinye iziphelo zezibonda zabazidibanisa ezi ziqhobosheni ezimbini, bazibeke emazantsi emilenze ye-ephod, ngasemva.
Zazenza iziqhoboshi ezimbini zegolide, zazibeka kwiikona zombini zesifuba, ecaleni le-ephod ngasemva, ngaphakathi.
Zazenza iziqingatha ezibini zegolide, zazibeka phantsi kweziqhoboshi zesifuba esingaphambili se-ephod, ecaleni kokuqhekeka kwayo, ngasentla komgca wayo.

Zazibophelela izikhonkwane zesifuba kwisikhonkwane se-ephod ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ukuze isikhonkwane sobuso sihlale phezulu komgca othambileyo, singangeni kwi-ephod; njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo umthetho uMoses.
Yayenza intyatyambo ye-ephod, yotywe yonke ingwevu.
Kwabakho umngxunya phakathi kwebhanti, njengomgquba; kwabekho nomngxunya ojikeleze umngxunya, ukuze ungabi nokunyathela.
Bazenza iziqhamo zegranate, zijikeleze umngxunya webhatyi, ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nengwevu emnyama, nengwevu emhlophe, nelinen esongiweyo.
Zazenza iinkunzi zegolide ecacileyo, zazibeka phakathi kweegranate, zijikeleze umngxunya webhanti.
Intsimbi, negranate, intsimbi, negranate, zazijikeleza yonke intsontelo yomqamelo, ukuze ugqoke xa esebenza njengombingeleli; njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Bazenza uAron nabantwana bakhe izihlangu ezithe tyaba zelinen,
nesigqubuthelo sobuso selinen ethambileyo, neziqhoboshi zelinen ethambileyo, nezihlangu zelinen ethambileyo ethe tyaba.
Wayenza imingxunya yentsimbi engenasici esongiweyo, nentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nemibala egqamile, nengwevu, yenziwe ngumzobi owenza izimbo, njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Zazilungisa isiqwenga, isithsaba esingcwele, segolide ecocekileyo; zazipheka phezu kwayo, njengesitshixo, zithi, Ingcwele kuYehova.
Zazibophelela intambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ukuze ziyibeke phezu kwemiqamelo, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo uMoses.
Yagqitywa ke yonke imisebenzi yetentile engcwele, itente yokuhlangana; oonyana bakaSirayeli bayenza yonke into, njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Bathi ke bazisa kuMoses itente engcwele, itenti nezixhobo zayo zonke, nezikhonkwane zayo, neetafile zayo, nemiqadi yayo, namatye ayo, neziseko zazo;
isakhelo sesikhumba somntu omnyama esibomvu, nesakhelo sesikhumba esinombala oqaqambileyo, nesitayile sokugcina isithuthi;
itekisi yomnqophiso, nemibhobho yayo, nesikhuselo sayo;
itafile nezixhobo zayo zonke, nesonka esikhethekileyo;
isiseko selanga segolide ecacileyo, nomgca wayo welanga, neempahla zayo zonke, neoli yokukhanya;
isibingelelo segolide, neoli yokupheka, nefuthe elinomphunga omnandi, nesikhuselo somngxunya wesingeniso setente;
isibingelelo sentsimbi, negridi yayo yentsimbi, neentonga zayo, nezithuthi zayo zonke; ibhotile yokuhlambela nesiseko sayo;

iithayile zendlu yangasemva, nezingcango zazo, neziseko zazo, nomgquba wokungena endlwini yangasemva, neentambo zayo, neentonga zayo, nazo zonke izinto ezisetyenziswayo kumsebenzi wendawo engcwele, yetente yokudibana;
iimpahla ezithe tyaba zokukhonza endlwini engcwele, iingubo ezingcwele zika-Aron umbingeleli, neingubo zabantwana bakhe, ukuba basebenze njengombingeleli.
Bathi oonyana bakaSirayeli bawenza umsebenzi wonke, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo uMoses.

Ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yokuqala, ubeke phezulu itentile engcwele, itente yokuhlangana.

Balala oonyana bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Xa kukho umntu kuni oza kunika umnikelo kuYehova, mnikele into ephilayo evela kwiinkomo zenu, naseipateni zenu.
Ukuba isonka sakhe sisonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, senyama yenkomo, kufuneka sibe ndoda, ingabikho kuyo intlungu; uya kuyizisa emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana, ukuze iNkosi ayifumane.

Izinto ezingaphakathi, nemilenze yayo, uya kuzihlamba ngamanzi; umbingeleli uya kuzitshisa zonke phezu kwesibingelelo. Yidini eliqhutywa limlilo, ngumnikelo owenziwe ngomlilo, wevumba elimnandi kuYehova.

Yayikhupha ibe ziinxalenye zayo, nayo intloko yayo, nenyama yayo; umbingeleli uya kuzibeka ngokulinganayo phezu komlilo wemithi esembindini wesibingelelo.

Okuseleyo komnikelo wokudla kuya kuba ngu-Aron nonyana bakhe; kungcwele kakhulu phakathi kweempawu zomlilo zikaYehova.

Uya kuyikhupha ibe ziinxalenye, uze uthele ioli phezu kwayo; ngumnikelo wokudla.

Ke kaloku, ukuba akakwazi ukuhlawula inkunzi yebhokhwe, uya kuzisa kuYehova iintaka ezibini, okanye iintlanzi ezimbini ezincinane, ngenxa yesono sakhe asenzayo; enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, nenye ibe ngumnikelo womlilo.
Uya kuzizisa kumbingeleli, umbingeleli aqale alungiselele iintaka zomnikelo wesono; azigqume umqolo wayo, kodwa angayikhuphi intloko.
Uya kutywina igazi lesonka sesono phezu kwecala lesibingelelo; igazi eliseleyo liza kukhutshwa phantsi kwesibingelelo: ngumnikelo wesono loo.
Yaye intaka yesibini ayilungiselele ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, ngokwendlela eyamelwe ngayo; ngoko ke umbingeleli uya kumlungisa kuye phambi koYehova ngenxa yesono sakhe asenzayo, aze amxolele.

Ke kaloku, ukuba akakwazi ukunikela ngeentyatyambo ezibini, okanye ngeentyatyambo ezincinane ezimbini, athabathe umgubo omsulwa ongenamakhulu amahlanu eekhilogram, abe ngumnikelo wesono; asibekenga phezu kwayo ioli, asibekenga phezu kwayo uvumba, ngokuba yidini lesono.

Uya kuzizisa kumbingeleli; umbingeleli athabathe kuyo isandla sakhe esigcweleyo, ibe yinxalenye emiselweyo, aze ayitshise phezu kwesibingelelo, ngaphezu kweempawu eziqhutywa ngamandla zikaYehova: lidini lesono.

Ke kaloku umbingeleli uya kumlungisa phambi koYehova, ngenxa yezo zinto zonke azinikele kuzo, aze amxolele; nenani eliseleyo lomgubo luya kuba lilungu lombingeleli, njengokuba kunjalo nomnikelo wokudla.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

Ke kaloku, xa umntu esenza inkohlakalo, aphelelwe lithemba ngezinto ezingcwele zikaYehova; yena uya kuzisa umnikelo wesono kuThixo: umnquba omncinci osuka kumabhokhwe angabikho monakalo kuwo; ixabiso lakhe liya kuba yintyatyambo yesilivere.

Ke yena abuyisele isono sakhe kwizinto ezingcwele,phambi kokuba abeke kuyo enye yesihlanu sazo, aze ayinike kumbingeleli; umbingeleli ke uya kumlungisa phambi koNdikhoyo ngomthi womnquba womnikelo wesono, aze amxolele.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu esenza isono, esenza nantoni na engomyalelo kaYehova okufunekanga yenziwe, nokuba awaziyo loo nto, uya kuba netyala, athabathe umonakalo wayo.

Uya kumthwala kumbingeleli umnquba omtsha, ongabikho monakalo kuwo, esuka kwinkomo, ngokwexabiso lakho, ibe ngumnikelo wokubulala; umbingeleli uya kumlungisa phambi koNdikhoyo ngenxa yobuxoki bakhe obungekho emthethweni, engawaziyo, aze amxolele.
Lidini lesono. Wathi ke, Ngokuqinisekileyo, wayengenasono phambi koYehova.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

Ke kaloku xa umntu ephelelwe lithemba, esenza inkohlakalo kuYehova, ekhohlisa umnqamlezo wakhe; ke kaloku xa ethetha ngento egcinwe engqondweni yakhe, okanye ngorhwebo, ke kaloku xa ephulaphula kumnqamlezo wakhe, ke kaloku xa eyenza kuye into engafanelekanga:
okanye ukuba afumane into elahlekile, athethe ngayo ngento engalunganga, aphe ilizwi elikhohlakeleyo. Ezi zinto zimbini zezona zinto zabantu bazenzayo isono.

Ke kaloku, xa ekwenzele into leyo, ibe yingozi kuye, kufuneka ayibuyisele loo nto ayithweleyo, okanye loo nto ayeyithathayo ngetyala, okanye loo nto igcinwe engqondweni yakhe, okanye loo nto yalahlekayo ayifumeneyo;
nokuba yiyiphi na into athetha ngayo ngelizwi elikhohlakeleyo; kufuneka ayibuyisele ngokugcwele, aphinde azenze inxalenye yayo yesihlanu; kufuneka ayinike kumnini wayo ngaloo mini afunyenwe ngaye.
Umele amnike umbingeleli, njengomnikelo wakhe wesono kuYehova, inkunzi yebhokhwe, engabikho monakalo kuyo, ngokwexabiso lakho.
Ngelo xesha umbingeleli uya kumlungisa phambi koThixo, phambi kweNkosi; naye angazixolela naziphi na izinto azenzayo, ezenza ukuba abe netyala.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

Umyalelo kuAron noonyana bakhe: Lo ngumthetho wesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi: isonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi kufuneka sihlale emlilweni phezu kwesibingelelo sonke isidlo sakusasa; umlilo wesibingelelo kufuneka ugcinwe ushushu.

Umbingeleli uya kugqoka ibhatyi yakhe yelinen, nempahla engaphantsi yelinen emlonyeni wakhe; athabathe uthuli lwesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, oko umlilo wawutshisa phezu kwesibingelelo, azibeke ngasecaleni kwesibingelelo.
Uya kuzikhupha iimpahla zakhe, agqoke ezinye iingubo, athabathe inkunkuma ngaphandle komkhosi, aye kwindawo engcwele.

Umnqamlezo phezu kwesibingelelo kufuneka ugcinwe ushushu, akufuneki utshise. Umbingeleli uya kubeka imithi phezu kwayo ngemini nganye, abeke phezu kwayo idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, aze amcinezele phezu kwayo umgubo weempawu zoxolo.
Umlilo kufuneka ugcinwe mihla le phezu kwesibingelelo; awunakutshisa.
Lowo ngumthetho womnikelo wesono; oonyana baka-Aron baya kuwunikela kuYehova phambi kwesibingelelo.

Umbingeleli uya kuthatha isandla sakhe esigcweleyo sengqolowa, neoli yesonka somnikelo wokudla, nofuzo lonke olukwinto leyo; uyasitshisa phezu kwesibingelelo, ibe yinkumbulo, ibe yivumba elimnandi kuYehova.
UAron noonyana bakhe baya kulila inxalenye yayo; kufuneka iliwe ngaphandle kweleyisi, kwindawo engcwele, enkundleni yetente yokudibana.
Akuyi kuphekwa ngesonka esixutyiweyo. Ndiya kubanika ukuba ibe yinxalenye yabo, yabanikezeli bam abaqhutywa ngumlilo; ingcwele kakhulu, njengedini lesono, nedini lokubulala.
Wonke umntu owesifazane endlwini ka-Aron uya kulila loo nto; yinxalenye yabo yobomi obude, kubo bonke oonyana babo, kumnikelo womlilo kaYehova. Yonke into enqumlayo ezo zinto ziya kuba zingcwele.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

Le nto ngumnikelo oza kuwunikela uAron noonyana bakhe kuYehova, ngaloo mini abawuphakisa ngayo umntu ngamnye wababingeleli ababingeleli abakhulu: inkunzi yebhokhwe elishumi elinambini neshumi elinesixhenxe, njengedini lesonka esiqhubekayo; inxalenye yayo ngemini, nengxenye yayo ngemini.
Yazilungiselele ngeoyile emlonyeni; uyinikeze ixutywe kakuhle neoli, uyenze ibe ngumnikelo wesonka esibiyelweyo, njengefuthe elimnandi kuYehovaipateni.
Unyana obhalelwe ukuba ngumbingeleli, emva kukaAron, uya kuyinikela; ibe yimithetho ephakamileyo; iya kuqhutywa ngokupheleleyo phambi koYehova.-
Yonke into yomnikelo womnquba kambingeleli kufuneka iqhutywe ngokupheleleyo; asiyi kulinwa.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho kuAron noonyana bakhe, uthi, Lo ngumthetho womnikelo wesono: isonka sesono kufuneka siqhutywe phambi koYehova, kwindawo apho kuqhutywa khona isibingelelo somlilo; lingcwele kakhulu.
Umbingeleli onikela ngayo ngenxa yesono uya kuyidla; iya kuliwa kwindawo engcwele, enkundleni yetente yokudibana.
Yonke into eya kutshisa inyama yayo, iya kuba ngcwele; yaye ukuba igazi layo lithethwa phezu kwempahla, uya kuyihlamba kwindawo engcwele.
Isitya somhlaba esiphekwe kuso kufuneka siqhutywe. Ukuba siphekwe kwisitya sentsimbi engenasici, isitya kufuneka sicocwe kwaye sicocwe ngamanzi.
Wonke umntu owesifazane phakathi kwababingeleli uya kulidla; lingcwele kakhulu.
Ke kaloku, ukuba kukho igazi lesonka sesono sithunyelwe ngaphakathi kwetenki yokuhlangana, ukuze kwenziwe umnikelo wesono ezweni elingcwele, akufanele kulinywe; kufuneka liqhutywe ngomlilo.
Lo ngumthetho womnikelo wesono; ungcwele kunazo zonke.
Kulapho kubulawa khona isibingelelo esiqhutywa ngamanzi, kuya kulinywa idini lesono; igazi layo liya kuvulwa phezu kwesibingelelo ngokujikeleze.
Zonke iinwele zayo ezityebileyo ziya kunikezelwa: intamo yeentloko, neenwele ezityebileyo ezigubungela imithambo-luvo;
neentliziyo ezimbini, notywala lwazo olusembindini womqolo; nomqolo wegazi, wawususa phantsi kweentliziyo.
Umbingeleli uya kuzitshisa phezu kwesibingelelo, ibe yidini eliqhutywa ngamandla kuYehova; lidini lokubulala.
Wonke umntu owesifazane phakathi kwababingeleli uya kulila loo nto; iya kuliwa kwindawo engcwele; ingcwele kakhulu.
Umnikelo wesono ufana nomnikelo wesono; mthetho owodwa uya kuba kuwo onke amadini, abe nguwo umbingeleli, owenzayo umnqophiso noThixo ngalo.
Umbingeleli onikela ngesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, isikhumba salowo mntu siya kuba sakhe.
Yonke inkomfa yesonka esiphekwe efrijini, okanye esiphekwe kwisitya, okanye esiphekwe kwipan, iya kuba nguwe umbingeleli onikela ngayo.
Yonke inkomfa yesonka esilungiselelwe ukutya, ixutywe neoli, nayo ecocekileyo, iya kuba yiyo oonyana baka-Aron bonke, ngokufanayo.
Lo ngumthetho womnikelo wesono, othi umntu awunikezele kuYehova.
Ke kaloku, ukuba azisa ukubulela, anikezele ngazo iintlanzi ezithe nkqo ezingaxutywanga neoli, neziqholo ezithe nkqo ezingaxutywanga neoli, neziqhekeza zesiqhamo esilula esixutywe neoli.
Ngeempawu zakhe zobukumkani, athabathe neentlanzi zesonka esixutywe ngevumba.
Umele anikezele nganye yazo, ibe ngumnikelo ongenisiweyo kuYehova; ibe yiyo umbingeleli onqumlayo igazi lesonka soxolo.
Inyama yomnqophiso wobubele iya kuliwa ngaloo mini inikezelwe ngayo; akukho nto izakugcinwa kuyo ukuya kusasa.
Ke kaloku ukuba umnikelo wakhe ungumnqophiso, okanye umnikelo osuka entliziyweni yakhe, uya kuliwa ngaloo mini anikela ngayo; oko kuseleyo ke kuya kuliwa ngoLwesihlanu.
Nayiphi na inyama eyonakalisayo mhla wesithathu, kufuneka iqhutywe ngomlilo.

Ukuba kukho nantoni na emnqamlezweni wesonka sokumkani esidlalwe ngemini yesithathu, asiyi kuvunyelwa, asiyi kubalwa kumnikeli wayo; iya kuba yintlungu; nokuba ngubani na oyilela loo nto, uya kuthabatha intlungu yakhe.
Intlanzi ethe yanxiba nantoni na engalunganga, asiyi kuliwa; kufuneka iqhutywe emlilweni; kodwa intlanzi yezinye iintlanzi, wonke umntu ococekileyo uya kuyidla.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umntu ongcolileyo udla inyama yesonka sokumnqamlezo, esiyiwe nguYehova, lo mntu uya kususwa phakathi kwabantu bakhe.

Ke kaloku, xa umntu etshisa nantoni na engalunganga, nokuba tu into engalunganga yomntu, okanye inkomo engalunganga, okanye nayiphi na into engaqhelekanga engalunganga, edla inyama yesonka soxolo esiyiwe nguYehova, lo mntu uya kususwa phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Balala oonyana bakaSirayeli, nithi: Musani ukutya nasiphi na iswekile senyama yenkomo, okanye iinkunzi zeenkomo, okanye izimvu.
Intyatyambo yenyama yenkomo efile ngayo, okanye efile ngamanzi, inokusetyenziselwa ezinye izinto; kodwa musa ukuyidla.
Wonke umntu odla utywala lwezinto eziphilayo, ezinikezelwa njengesonka esiqhutywa ngamandla kuYehova, loo mntu uya kususwa ebantwini bakhe.
Ngawo onke amakhaya enu, musa ukutya igazi naliphi na, nokuba yiyo intaka, nokuba yiyo inkomo.
Wonke umntu odla igazi naliphi na, lo mntu uya kususwa phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Uthi ke kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, Wonke umntu onika umnikelo woxolo kuYehova, athabathe isiqingatha sayo, abe ngumnikelo ongenisiweyo kuThixo.
Uya kuzinikela ngezandla zakhe izipho eziqhutywa ngamandla kuYehova; uyasinikela iinkunzi zeenkomo kunye neentliziyo, aze azigqume intliziyo phambi koYehova, ibe lidini eliqhutywa ngomlilo.
Umbingeleli uya kuzitshisa iinkunzi zeenkomo phezu kwesibingelelo; isibeleko siza kuba nguAron nonyana bakhe.
Intamo ekunene yezibingelelo zenu zoxolo niyinike kumbingeleli, ibe ngumnikelo wesono.
Unyana ka-Aron, onikela igazi notywala lwesonka esingcwele soxolo, iya kuba yinxalenye yakhe intamo ekunene.

Ngokuba ndithathe isibeleko esiqhutywayo, nemilenze ephakanyisiweyo, ezimiboniso yoxolo yabantu bakaSirayeli, ndazinika uAron ukumkani nabantwana bakhe; ibe yinxalenye yabo phakathi kwabantu bakaSirayeli, ngonaphakade.
Le yinxalenye ka-Aron nonyana bakhe, emiselweyo kumnikelo womlilo kaYehova, ngomhla bafikelelweyo ukuba babe ngababingeleli bakaYehova.
UYehova wabawisela umthetho oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngaloo mini abatywinwe ngayo, ukuba bayinike loo nto; ibe yinxalenye yabo yobomi obude, ifike kuzo zonke iintlanga zabo.
Lowo ngumthetho womnikelo wokushiswa, nomnikelo wesonka, nomnikelo wesono, nomnikelo wetyala, nomnikelo wokwenza ububingeleli, nomnikelo wokuthula.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuMoses, emnqamlezweni kaSinayi, ngaloo mini awawisela umthetho oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba banikezele izipho zabo kuYehova, entlango kaSinayi.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Nciphisa uAron nonyana bakhe, nezihlangu zababingeleli, neoli yokupheka, nenkunzi yebhokhwe yomnikelo wesono, neenkomo ezimbini, nesiqulathi seentlanzi ezingenasici.
Yathi ke iNkosi kuMoses, Zihlanganisi ibandla lonke emngxunyeni wetente yokudibana.
Wakwenza ke uMoses njengoko wamwiselayo iNkosi; lahlangana ibandla emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana.
Wathi kubo uMoses, Yiyo loo nto iNkosi amwiselayo ukuba siyenze.
UMoses wazisa uAron noonyana bakhe, wabahlamba ngamanzi.
Wamisa uAron ibhanti, wamthabatha umsesane, wamgqobhoza impahla emfutshane, wamisa phezu kwakhe i-ephod; wamisa phezu kwakhe isibonda se-ephod, ukuba siyibeke endaweni yayo.
Wabeka phezu kwakhe isifuba, wamisa i-Urim ne-Thummim kwisifuba.
Wabeka i-tiara phezu kwentloko yakhe, wabeka ngaphambili kwe-tiara intonga yegolide, isithsaba esingcwele; njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathabatha ke uMoses ioli yokubhaka, wabhaka itente engcwele, nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kuyo, ukuba zingcwele.
Watshisa ioli phezu kwesibingelelo amaxesha asixhenxe, wayithambisa isibingelelo nazo zonke izithuthi zaso, nombhobho wokuhlambela nesiseko saso, ukuba zingcwele.
Wamisa ioli yokupheka phezu kweκεφαλi ka-Aron, wamenza ukuba abe ngumbingeleli.
Wazisa ke uMoses oonyana baka-Aron, wabagqoka izihlangu ezimfutshane, wabeka phezu kwabo imiqulu, wabeka iintonga eziphezulu zeentloko zabo; njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo uMoses.
Wazisa inkunzi yenkomo yesonka sesono; uAron nonyana bakhe babeka izandla zabo phezu kwenqanawa.

Ke kaloku uMoses wambulala, wathabatha igazi layo, wayibeka ngesandla sakhe phezu kwazo zonke izikhonkwane zesibingelelo sayo, ukuze ayihlanze; igazi eliseleyo walibambisa phantsi kwesiqingatha sesibingelelo sayo, wayenza ibe yingcwele phambi koThixo.
Wathabatha utywala lonke olusezinyaweni, nomqolo wegazi, nezihlunu zombini notywala lwazo; waza uMoses wawutshisa phezu kwesibingelelo.
Ke kaloku inkunzi yenkomo, isikhumba sayo, nenkukhu yayo, nenyamatenkumbulo yayo, wazitshisa ngomlilo ngaphandle komkhosi; njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Wazisa unyana womkhweli womnikelo wokushiswa; uAron noonyana bakhe babeka izandla zabo phezu kwentloko yalo.
Wayibulala ke uMoses, watshisa igazi phezu kwesibingelelo ngazo zonke iindawo.
Wamisa unyana womntu waba ziintonga; uMoses watshisa intloko, nezontanga, nenyama.

Wazihlamba ngamanzi izihlunu nemilenze; uMoses wamcinezela wonke lo mntanda phezu kwesibingelelo: yayisonka esiqhutywa ngamandla, ivumba elimnandi, idini elifihliweyo kuYehova; njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathabatha ke unyana webhokhwe omnye, unyana webhokhwe wokuba ngumbingeleli kubo; wabeka uAron noonyana bakhe izandla zabo phezu kwentloko yayo.
Wayibulala ke uMoses, wathabatha igazi layo, wamfaka phezu kwengcambu yendlebe ekunene ka-Aron, naphezu komnwe wakhe okunene, naphezu komnwe omkhulu wenyawo lakhe ekunene.

Wabazisa ke oonyana baka-Aron, wabeka uMoses igazi phezu kweendlebe zabo ezikunene, naphezu komnwe wabo wesandla sasekunene, namadolo abo enyawo lasekhohlo; waza uMoses wehlisa elo gazi kwisibingelelo esijikelezayo.
Wathabatha utywala, nomlenze wotywala, notywala lonke olusezinyaweni, nentonga yegazi, nezihlunu zombini netywala lwazo, nesifuba esikunene.

Wathabatha, ekungeneni kwebhotile yeentlanzi ezingaqhelekanga, ezingaphambili kukaYehova, ibhokhwe enye encinane, nebhokhwe enye eyenziwe ngeoyile, nebhokhwe enye encinane; wazisa phezu kotywala, naphezu komlenze osekunene.
Wazibeka zonke ezi zinto emlonyeni kaAron, nasemlonyeni waabantwana bakhe; waza wazigqubuthela phambi koYehova njengento esigqubuthelayo.

Wazithabatha ke uMoses ezandla zabo, waza uzitshisa phezu kwesibingelelo, ngaphezu kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi; yayiye inkomfa yokwenza ukuba babe ngababingeleli, ibe yivumba elimnandi, idini elifihliweyo kuYehova.
Wathabatha ke uMoses isifuba, waza wasigquma phambi koYehova; ibe yinxalenye kaMoses kwimvu, ukuba abe ngumbingeleli, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo uMoses.

Wathabatha ke uMoses ioli yokupheka, negazi elingene osangweni, walihlisa phezu kuka-Aron, nezihlangu zakhe, namadodana akhe, nezihlangu zamadodana akhe; wabangcwele ngokunjalo uAron nezihlangu zakhe, namadodana akhe, nezihlangu zamadodana akhe.

Wathi uMoses kuAron noonyana bakhe, Ubisisele inyama emngxunyeni wetentyatyambo yokuhlangana, niyidle khona, nesonka esikwibhotile yokulungiselela ababingeleli; njengokuba ndiwisela umthetho, ndisithi, UAron nonyana bakhe baya kuyidla.
Nciphise konke okuseleyo kwenyama nesonka.
Musani kuphuma emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana iintsuku ezisixhenxe, de zigqitywe iintsuku zokubekwa kwenu endlwini kaThixo; iintsuku ezisixhenxe êza kunimisa.
Oko kuthe kwenziwe namhlanje, ngumthetho kaYehova, ukunilungisa kuni noThixo.
Nihlale emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana busuku nobusuku iintsuku ezisixhenxe, nigcine imiyalelo kaYehova, ukuze ningafa; kuba oko kuthe kwathiwa kum.
Ke kaloku uAron noonyana bakhe bazenza zonke izinto awiselayo iNkosi ngomlomo kaMoses.
Kwathi ngomhla wesibhozo, uMoses wabiza uAron noonyana bakhe, nabathetheli bakaSirayeli.
Wathi kuAron, Yithathe inkunzi yenkomo encinci, ibe yidini lesono, nemvu, ibe lidini lokunqunyanyiswa; zibe zingenakubi, uzilungiselele iNkosi.

Bathi ke kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, Nithathe inkunzi yenkomo ibe ngumnikelo wesono, nenkunzi yebhokhwe nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka elishumi elinambini ubudala, engabikho monakalo kuyo, ibe ngumnikelo womlilo.
Niyithathe inkunzi yenkomo, nenyama yomgubo, zibe zizipho zoxolo, nizinikezele kuYehova; nomnikelo wesonka oxutywe neoli; ngokuba namhlanje iNkosi uya kukubonakalisa.
Bazithabatha ke ezo zinto uMoses awisenzileyo, bazisa phambi kwetenki yokuhlangana; ibandla lonke lafika, lihlala phambi koYehova.
Wathi uMoses, Yiyo loo nto iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngayo ukuba niyenze; yaye uzuko lukaYehova luza kukubonakalisa.

Wathi ke uMoses kuAron, Yifike kwisibingelelo, uyilungiselele idini lakho lesono, nedini lakho eliqhutywa ngamanzi, ukuze wenze intliziyo yakho ibe ngcwele phambi koThixo, nawe nabantu; uze uyilungiselele intliziyo yabantu, ukuze benze intliziyo yabo ibe ngcwele phambi koThixo, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo.
Wafika ke uAron kwisibingelelo, wabulala inkunzi yebhokhwe ibe yisonka sesono sakhe.
Bathi ke oonyana baka-Aron bamnika igazi; watshisa umnwe wakhe kulo, wayibeka phezu kweempawu zesibingelelo; igazi eliseleyo lalifutha phantsi kwesibingelelo.
Wazithutha phezu kwesibingelelo iinwele, nezihlunu, nentonga yentliziyo yesonka sesono; njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo umthetho uMoses.
Inyama nesikhumba saso wazitshisa ngomlilo, ngaphandle kwekhabhathi.
Wabulala ke idini eliqhutywa limlilo; noonyana baka-Aron bamnika igazi, walihlisa phezu kwesibingelelo ngazo zonke iintloko.
Bathi ke kuye idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, ingxenye ngenxalenye yayo, kunye neκεφαλi; wazitshisa phezu kwesibingelelo.
Wazihlamba izihlunu nemilenze, waza wazitshisa phezu kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi kwisibingelelo.
Wazisa ke umnikelo wale ndoda, wathabatha inkunzi yebhokhwe yomnikelo wesono wale ndoda, wayibulala, wayinikela njengomnikelo wesono, njengokuba wenzayo leyo yokuqala.
Wathabatha idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, wayinikela ngendlela awayegunyaziwe ngayo.
Wathabatha umnikelo wokudla, wawugcwalisa umlomo wakhe ngaye, wayitshisa phezu kwesibingelelo, kunye nesonka sokusasa esiqhutywa ngumlilo.
Wabulala inkunzi yebhokhwe nemvu, ibe yimithandazo yabantu; uAron nonyana wakhe bamnika igazi, walihlisa phezu kwesibingelelo ngaphaya.
Bathi ke kuye utywala lwenkomo, notywala lomnquma, notywala oluzigubungela izitho zangaphakathi, nezihlunu, notywala lwesibeleko.
Babeka utywala phezulu kwezibeleko, watshisa utywala phezu kwesibingelelo.
UAron wayalela iinkunzi zeenkomo, nengalo ekunene, ukuba ziqhutywe phambi koYehova; njengoko uMoses abewiselayo.
Waphakamisa ke uAron izandla zakhe abantu, wababhaptiza; waza wahla emva kokuba elungiselele isibingelelo sesono, nesibingelelo somlilo, nezibingelelo zoxolo.
Ke kaloku uMoses noAron bafika etentweni yokuhlangana; bephuma ke, babambisa abantu. Uzuko lukaYehova lwabonakala kubo bonke abantu.
Waphuma umlilo endlwini kaYehova, watshisa idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, nenyama, phezu kwesibingelelo. Yabona loo nto yonke intliziyo yabantu, babhiyozela ngovuyo, bahlangula ngeempawu zabo phantsi.

Ke kaloku uNadab noAbhihu, oonyana baka-Aron, bathabatha omnye ngamnye isuti yakhe yomlilo, babeka kuyo umlilo, babeka phezu kwayo umnquba; banikela kuYehova umlilo ongafanelekanga, into awayebangawawisela umthetho ngayo.
Waphuma umlilo endlwini kaYehova, wabatshisa; babafa phambi koYehova.
Wathi ke uMoses kuAron, Le nto ithethayo iNkosi, esithi, Ndiya kuba ngungcwele kubo bandisekayo kum; ndiya kuba mkhulu phambi kobuso bomntu wonke. UAron ke akathethi nto.
UMoses wabiza uMishayeli noElzafane, oonyana bakaUziyele umyeni ka-Aron; wathi kubo, Nxibelelani, nithabathe abazalwana benu ngaphambili kwendawo engcwele, ngaphandle komkhosi.
Bafika ke, babathwala phandle komkhosi, bezigqoka iingubo zabo, njengokuba uMoses wathi.

Wathi ke uMoses kuAron, noElazare noIthamari, oonyana bakhe, Musani ukushiya iinwele zenu zivuleke, nangamagqomo enu, ukuba nililinde, ukuze ningafile; ibe iNkosi uya kubakhokelela intliziyo yakhe kwintlanganiso yonke; kodwa abazalwana benu, bonke abantwana bakaSirayeli, balilinde ngenxa yabo, abo iNkosi awatshisa ngomlilo.
Musani kuphuma emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana, ukuze nife; ngokuba ioli yokupheka kaYehova iya kuba phezu kwenu. Bayenza ke loo nto uMoses awiselayo.
Wathetha iNkosi kuAron, wathi,
Musani ukutshaya iwayini, namanzi ashushu, wena nonyana bakho, xa ningena etentweni yokuhlangana, ukuze ningafa; ibe ngumthetho ohlala ubomi bonke abazalwana benu.
Nikwazi ukukhetha phakathi kwento engcwele nento engathandekiyo, phakathi kwento engalunganga nento ecocekileyo.
Nizifundise ke oonyana bakaSirayeli zonke izigqibo, iNkosi awathi kubo ngesandla sikaMoses.

Wathi uMoses kuAron, noElazare noItamari, oonyana bakhe abaseleyo, Niyithathe idini lesonka eliseleyo kwiintyatyambo eziqhutywa ngamandla kaYehova, nilidle lingenawo umgubo ecaleni kwesibingelelo; ngokuba lingcwele kakhulu.
Uya kulila endaweni engcwele; ngokuba yinxalenye yakho, nenxalenye yabantwana bakho, yezonka eziqhutywa ngamandla zikaYehova. Oku kuthe kwathiwa kum.

Ke wena, noonyana bakho, neentombi zakho, nizidle isibeleko esiqhutywayo, nesinqe esithe nkqo, nakweyiphi na indawo ecocekileyo; zinikezelwe kuwe nabantwana bakho, zibe yinxalenye yenu, ezimilweni yamaSirayeli yoxolo.

Intamo enyukiweyo, nesibeleko esiqhutywayo, kufuneka zithunyelwe kunye nenyama, zibe yimithandazo eyenziwe ngomlilo, ziqhutywe phambi koYehova, zibe ngumnikelo oqhutywayo; ziya kuba zakho nabantwana bakho, ibe yinxalenye yenu ngonaphakade, njengoko iNkosi abewiselayo.
Ke kaloku uMoses wakhangela ibhokhwe yesonka somnikelo wesono, yabona ukuba iqhutywe. Waxolisa ke kuElezare noIthamari, oonyana baka-Aron abaseleyo, wathi,
Uthini na ukuba ningalidla idini lesono kwindawo engcwele? Lingcwele kakhulu; uThixo wamnika lona, ukuze asuse ububi bebandla, aze awalungisa kuThixo phambi koYehova.
Igazi layo alingeniswanga ngaphakathi kwendawo engcwele; ke ngoko, nimele niyidle kwindawo engcwele, njengokuba ndiwisela umthetho.

Waphendula uAron kuMoses, esithi, Yabona, namhlanje banikela idini labo lesono, nedini labo elinyukayo, kuYehova; yaye zafika kum ezi zinto zibuhlungu; ukuba ndidlale idini lesono namhlanje, iNkosi uya kuyithanda na?
Ke kaloku, xa uMoses ephulaphule loo nto, wavuya.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses noAron, wathi,
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Kuzo zonke iintlanzi eziphilayo ehlabathini, ezi zizinto oza kuzidla.
Ungadla nasiphi na isilwanyana esinomqolo ophindwe kabini kwaye sitshizise i-cud.
Zininzi ke iintaka ezidla ngotywala, okanye ezinomqolo ophindwe kabini; musa ukuzidla. Iingelosi zidla ngotywala, kodwa ayinamqolo ophindwe kabini; iya kuba yinyama engcolileyo kuni.
I-rock badger itshisa iinwele kodwa ayinayo intamo ephindwe kabini, ngoko ke ayicocekanga kuni.
Ingulube itshiza i-cud kodwa ayinayo intamo ephindwe kabini, ngoko ke ayicocekanga kuwe.
Iinkomo zinomqolo ophindwe kabini, uphindwe macala onke, kodwa azitshizi; ziya kuba ngamanzi.
Musani ukutya inyama yazo, ningazicoci izidumbu zazo; ziya kuba zimbi kuni.
Kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo emanzini, elwandle nakumlambo, zonke ezo zinomqolo namachaphaza, nizidle.
Ke kaloku zonke izinto ezilwandle, nakwiimlambo, ezingabakho iziqhoboshi neziqhamo, nokuba ziintaka ezincinci zamanzi, nokuba yiyiphi na into ephilayo yamanzi, ziya kuba ngumbulelo kuni.
Zimele zibe yintlungu kuwe; inyama yazo musa ukuyidla, nezinyama zazo zimele zibe yintlungu kuwe.
Nantoni na emanzini engakholelekiyo iziqhoboshi nezigqubuthelo yenza ukuba ukhathazeke.
Ezi ziintaka, nizithathe njengezinto ezibi; musa ukuzidla, ngokuba zizinto ezibi: i-eagle, ne-eagle emnyama, ne-eagle emhlophe,
iintaka ezibomvu, naziphi na iintlobo zeentaka ezimnyama;
naluphi na uhlobo lweqhwa,
i-owl enezikhonkwane, ne-owl ephikisayo, ne-seagull, nokuba yiyiphi indidi ye-hawk;
i-owl encinci, ne-cormorant, ne-owl enkulu,
i-owl emhlophe, ne-owl yasendle, ne-osprey,
i-stork, nayiphi na indidi ye-heron, i-hoopee, ne-bat.
Zonke iintsholongwane ezibalekayo ezihamba ngemilenze emine zibuhlungu kuwe.
Zonke iintaka eziphilayo ezihamba ngeenyawo ezine, nize nizidle; ezo zinomqolo odityanisiweyo ngasentla kweenyawo zawo,ulo mntu, ukuze aqhume phantsi.
Kuzo nidla zonke iintlobo zeentaka, zonke iintlobo zeentyatyambo, zonke iintlobo zeengcuka, nazo zonke iintlobo zeentyatyambo.
Zonke ezinye iintsholongwane ezinamaphiko ezinemilenze emine zinomsindo kuwe.
Zonke ezi zinto ziya kuninyanzela. Wonke umntu otshisa umphefumlo wabo, uya kuba namachiza de kube semini.
Wonke umntu othabatha nantoni na emfazweni wabo, uya kuhlamba iimpahla zakhe, aze abe mnciphisi kude kube semini.
Zonke izinto eziphilayo, ezinomqolo ongaqhelekanga, nazo zonke ezo zingadla ngotywala, ziya kuba zimbi kuni; wonke umntu ozitshisa uya kuba mnyama.
Kuzo zonke iintaka ezihamba ngeenyawo ezine, ezo zihamba ngeentloko zenu ziya kuba zimbi kuni; umntu onqumlayo umphefumlo wabo uya kuba mnyama de kube semini.
Nabani na othabatha iinkunzi zawo, kufuneka ahlamba izihlangu zakhe, abe mnciphisi de kube semini; ziya kuba mnciphisi kuni-ke.
Kuzo zonke iintlanzi ezihamba phantsi komhlaba, ezi ziya kuba zingcolileyo kuni: iintaka, neengcuka, nazo zonke iintkobhontsi privu,
i-gekko, i-monitor lizard, i-wall lizard, i-skink, kunye ne-chameleon.
Kuzo zonke iintaka ezihamba phezu komhlaba, ezi zinto ziya kuba zingcolileyo kuni; wonke umntu ozitshisa xa zifile, uya kuba nesono de kube semini.

Ukuba enye yazo ifile, ibe isuka phezu kwento ethile, iya kuba tu; nokuba yintsimbi, nokuba yimpahla, nokuba yisikhumba, nokuba yimigqomo, nokuba yintoni na esetyenziswa kuyo, iya kubekwa emanzini; izakuba tu kude kube semini; emva koko iya kuba yinhle.
Ukuba enye yazo iwela kwisitya somhlaba, zonke izinto ezikwisitya ziya kuba zingcolileyo; kufuneka uvule isitya.
Yonke inyama edlakayo, ukuba kungena amanzi kuloo mbhobho, iya kuba yinyani; nakuphi na utywala olukhoyo kuloo mbhobho luya kuba linyani.
Nantoni na ephuma kuyo inyama yazo, iya kuba yinyani; ukuba iyifriji, nokuba iyibhodwe lokupheka, iya kuqhutywa ibe ziinxalenye; ziya kuba zinyani, nizigcine zibe zinenyani.
Ke kaloku umbhobho, nokuba yimpu, equlethe amanzi, uya kuba ucocekile; kodwa wonke umntu otshisa inyama emlonyeni wayo, uya kuba mkhulu.
Ukuba inxalenye yomphefumlo ofileyo iwela kwisityalo esiza kusetyenzwa, isityalo sihlala sicocekile.
Ke kaloku, ukuba amanzi afakwe phezu kwesityalo sayo, nakuba kukho into ephuma kumhlaza wayo iwela phezu kwayo, iya kuba yinqambi kuni.
Ukuba inyama yezinto eziphilayo, ezidla ngazo, zifile ngokwazo; umntu onqumlayo umphefumlo wayo, uya kuba mncipha kude kube kusasa.
Wonke umntu odla inyama yayo, uya kuhlamba izihlangu zakhe, aze abe nenyameko de kube semini; nalowo uthabatha inyama yayo, uya kuhlamba izihlangu zakhe, aze abe nenyameko de kube semini.
Yonke into encinane ehamba phantsi komhlaba, inobungozi; musa ukuyidla.
Nayiphi na into ehambayo phantsi komhlaba, nokuba ihamba ngesibeleko sayo, nokuba ihamba ngeenyawo ezine, nokuba ineenyawo ezininzi, musa ukuyidla; zizinto ezibi.
Musani kwenza iinwele zenu zibe zinomsindo, ningabi namanzi ngazo zonke ezinyama ezihambayo; musani kwenza iinwele zenu zibe zinomsindo.
Kuba mna ndinguYehova uThixo wenu; nizingcweleni, nibe zingcwele, ngokuba mna ndiyingcwele. Musani ukubizela iinwele zenu ngazo zonke izinto ezihamba phantsi komhlaba.
Ndiye mna iNkosi, owazikhuphileyo ezweni laseYiputa, ukuba ndibe nguThixo wenu; nibe bangcwele ke; ngokuba ndingcwele.
Lo ngumthetho wezinto eziphilayo, neentlanzi, nazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezihamba emanzini, nazo zonke izinto ezihamba phantsi komhlaba.
ukuze nikwazi ukwahlula phakathi kwezinto ezingcolileyo nezinto ezicocekileyo, naphakathi kwezinyama ezidlayo nezinyama ezingadlanga.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho ke uNdikhoyo kuYakobi, uthi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli: Xa umntu ekhulelwa, ezala umntwana owesifazane, uya kuba mnyama iintsuku ezisixhenxe, njengokuba engcolileyo ngexesha lokuphuma kwakhe.
Ngomhla wesibhozo unyana womfazi uya kuthwala.
Ke yena alinde iintsuku ezimashumi mathathu anesibhozo, ukuba acoceke ekungeneni kwegazi lakhe; angayitshisi into engcwele, angangeni kwindawo engcwele, de ziphele imihla yokucoca kwakhe.

Ke kaloku, ukuba ezala indodakazi, uya kuba mnyama iintsuku ezibini, njengokuba mnyama ngexesha lokuphuma kwegazi lakhe; kufuneka alinde imihla engamashumi amathandathu anesithandathu, aze acoceke kwigazi lakhe.

Xa zigqityiwe iintsuku zokucoca kwakhe, nokuba nguphanda okanye intombi, athabathe inkunzi yenkomo yomnyaka mnye, ibe lidini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, aze amnike umbingeleli, emngxunyeni wetente yokudibana; athabathe iintaka ezincinci, zibe yidini lesono.
Umbingeleli uya kuzinikela kubo kuYehova, ayenze inyaniso kuye uThixo; aze acocekile kwigazi lakhe eliphumayo. Lo ngumthetho womfazi ozala umntwana wesifazane, okanye umntwana wesifazana.

Ke kaloku, ukuba akakwazi ukuhlawula inkunzi yebhokhwe, athabathe iintaka ezibini, okanye iintombi zebhokhwe ezimbini; enye ibe lidini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, nenye ibe lidini lesono. Umbingeleli uya kumlungisa phambi koYehova, aze abe mhle.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses noAron, wathi,

Ke kaloku, xa umntu ebona ukuba isikhumba sakhe siphukile, okanye sineentlobongela, okanye sineempawu ezikhanyayo, zibe yizifo zesikhumba; kufuneka afikelwe kuAron ukumkani, okanye kumnye wabo oonyana bakhe ababingeleli.

Umbingeleli uya kuyijonga iintsholongwane zesikhumba; ukuba iinwele kwiintsholongwane zitshintshile zibe mhlophe, kwaye iintsholongwane zibonakale ziphantsi kunesikhumba, ibe yisifo esibi sesikhumba; umbingeleli uya kumjonga, athi ngumuntu ongenabuthi.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umbala okhanyayo esikhumbani umhlophe, nokuba awubonakaliyo ngaphantsi kwesikhumba, iinwele zayo zingabi zimnyama; ngoko ke umbingeleli uya kumfihla iintsuku ezisibhozo.
Umbingeleli uya kumqwalasela kwakhona ngomhla wesixhenxe; ukuba, ekuboneni kwakhe, iintsholongwane azitshintshi, zithe zasasazeka kwisikhumba, ke umbingeleli uya kumfihla iintsuku ezisibhozo.

Umbingeleli uya kumqwalasela kwakhona ngemini yesixhenxe; ukuba iintsholongwane ziye zanyamalala, zingasasazi kwisikhumba, umbingeleli uya kuthetha ukuba ucocekile, kuba yintlungu; kufuneka ahlamba iimpahla zakhe, aze abe mhle.
Ukuba ke, emva kokuba ebonakaliswe kumbingeleli ukuba ucocekile, iintsholongwane zithe zasasazeka kwisikhumba sakhe, uya kuphinda abonakaliswe kumbingeleli.
Umbingeleli uya kumqwalasela; ukuba iintsholongwane zithe zasasazeka kwisikhumba, umbingeleli uya kuthetha ukuba ungumntu ongenasono; kubuhlungu kakhulu.
Xa umntu enesifo esibuhlungu sesikhumba, kufuneka athathelwe kumbingeleli.
Umbingeleli uya kumbona; ukuba kukho utywala olumhlophe esikhumbani, luguqule iinwele zibe mnyama, ibekho inyama emdaka kulo tywala,
isifo sesikhumba esihlala ixesha elide; umbingeleli uya kumthisa ukuba ungum additi; akafuni ukumfihla, ngokuba ungumdididi.
Ke kaloku, ukuba iintsholongwane zikhupha kwisikhumba sonke, zigubungele isikhumba sakhe sonke, ukususela ebusweni bakhe ukuya enyawo lwakhe, naphi na apho umbingeleli ebona khona,
umbingeleli uya kumqwalasela; ukuba iintsholongwane zithe zagubungela umzimba wakhe wonke, umbingeleli uya kuthetha ukuba ucocekile kwiintsholongwane zakhe. Ziye zaba mhlophe zonke; ucocele.
Ke kaloku, xa kubonakala kuye inyama ephilayo, uya kuba mncipha.
Umbingeleli uya kuyijonga inyama ecocekileyo, athi ngumnyama; inyama ecocekileyo yinyama ecocekileyo; lisifo esibuhlungu.
Ke kaloku, ukuba inyama emnyama itshintshile ibe mhlophe, kufuneka afike kumbingeleli.
Umbingeleli uya kumbona; ukuba iintsholongwane zitshintshile zibe mhlophe, umbingeleli uya kuthi ucocekile kwiintsholongwane zakhe; ucocekile.
Ke kaloku xa umntu efumana intlungu emlonyeni wakhe, ibe icocekile,

Umbingeleli uya kuyijonga; ukuba ibonakale iphantsi kunesikhumba, namehlo akhe amnyama, umbingeleli uya kuthetha ukuba unobungozi; kuba yisifo esibi sesikhumba, sikhuphe ebusweni besilonda.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umbingeleli uyijonge, yabona ukuba ayikho iinwele ezimhlophe kuloo ndawo, yaye ayinakuba phantsi kunesikhumba, ibe imnyama; ngoko ke umbingeleli uya kumfihla iintsuku ezisibhozo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba isasazeke kakhulu esikhumbani, umbingeleli uya kumthisa ukuba ungumntu ongcolileyo; lusifo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umbala okhanyayo uhlala endaweni yakhe, awusalunga, ke ngoko ngumhlaza wesifo; umbingeleli uya kumthisa ukuba ucocekile.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu ecinezela isikhumba sakhe ngomlilo, ukutya okutshiswayo kwenzeke kube yindawo eqaqambileyo, ebomvu-bomvu okanye ebomvu.

umbingeleli uya kuyijonga; ukuba iinwele ezikwindawo emhlophe zenziwe zibumnyama, zibonakale ziphantsi kunesikhumba, ngoko kubuhlungu besikhumba obungapheliyo, buphuma emngciphekweni. Umbingeleli uya kumxelela ukuba ungumntu ongenabuthi; lubuhlungu besikhumba obungapheliyo.

Ke kaloku, ukuba umbingeleli uyijonga, yabona ukuba kukho iinwele ezimhlophe kulo mkhuhlane, yaye ayikho ngaphantsi kwesikhumba, ibe imnyama kakhulu; ngoko ke umbingeleli uya kumfihla iintsuku ezisibhozo.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe umbingeleli uya kumqwalasela; ukuba sele isasazeke kwisikhumba, umbingeleli uya kumthisa ukuba ungumntu ongcolileyo; lisifo esibuhlungu.

Ke kaloku, ukuba umbala okhanyayo uhlala endaweni yakhe, angasathethwanga esikhumbani, kodwa umnyama kakhulu, ngoko ke, kubuhlungu bomlilo; umbingeleli uya kumxelela ukuba ucocekile; kuba yimithambo yomlilo.
Xa umntu, indoda okanye umfazi, efumana intlungu entliziyweni yakhe, okanye emlonyeni wakhe;

umbingeleli uya kuyijonga intlungu; ukuba ibonakale phantsi kunesikhumba, nezinwele zayo zibe mthubi ezimdaka, umbingeleli wothi ngumuntu ongcolileyo. Iintsholongwane zesilonda esikhuthazayo sisifo solusu seentloko okanye seenwele.

Ke kaloku, ukuba umbingeleli ejonge iinwele zesilonda, yaye, kubonakala ngathi, azikho ziphantsi kunesikhumba, zingabikho khona iinwele ezimnyama; ngoko ke umbingeleli uya kumfihla iintsuku ezisibhozo.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe umbingeleli uya kuyijonga iintsholongwane; ukuba intsholongwane ayisasazikanga, ingabikho kuyo iinwele ezimthubi, nokuba ibonakala ngathi ayikho ngaphantsi kulusu,
umele awele iinwele zakhe, kodwa angawele iinwele zesilonda; ngoko ke umbingeleli uya kumfihla yena iintsuku ezisibhozo.

Ngomhla wesixhenxe umbingeleli uya kujonga iintsholongwane; ukuba zithe zasasazeka esikhumbani, nokuba kubonakala ngathi azikho phantsi kunesikhumba, ke umbingeleli uya kubhengeza ukuba ucocekile; uya kuzihlamba izinto zakhe, aze ahlale ecocekileyo.
Ukuba ke, emva kokuba eqinisekisiwe ukuba ucocekile, iintsholongwane zithe zasasazeka kwisikhumba,
umbingeleli uya kumbona kwakhona; ukuba iintsholongwane zithe zasasazeka kwisikhumba, umbingeleli akafuni ukukhangela iinwele ezimthubi; ungumntu ongenanto.
Ke kaloku, xa umbingeleli ebona ukuba iinwele ezimnyama ziye zakhula kuyo, iinwele ezimnyama azitshintshi, iinwele ezimnyama zikhulule; lo mntu ucocekile; umbingeleli uya kumxelela ukuba ucocekile.
Xa umfazi, nokuba ngumntu wesifazane, ebona amachaphaza amhlophe esikhumba sakhe,
umbingeleli uya kuzijonga; ukuba iinyembezi zimhlophe, zingabonakali ngathi zimnyama, ngoko ke kubuhlungu obungaphaya kwesikhumba; lo mntu ucocekile.
Xa umntu eshiya iinwele zesifuba sakhe, umnyama, kodwa ucocekile.
Ukuba iinwele zakhe ziphuma ngasemva kwengcambu yakhe, ziphuma ngasemva kwengcambu yakhe; ucocekile.
Kodwa ukuba kukho intlungu ebomvu-emnyama ebusweni okanye kwisiphelo sendlebe, oko kuthetha ukuba kukho isifo esibi solusu esiphuma apho.
umbingeleli uya kumbona; ukuba iinwele zakhe ezimdaka, okanye imilenze yakhe eyimdaka, zineentlungu ezinombala ongwevu, njengentsholongwane yesikhumba emlonyeni wakhe,
ke unyana womfazi uya kuba neentlungu ebusweni bakhe, abe mnyama; umbingeleli uya kumxelela ukuba umnyama, ngenxa yeentlungu ezisenkanyeni yakhe.
Ke kaloku umntu onesifo sesikhumba, kufuneka agqoke iimpahla ezirhabaxa, ashiye iinwele zakhe zithe nkqo; kufuneka agubungele icala eliphantsi lomlomo wakhe, atsho ke athi, Amanzi! Amanzi.
Zonke iintsuku eziphilayo isifo sakhe, uya kuba mncipha; kufuneka ahlale ecaleni kwakhe, ngaphandle komkhosi.
Izinto zokuzigqoka zinokuba nazo iintsholongwane kuyo, nokuba ziimpahla zoboya okanye zelinen,
okanye impahla ethe tyaba, okanye ethe nkqo, yelinen, okanye yenkomo, okanye isikhumba, okanye nantoni na eyenziwe ngesikhumba.

Ukuba isibonda esikwimpahla, okanye kwisikhumba, okanye kwinto ethe tyaba, okanye ethe nkqo, okanye kwisixhobo sesikhumba, siluhlaza, okanye sibomvu kakhulu, yimifuno esasazekayo; kufuneka iboniswe kumbingeleli.
Umbingeleli uya kuyijonga iintsholongwane, ashiye loo nto iintsuku ezisibhozo.

Ngomhla wesixhenxe uya kuyijonga; ukuba iintsholongwane zisasazeke kwimpahla, nakwizinto ezenziweyo, nakwizinto ezithe tyaba, nakwisikhumba, nakweyiphi na into esetyenziswa kuyo, kubuhlungu intsholongwane, ibe yinto engangcwele.

Uya kuyitshisa iingubo, nokuba ziyimisonto, nokuba ziintambo zesundu, nokuba ziilinen, nokuba yimpahla yesikhumba, ekhoyo kuyo intsholongwane; kuba yintsholongwane enobungozi; iya kutshiswa emlilweni.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umbingeleli ebona ukuba iintsholongwane azisasazi kwimpahla, nakwizinto ezithe tyaba, nakwizinto ezenziwe ngesikhumba;
umbingeleli uya kuthetha ukuba ihlambalwe loo nto ineentlungu, aphinde ayigcine iintsuku ezisibhozo.

Ke kaloku umbingeleli uya kuyijonga kwakhona, emva kokuba ihlanjwe; ukuba iintsholongwane azitshintshi umbala wayo, nokuba zithe zasasazeka, iya kuba yinto engcolileyo. Ukuba intsholongwane ikwindawo yangaphakathi okanye kwindawo yangaphandle, uyitshise emlilweni.

Ke kaloku, ukuba umbingeleli ejonge, wabona ukuba iintsholongwane zifihle emva kokuzihlamba, ke yena umbingeleli uya kuzisusa ezi ntsholongwane kwimpahla, okanye kwisikhumba, okanye kwinto ethe nkqo, okanye kwinto ethe nkqo.

Ke kaloku, ukuba iphinde yavela kwimpahla, nakwizinto ezithe tyaba, nakwizinto ezenziwe ngesandla, nakweyiphi na into eyenziwe ngesikhumba, iyasasazeka;ipateni nganye enayo intsholongwane, uyitshise emlilweni.
Ukuba uhlamba iingubo, nokuba ziyinto ethe tyaba, nokuba ziyinto ethe nkqo, nokuba yintoni na eyenziwe ngesikhumba, ibe isuka kuyo loo nto, uya kuyihlamba kwakhona, ibe iya kucoceka.

Lo ngumthetho wesifo sebhokhwe kwimpahla yoboya, nakwilinen, nakwizinto ezithe nkqo, nakwizinto ezithe nkqo, nakweyiphi na into eyenziwe ngesikhumba, ukuze kucace ukuba icocekile nakuba ingacocekanga.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Lo ngumthetho wokuba umntu onesifo solusu, ngomhla wokucocwa kwakhe, athathelwe kumbingeleli;
umbingeleli uya kuphuma ngaphandle komkhosi, ajonge; ukuba lo mntu sele ephilisiwe kule ntlungu,
umbingeleli uya kucela ukuba zithunyelwe kuye iintaka ezimbini eziphilayo, ezicocekileyo, kunye nentsimbi yesedari, noboya obubomvu, ne implanga ye-isope.
Umbingeleli uya kucela ukuba intaka enye ifile phezu kwamanzi acocekileyo aphumayo kwisitya somthi.
Uya kuthatha ikati ephilayo, nokhuni lweediliya, nesibindi esibomvu, ne-hysop; azizitshisa ezo zinto, nekati ephilayo, kwigazi lekati elibiwe phezu kwamanzi aphumayo.
Uya kutshisa igazi phezu komntu ococwayo, phinda-phinda amaxesha asixhenxe, athethe ukuba ucocekile; uyasishiya ke isibhozo esiphilayo sihambe ezweni elivulekile.

Ke yena ococekileyo uya kuzihlamba iimpahla zakhe, aziqhekeze zonke iinwele zakhe, ahlamba ngamanzi, aze abe mhle; emva koko angaya endlwini kakumkani, kodwa kufuneka ahlale ngaphandle kwetentile yakhe iintsuku ezisibhozo.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe uya kutshaya zonke iinwele zakhe, intloko yakhe, nembevu yakhe, namehlo akhe, nazo zonke iinwele zakhe; ahlamba izihlangu zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, aze abe mhle.

Ngomhla wesibhozo athabathe iinkunzi zeegusha ezimbini, nengubo yegusha elinye elineminyaka elishumi elinanye ubudala, zingenanto yobugqwetha kuzo zonke; nomgubo womnquma omncinci, oxutywe neoli, ubuncinane amawaka amathathu eetoni, ibe ngumnikelo wokudla; neoli, ubuncinane isiqingatha selitha yomthi.
Ke yena umbingeleli owenza ukuxolelwa kwakhe, abeke loo mntu naloo madini phambi koYehova, emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana.
Umbingeleli uya kuthatha omnye umntwana womntwana, alungiselele ukuba ibe ngumnikelo wesono, kunye neoli; umbingeleli uya kuzitshisa phambi koYehova zibe yidini eliqhutywa.
Umele afile loo mntwana kwindawo engcwele, apho kubulawa khona idini lesono, nedini eliqhutywa ngamanzi; njengedini lesono, nomnikelo wokubulala uya kuba nguwo umbingeleli; lingcwele kakhulu.
Umbingeleli ke uya kuthatha igazi lesonka esingenasono, alisifake emlonyeni wendlebe ekunene yomntu ococekileyo, nomnwe omkhulu wesandla sakhe esingenanto, nomnwe omkhulu wenyawo lakhe elingenanto.
Umbingeleli uya kutywina ioli leyo emlonyeni wesandla sakhe esikhohlo;

Wathi ke umbingeleli umnwe wakhe wesandla esikunene awutshise kwioli ekwisandla sakhe sasekhohlo; wathi umbingeleli umnwe wakhe wesandla esikhohlo aphucule ioli ngesandla sakhe esikhohlo amaxesha asixhenxe phambi koYehova.

Kuwo onke amafutha asele esandlani sakhe, umbingeleli uya kuwubeka emlonyeni wendlebe yakhe esekunene, nakwimpumlo yesandla sakhe esikunene, nakwimpumlo yentloko yakhe esekunene, phezu kwegazi lesonka sokubulala.
Eyona mafutha asele emlonyeni wakhe, umbingeleli uya kuwubeka phezu kwentloko yomntu ococekileyo; ngoko ke umbingeleli uya kumlungisa kuye uThixo phambi koYehova.
Ke yena umbingeleli uya kunikela idini lesono, ukuze ayenze intliziyo yakhe ibe yinyaniso phambi koThixo ngenxa yokunqula kwayo; emva koko abulala idini eliqhutywa limlilo.
Umbingeleli uya kunikela idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, nedini lesonka, phezu kwesibingelelo; ngoko umbingeleli uya kumlungisa phambi koNdikhoyo, aze acoceke.

Ke kaloku, ukuba ungumfazi, akakwazi ukunikela ngazo zonke ezi zinto, athabathe inkunzi yebhokhwe enye ibe ngumnikelo wokubulala, ukuze iqhutywe, aze amlungisa phambi koThixo wakhe, kunye nenani elimalunga neshumi elinanye lesilivere lomgubo omuncu oxutywe neoli, ibe ngumnikelo wesonka, kunye nenani elingaphezu kwesihlanu selitha yeoli.
Athabathe neentyatyambo ezibini, okanye iintyatyambo ezincinci ezibini, ngokwento akwaziyo ukuyifumana; enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, enye ibe ngumnikelo womlilo.
Ngomhla wesibhozo uya kuzizisa kumbingeleli, emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana, phambi koYehova, ukuze ahlanzeke.
Umbingeleli uya kuthatha inkunzi yenkomo yesonka esiphelelwe lityala, neoli yayo, ayisandise phambi koYehova njengesonka esiphelelwe lixesha.

Uyasibulala isibeleko sesonka esingenasono, athathe igazi layo, alisifake emngxunyeni wendlebe ekunene yomntu ococekileyo, nomnwe omkhulu wesandla sakhe esingenanto, nomnwe omkhulu wenyawo lakhe elingenanto.
Umbingeleli uya kutywina ioli leyo emlonyeni wesandla sakhe esikhohlo.
Wathi umbingeleli, ngesandla sakhe sokunene, athabathe ioli ekwisandla sakhe sasekhohlo, aze ayityhefe izixhenxe phambi koYehova.

Wathi ke umbingeleli, esuka kwioli esesandlani sakhe, ayifake emlonyeni wendlebe yakhe ekunene, nakwimbonakalo yesandla sakhe esikunene, nakwimbonakalo yenyawo lakhe elisekunene, endaweni yegazi lesonka sokubulala.
Okuseleyo kweoyile esesandlani sakhe, umbingeleli uya kulibeka phezu kwentloko yomntu ococekileyo, ukuze amlungisa kuThixo phambi koYehova.
Ke kaloku uya kuzinikela iintaka-mpuma, okanye iintlanzi-mpuma ezincinci, nantoni na enokuyenza intliziyo yakhe;
enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, nenye ibe ngumnikelo womlilo, kunye nomnikelo wesonka; ngoko ke umbingeleli uya kumlungisa umntu phambi koThixo phambi koYehova.
Lo ngumfundiso yomntu onesifo solusu esibuhlungu, ongakwazi ukuhlawula iindleko eziqhelekileyo zokucoceka.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses noAron, wathi,
Xa nifike ezweni laseKanan, endinika lona ukuba libe likhaya lenu, ndiya kubeka iintsholongwane kwindlu kuloo lizwe.
Ke yena umnini wendlu uya kungena, athethe kumbingeleli, esithi, Ndibona into efana ne-mollusk endlwini yam.
Ke yena umbingeleli, phambi kokuba afike ajonge iintsholongwane, kufuneka athethe ukuba le ndlu igqunywe, ukuze akukho nto ingabi yinkunkuma kuyo; ke ngoko umbingeleli uya kungena ajonge le ndlu.
Uya kuyijonga iintsholongwane; ukuba zikwizinto ezingaphakathi, zibe ngamaqhekeza aluhlaza, okanye amnyama, abonakala phantsi komgangatho wezinto ezingaphakathi,
umbingeleli uya kuphuma emngxunyeni wendlu, ayivale imihla esixhenxe.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe uya kubuyela umbingeleli, aze ajonge; ukuba iintsholongwane zisasazeke ngaphaya kweendonga,
ke umbingeleli uya kuthetha ukuba bathabathe iithayile ezinomkhuhlane, zithunyelwe kwindawo engcolileyo ngaphandle komzi.
Uya kwenza ukuba iintonga zangaphakathi zendlu zixutywe ngazo zonke iindawo; nelitye elixutywe ngaso lithunyelwe kwindawo engalunganga, ngaphandle komzi.
Bathi ke bathathe ezinye iithayile, bazifake endaweni yazo ezidala, basebenzise udonga olutsha ukugubungela indlu.
Ukuba iintsholongwane ziye zabuya, ziphuma endlwini, emva kokuba izityalo zisuswe, nendlu isetshelelwe, ibe yitywina,
uya kungena umbingeleli, ajonge; ukuba iintsholongwane zithe zasasazeka endlwini, yimifuno enobungozi; indlu iya kuba yinkunkuma.
Iya kuqhutywa, iithayile zayo, nemithi yayo, nodongwe lwayo lonke; iya kuthunyelwa ngaphandle komzi, iye kwindawo enobungozi.
Wonke umntu oza kungena endlwini, ngelixa livalwe, uya kuba unqulo kude kube semini.
Nabani na olala, nabani na odla endlwini leyo, kufuneka ahlamba iimpahla zakhe.

Ke kaloku, ukuba unyana kambingeleli engene, ajonge, ukuba iintsholongwane azisasazi, emva kokuba ikhaya ligqityiwe, yena unyana kambingeleli uya kuyithi le ndlu iyingcwele; kuba intsholongwane iyeka.
Athabathe iintaka ezimbini, nokhuni lweediliya, nentambo emnyama, ne-hysop, ukuze ahlanze indlu.
Uya kubulala intaka enye phezu kwamanzi acocekileyo aphumayo kwisitya somthi.
Uya kuthatha imithi yesedari, ne-ysop, nentsimbi engenasici, nomntwana ophilayo; uya kuzitshisa ezi zinto kwigazi lomntwana ofileyo, namanzi acocekileyo, aze ayitshise indlu amaxesha asixhenxe.
Uya kusonwabisa indlu ngegazi lentaka, namanzi acocekileyo, nenyama yentaka ephilayo, nokhuni lweediliya, ne-ysop, nentambo emnyama.
Ke kaloku ayeke iintaka eziphilayo zihambe ngaphandle komzi, zibe ngaphaya komhlaba; ngoko ke uya kuyilungisa le ndlu, ibe yingcwele.
Lo ngumfundiso yezo zonke iintlobo zezifo ezibi zesikhumba, neentlungu zokuthamba,
i-mold kwimpahla okanye endlwini,
kunye neentlungu, iintsholongwane, okanye amabala akhanyayo.
Ifundisa ukuba yintoni engalunganga, nokuba yintoni ecocekileyo. Le yimfundiso malunga nezifo ezibi zesikhumba kunye ne-mollusk.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses noAron, wathi,
Uthi ke iNkosi kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Xa umntu ephuma emlonyeni wakhe umchamo, lo mchamo uya kuba ngumngcipheko kuye.
Ukuba udaka lwakhe luya kuphuma, nokuba luya kuhlala liphuma, lo mntu uya kuba mnyama; le nto iyenza abe mnyama.
Yonke ibhedi ahlala kuyo iya kuba yinyani; yonke into ahlala kuyo iya kuba yinyani.
Wonke lowo utshisa ibhedi yakhe, uya kuzihlamba izihlangu zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, aze abe mncipha kude kube semini.
Wonke umntu ohlala phezulu kwinto ebekwe kuyo lowo ungcolileyo, uya kuzihlamba iimpahla zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, aze abe mnciphiswe de kube semini.
Wonke lowo utshisa umphefumlo wakhe uya kuzihlamba iimpahla zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, aze abe mnciphiso de kube semini.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umntu onesifo sokuphuma kwegazi ephuca phezu komntu ococekileyo, lo mntu uya kuhlamba iimpahla zakhe, ahlamba ngamanzi, aze abe mnciphiswe kude kube semini.
Nasiphi na isithuthi esiqhutywa ngumntu, singcolile.

Wonke umntu otshisa nantoni na ebekwe phantsi kwakhe, uya kuba mnciphisi kude kube semini; lowo uzithabathayo ezo zinto uya kuzihlamba iimpahla zakhe, ahlamba amanzi, aze abe mnciphisi de kube semini.
Nabani na owutshisa wona loo mntu, ngaphandle kokuhlamba izandla zakhe ngamanzi, uya kuzihlamba izihlangu zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, aze abe mncipha kude kube semini.
Ibhotile yomhlaba umntu oyisebenzisayo kufuneka iqhutywe, kwaye nayiphi na ibhotile yemithi kufuneka icocwe ngamanzi.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu ephiliswe emlonyeni wakhe, uya kubala iintsuku ezisixhenxe zokucoceka kwakhe; ahlamba iimpahla zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi aphumayo, aze abe mhle.
Ngomhla wesibhozo uya kuthatha iintaka ezibini, okanye iintlanzi ezincinci ezimbini, aze afike emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana phambi koYehova, azinike kumbingeleli.
Umbingeleli uya kunikela omnye njengomnikelo wesono, nenye ibe ngumnikelo womlilo; ngoko ke umbingeleli uya kumlungisa phambi koYehova ngenxa yokuphuma kwakhe.
Umfazi, xa ephuma khona isisu sakhe, uya kuhlamba umzimba wakhe wonke ngamanzi, aze abe mnciphiso kude kube semini.
Yonke impahla, nokuba yisikhumba, apho kukho isiqhamo kuso, iya kuhlanjwa ngamanzi, ibe yinqambi kude kube semini.
Xa umfazi nowesifazane bethabathelana, ibe kuphuma imbewu yabo, baya kuhlamba ngamanzi, babe namalungisa de kube sebusuku.
Umfazi, xa ephuma khona igazi lakhe, uya kuba mnyama iintsuku ezisixhenxe. Wonke umntu owutshisa uya kuba mnyama de kube semini.
Yonke into ahlala kuyo, ngexesha lokuphuma kwegazi lakhe, iya kuba yinyani; yonke into ahlala kuyo, iya kuba yinyani.
Wonke lowo utshisa ibhedi yakhe, uya kuhlamba izihlangu zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, aze abe mnciphiso de kube semini.
Wonke umntu otshisa nantoni na ehlala phezu kwayo, uya kuzihlamba iimpahla zakhe, ahlamba ngamanzi, aze abe mncipha kude kube semini.
nokuba yibhedi yakhe, nokuba yintoni na ahlala kuyo; wonke lowo utshisa loo nto, uya kuba mncipha kude kube kusasa.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu ehlala naye, igazi lakhe lithi lifike kuye, uya kuba mncipha iintsuku ezisixhenxe; nasiphi na isibhedlele ahlala kuso siya kuba sincinane.

Xa umfazi ephuma igazi lakhe iintsuku ezininzi ngaphandle kwexesha lokuphuma kwakhe, okanye xa liphuma ngaphezu kwexesha lokuphuma kwakhe, kuzo zonke iintsuku zokuphuma kwakhe uya kuba mncipha, njengokuba ephumayo ngexesha lokuphuma kwakhe.
Yonke ibhedi ahlala kuyo, xa ephuma khona, iya kuba yinyani, njengebhedi yakhe yexesha lakhe lokuphuma; nantoni na ahlala kuyo, iya kuba yinyani, njengexesha lakhe lokungena.
Wonke umntu onqumlayo ezi zinto, uya kuba mncipha; uya kuzihlamba iimpahla zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, aze abe mncipha kude kube semini.
Ke kaloku, xa ephiliswe ukuphuma kwakhe, uya kubala iintsuku ezisixhenxe; emva koko uya kucoceka.
Ngomhla wesibhozo athabathe iintaka ezibini, okanye iintombi ezimbini zeentaka, aziveze kumbingeleli, emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana.
Umbingeleli uya kunikela omnye njengomnqophiso wesono, omnye ube ngumnqophiso womlilo; ngoko ke umbingeleli uya kumlungisa phambi koYehova ngenxa yobubi bokuphuma kwakhe.
Nizikhusele ke oonyana bakaSirayeli ekufumaneni inkanuko yabo, ukuze bangafa, xa beyenza inkanuko indlu yam engcwele, itabernakele ephakathi kwabo. ê
Lo ngumthetho womntu ophuma emlonyeni wakhe, nomntu ongcolileyo ngenxa yokuphuma komchamo wakhe;
nowesifazane, xa ephelelwa yinyanga yakhe; nomfazi, okanye umfazi, ophumayo emlonyeni wakhe; nomfazi, nalowo uhamba nomkakhe, xa engcolileyo.
Wathetha ke iNkosi kuMoses, emva kokufa koonyana ababini bakaAron, abafileyo xa befikela phambi koYehova.

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Utsho noAron, umzalwana wakho, ukuba angangeni mihla le kwindawo engcwele kakhulu, ngasemva kwetayile, phambi kophahla lwesiqwenga somnqophiso, ukuze aphile; ngokuba ndiya kubakho emlilweni phezu kophahla.
Kunjalo ke uAron oza kungena kwindawo engcwele, enonyana omncinci wenkomo, ibe ngumnikelo wesono, nenkunzi yebhokhwe, ibe ngumnikelo womlilo.

Uya kugqoka ibhanti elingcwele lelinen,phambi kokuba agqoke iinwele eziphantsi zelinen phezu komphefumlo wakhe; uya kubamba umgca welinen emqolo wakhe, uyasibeka isibuko selinen ebusweni bakhe; ziingubo ezingcwele ezi. Uza kuhlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, aze azigqoke.
Kuhlanga lwakwaSirayeli athabathe iinkunzi zeegusha ezimbini, zibe ngumnikelo wesono, nemvunye enye ibe ngumnikelo womlilo.
Ke uAron uya kuyilungiselela inkunzi yenkomo, ibe yidini lesono lakhe, ukuze alungise yena nosapho lwakhe phambi koThixo.
Uya kuzithabatha iinkunzi zebhokhwe ezibini, azibeke phambi koYehova, emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana.
Athabathe iinqununu ezibini zebhokhwe; inqunu enye ibe nguYehova, nenye ibe ngubhokhwe oza kuthuthwa.
UAron ke uya kuzisa inkunzi yebhokhwe, ekhethiweyo ngesazela kuYehova, ayilungiselele ibe lidini lesono.

Ke kaloku ibhokhwe ethe yathathwa ngesazela, ukuba iqhutywe, iya kubekwa iphila phambi koYehova; iza kusetyenziswa ukusindisa abantu kuye uThixo, ibe yibhokhwe yokuthwala intlungu, ukuze iqhutywe emlilweni.
UAron ke uya kuzisa inkunzi yenkomo yesonka sakhe sesono, ukuze alungise yena nosapho lwakhe phambi koYehova; aze afile inkunzi yenkomo yesonka sakhe sesono.

Uya kuthatha isitya esigcwele iinkuni ezifudumeleyo, ezisuka kwisibingelelo esingaphambili kukaYehova, nezandla zakhe ezimbini ezigcwele uvumba olumnandi oluthambileyo, aze alizifake ngaphakathi komthi.isiqithi.
Uya kuzibeka iinkunzi zeenkomo emlilweni phambi koYehova, ukuze ifuthe lenkunzi yenkomo ligubungele isikhuselo esiphezulu sebhokisi yomnqophiso; aze afile.

Uya kuthatha igazi lenkunzi yebhokhwe, alilitshisa ngesandla sakhe phezu kwecala elingaphambili lesikhuselo, ecaleni lasempumalanga; uyasitshisa negazi ngesandla sakhe amaxesha asixhenxe phambi kwesikhuselo.

Uya kuyibulala ibhokhwe yesonka sesono sabaphandi, ayiselise igazi layo ngasemva kwesitayile; ayenze negazi lebhokhwe njengokuba akwenzele igazi lenkomo, alilitshise phezu komgquba, nangaphambili komgquba.

Uya kwenza njalo, aze alungise indawo engcwele kakhulu phambi koYehova, ngenxa yezinto ezingcolileyo zabantwana bakaSirayeli, ngenxa yobulungisa babo kuzo zonke iinkolelo zabo; naye uya kwenza njalo kwitentile yokuhlangana, ebekwe phakathi kwabo phakathi kwezinto ezingcolileyo zabo.
Akuyi kubakho mntu othile endlwini yokuhlangana,phambi kokuba uAron afike, ukuba alungiselele indawo engcwele kakhulu, kuze aphume; aze alungiselele yena nosapho lwakhe, nebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli.
Waza waphuma waya kwisibingelelo esibekwe phambi koYehova, wayilungisa kuye; wathabatha igazi lenkomo, negazi lebhokhwe, waza walibeka phezu kweendlebe zonke zesibingelelo.
Uya kutywina phezu kwayo ngesandla sakhe, ngale gazi, amaxesha asixhenxe, ukuze ayihlanze, ayenze ingcwele, ezingenakuthelekiswa nanto yabantu bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, xa egqibile ukwenza indawo engcwele kakhulu, netentile yokuhlangana, nesibingelelo esibekwe phambi koThixo, athabathe ibhokhwe ephilayo.

UAron uya kuzibeka izandla zakhe zombini phezu kwentloko yebhokhwe ephilayo, aze acacise phezu kwayo zonke izimangalo zabantwana bakaSirayeli, nazo zonke iintlungu zabo, neengxabano zabo; azibeke phezu kwentloko yebhokhwe, ayiselise ibhokhwe entlango ngesandla somntu olungiselelweyo.
Ibhokhwe iya kuzithabatha zonke iimpazamo zabo phezu kwayo, iye kwindawo efihlakeleyo; lo mntu uya kuyishiya ibhokhwe ihambe emhlabathini.
UAron ke uya kungena kwitentile yokuhlangana, asuse iimpahla zelinen additaneyo, awazigqoka xa efika kwindawo engcwele kakhulu, azibeke khona.

Uya kuhlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi kwindawo engcwele, agqoke iimpahla zakhe eziqhelekileyo, aze aphume; alungiselele umnikelo wakhe womlilo, nomnikelo wabo bonke abantu, ukuze enze isigwebo sakhe, nesigwebo sabantu, phambi koThixo.
Uyamcinezela utywala lwesonka sesono kwisibingelelo.
Lo mntu uthathayo inkunzi yebhokhwe ezweni elingenanto, kufuneka ahlamba iimpahla zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi; emva koko angabuyela emkhosini.

Inkunzi yenkomo, nebhokhwe yomnikelo wesono, igazi labo lafakwa endlwini engcwele kakhulu, ukuze kwenziwe ulungisa phakathi kwazo, kufuneka lithunyelwe ngaphandle komzi-ndlu; amathambo azo, nemifuno yawo, nenkunkuma yawo, kufuneka iqhutywe ngomlilo.
Ke yena oza kuzitshisa, uya kuhlamba izihlangu zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi; emva koko angaphuma ekungeneni emzini.

Le nto ibe ngumthetho kuni ngonaphakade: kule nyanga yesixhenxe, ngemini yeshumi yenyanga, nizibekele isonka, ningasebenzi msebenzi onke, nabani na ozalwa kuloo mhlaba, nabani na ohlala phakathi kwenu.
Kuba ngaloo mini niza kuthotywa phambi koYehova, nize nicocwe; kuzo zonke izono zenu phambi koYehova nizococwa.
Intlanganiso yenkcubeko, intlanganiso yeentlanga, intlanganiso yeentlanga, yintlanganiso yeentlanga. Kuye kube ngumthetho wemihla ngemihla.
Ke yena umbingeleli otywinwe, owabekwa endaweni yoyise, uya kwenza uxolo phakathi kwabantu noThixo; agqoke iimpahla zelinen, iingubo ezingcwele.
Uya kuzilungisa izinto ezingcwele kakhulu, netentile yokuhlangana, nesibingelelo; uya kuzilungisa oombingeleli, naba bantu bonke bebandla, uThixo.
Le nto imele ibe ngumthetho kuni ophakamileyo, ukuba nizilungisa iintsapho zakwaSirayeli ngazo zonke iziphoso zabo, kube kanye ngonyaka. Yathi loo nto, njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho uNdikhoyo kuMoses, uthi kuAron noonyana bakhe bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli: Nithi kubo le nto umyalelo kaYehova wamwiselayo,
Wonke umSirayeli obulala inkunzi yenkomo, okanye unyana womntwana, okanye ibhokhwe, ngaphakathi emkhosini nangaphandle komkhosi;

angazikhokelela emngxunyeni wetentyatyambo yokuhlangana, ukuba ayinikezele ibe ngumnikelo kuYehova phambi kwentyatyambo yakhe engcwele; lo mntu unetyala lokutywina igazi; utyhile igazi; elo lizwi liya kususwa phakathi kwabantu bakhe.

Ke kaloku abantwana bakaSirayeli baya kuzizisa kuYehova iinkomo zabo tu, abazibulalayo emaphandleni; baya kuzizisa kubo umbingeleli emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana, bazenza zibe ziintyatyambo zoxolo kuYehova.
Umbingeleli uya kutywina igazi phezu kwesibingelelo sikaYehova, esisemnyango wetente yokuhlangana; uyamcinezela umgubo wayo, ibe ngumphunga omnandi kuYehova.
Akuyi kuqhubeka benikela iinkomo zabo kwiibhokhwe, abazilandelela ngazo njengendoda enobuxoki; ibe ngumthetho wexesha eliphakamileyo kubo, kuzo zonke iintlanga zabo ezizayo.
I-Israeli, okanye ilizwe elikhoyo phakathi kwethu, elibizwa ngokuba yi-Israeli, okanye ilizwe elikhoyo phakathi kwethu.
angazithabatha zifike emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana, ukuze azinikezele kuYehova, lo mntu uya kususwa phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Nabani na osuka kumaSirayeli, nabani na ohlala phakathi kwabo, edla igazi naliphi na igazi; ndiya kujongana nalo mntu, ndimqulethe phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Kuba umphefumlo wenyama ephilayo ukwigazi. Ndininike igazi phezu kwesibingelelo, ukuze ndinilungise kum; kuba ligazi elilungisa umntu phambi koThixo, ngenxa yokuba yimpilo.
Yiyo loo nto ndithi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, Akukho mntu kuni oza kulila igazi; nalowo uhlala phakathi kwenu, akukho namnye oza kulila igazi.
Ke kaloku, ukuba nabani na phakathi kwabaSirayeli, nokuba ngumkhenkce ohlala phakathi kwabo, athabathe intaka, okanye ikati, edlakayo, aze ayiphule igazi layo, alisigubungele ngothuli.

Kuba umphefumlo wenyama yonke yigazi layo; ngokophulwa koko ndathi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, Musani ukutya igazi lenyama nantoni na; kuba umphefumlo wenyama yonke yigazi layo; lowo uyidla uya kususwa.

Wonke umntu, nokuba ungumntu ozalwa kuloo mhlaba, nokuba ungumhlali ezweni elingaphandle, odla inyama yezinto eziphilayo ezifileyo, okanye ezifayo, uya kuzihlamba izihlangu zakhe, aza kuhlambela emanzini; aze abe mnciphisi kude kube semini; emva koko aphele.
Ke kaloku, ukuba angazihlamba izihlangu zakhe, angazihlambela umzimba wakhe, uya kuba netyala.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Uthethe kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo, Ndiye iNkosi uThixo wenu.
Musani kuhamba ngendlela abayenzayo eYiputa, apho nihlala khona; musani kuhamba ngendlela abayenzayo ezweni laseKanan, apho ndiza kunizisa khona; musani ukwenza ngokwemimiselo yabo.
Nizigcine imithetho yam, niyigcine imimiselo yam, niyenze. Ndiye iNkosi uThixo wenu.
Gcinani imimiselo yam, nemimiselo yam; umntu oyenzayo uya kuziphila ngazo. Ndiye iNkosi.
Akukho namnye kuni oza kuthelekiswa nomhlobo wakhe, ukuba abe nesondo naye. NdinguYehova.
Musa ukuxhaphaza utata wakho, ukubala umyeni wakho; ngumama wakho; musa ukubala umyeni wakhe.
Umfazi kayise wakho, awuyi kudibana naye; kuba oko kwenza ukuba ubaba wakho athandeke.
Udade wakho, nokuba yindodana yoyise, nokuba yindodana yomyeni wakho, nokuba wazalwa endlwini yakho, nokuba wazalwa kwelinye ilizwe, awuyi kuvula ubuso bakhe.
Umfazi wonyana wakho, okanye umfazi wenkosikazi yakho, awuyi kutyhila ubufazi bayo; kuba iyakuba yinkanuko.
Unyana womfazi kayise wakho, ozalwa nguyise wakho, awuyi kuwuvula ubuso bakhe; ungudade wakho.
Udade kayise wakho, udade wenkosikazi yakho, musa ukuwuvula umlomo wakhe; ungumzalwana woyise.
Umama womyeni wakho, udade wakhe, musa ukuwubona umlomo wakhe; ungumzalwana womyeni wakho.
Udade kayise wakho awuyi kuwuphazamisa, ufike kumyeni wakhe, ubone iinwele zakhe; ngumamakazi wakho.
Umfazi wenkosikazi yakho, awuyi kutyhila ubuso bayo; yena ngumfazi wonyana wakho; awuyi kutyhila ubuso bakhe.
Umfazi womzalwana wakho, awuyi kuwubona ubuso bakhe; kuba oko kwenza ukuba umzalwana wakho agwebe.
Umfazi nonyana wakhe, awuyi kutyhila ubuso bakhe; unyana wonyana wakhe, okanye intombi yendodana yakhe, awuyi kuyithabatha ukutyhila ubuso bayo; ziintanda zakhe ezisondeleyo; oku kukubi.
Musa ukumnika udade wenkosikazi yakho, ngelixa inkosikazi yakho iphila, ukuba ube ngumthandi wayo, ukuba ubambe umlomo wakhe.
Musa ukungena kumfazi, ukuba nesondo naye, ngexesha leentlungu zakhe, xa engcolileyo.
Musa ukudibana nomyeni womhlobo wakho, ukuze ungabi mnyama ngenxa yakhe.
Mna iNkosi. Musani ukunika nabani na kubantwana bakho, ukuba anikezelwe kuMoloki; musani ukulibazisa igama likaThixo wakho.
Musa ukuthandana nomfazi, njengokuba umntu athandana nomyeni wakhe; kuba oku kubuhlungu.
Akuyi kubakho into ephilayo oza kudibana nayo, ukuze ungabi namanzi ngayo; umfazi akayi kubakho into ephilayo oza kudibana nayo, ukuze angabi namanzi kuyo; le yindlela engalunganga.
Musani ukuba neentlungu ngazo zonke ezi zinto; ngenxa yoko zathi zinetenkelelo izizwe, endizikhuphayo phambi kwenu.
Ke kaloku eli lizwe lalibanjwa, ndathi ndiyihloniphe ngenxa yobulungisa bayo; ilizwe likhuphe abantu bayo, njengokuba umntu evutha.
Nizigcine ke imiyalelo yam, nemimiselo yam; ningaze niyenze nanye yazo zonke ezi zinto zixhaphakileyo, nokuba ungumzalwana ovela ezweni, nokuba ungumkhenkce ohlala phakathi kwenu.
Kuba bonke abahlali baloo mhlaba, ababekhona phambi kwenu, bazenza zonke ezi zinto zibuhlungu; ilizwe lalibanjwa.
Ukuba niyilungisa ilizwe, liya kukutyhila wena, njengokuba yatyhila uhlanga lwangaphambili kwakho.
Wonke umntu owenza nanye yazo zonke ezi zinto zixhaphakileyo, igazi labo liya kususwa phakathi kwabantu bayo.
Gcina ke ngoko imimiselo yam, ukuba ningazisebenzisi nanye yazo zonke iintshukumo ezibi ezenziwe phambi kokufika kwenu; nize mna ndiyigcinele. NdinguYehova uThixo wenu.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, sithi kubo bonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, Nibe bangcwele; kuba mna iNkosi uThixo wenu ndingcwele.
Nceda nikhathalele wonke umntu umzali wakhe noyise, nigcine iintsuku zam zokuphumla. NdinguYehova uThixo wenu.
Musani ukubuyela kwiintombi, nize ningabi nemifanekiso eqingqiweyo yezithixo; mna nguYehova uThixo wenu.
Xa ninika umnikelo woxolo kuYehova, niwunikezele ngendlela efanelekileyo, ukuze ibe yimfuneko kuwe.
Yadlalwe ngaloo mini niyinikela ngayo, okanye ngomhla olandelayo; nantoni na eyonakalisayo ukuya mhla wesithathu, iqhutywe emlilweni.
Ukuba kukho into edlalwe ngaloo mini yesithathu, iya kuba yinto engalunganga; ayiyi kuvunyelwa.
Yonke into eyileleyo iya kuthwala intlungu, ngokuba isenza izinto ezingcwele zikaYehova zibe zingenanto; lo mntu uya kususwa phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Ke kaloku, xa nithe niqokelela imbewu yelizwe lakho, musa ukuqokelela kude kugqitywe isiphelo somhlaba wakho; ungabuyeli ukuba uthabathe iziqhamo ezibiweyo.
Mna ndinguYehova uThixo wenu. Musa ukutshisa ivini lakho, mna ndinguYehova uThixo wenu.
Musani ukutshisa, musani ukuthetha ubuxoki, musani ukuxhaphaza omnye komnye.
Musani kwenza isibingelelo esikhohlakeleyo ngegama lam, ukuze niyihloniphe igama loThixo wakho. Ndiye iNkosi.
Musa ukuxhaphaza umhlobo wakho, ungamrhoxi. Ungayigcina intlawulo yomqeshwa phantsi kwelanga kude kube mhla.
Mna iNkosi. Musa ukumcaphukisa umntu omnyama, ungabeka ngaphambili komkhohlakeleyo nantoni na eyenza ukuba athabathe intlungu; kodwa uya kuxoka uThixo wakho. Ndiye iNkosi.
Musa ukwenza into engafanelekanga, xa u arbitrate; musa ukujonga umfazi, kwaye musa ukujongana nomntu onamandla; arbitrate umhlobo wakho ngokuchanekileyo.
Musa ukuhamba uthetha ubuxoki malunga nabantu bakho; musa ukubeka umphefumlo womhlobo wakho emngciphekweni. Ndiye ndinguYehova.
Musa ukumchukumisa umzalwana wakho entliziyweni yakho; ugweme umhlobo wakho phambi kobuso bakhe, xa ekhohlakele, ukuze ungabi ngumthwalo wesono sakhe.
Musa ukuxolela, ugcine inkanuko kumntu ngamnye ebantwini bakho; thanda umhlobo wakho njengokuba uthanda wena ngokwakho. Ndiye ndinguYehova.

Gcina imigaqo yam. Musa ukuzala iintlobo ezimbini ezahlukeneyo zezinto eziphilayo ngaxeshanye. Musa ukutyala izityalo zakho ngeentlobo ezimbini zeembewu. Musa ugqoka iimpahla ezenziwe ngeentlobo ezimbini zezinto.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu edibana nomkhonzi-bhinqa, ukuba umele umyeni womntu omnye, kodwa angavunywanga, okanye angaqhelekanga, baya kugwetywa; kodwa bangafanga, ngenxa yokuba akazange aqhelekanga.
Umele amnike umbingeleli inkunzi yebhokhwe kuYehova, emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana, ibe lidini lesono.
Umbingeleli uya kumlungisa ngomthi womnquba womnikelo wesono, phambi koYehova, ngenxa yesono sakhe ebesenzayo; idini lakhe liza kuthotywa.
Ke kaloku, nifike kuloo lizwe, nizamile umthi weentyatyambo zezinto zonke, intyatyambo yayo niyigcine ibe yinqaba; ibe yinqaba kuni iminyaka emithathu, ingadlalwa.
Ngomnyaka wesine, zonke iziqhamo zayo ziya kuba zingcwele, zibe ngumnikelo wokubonga iNkosi.
Ngomnyaka wesixhenxe nidla imbewu yayo, ukuze umthi ukhule uze unyuse ubomi bakho. Ndiye iNkosi uThixo wenu.
Musa ukutya nayiphi na inyama enegazi elinokubakho kuyo. Ungasebenzisi izitha okanye uzame ukucinga ngento ezayo.
Musa ukucheba iinwele ezisecaleni kweentloko zakho, okanye ukucheba iziphelo zeenwele zakho.
Musani ukutshisa iinwele zenu, nizixolele izidumbu zenu, nangamachaphaza entolongweni yenu. NdinguYehova.
Musa ukuxhaphaza intombi yakho, uyenze ibe ngubhinqa, ukuze ilizwe lize libe yibhinqa, libe likhululwe lububi.
Zigcineni iintsuku zam zokuphumla, nizihlonele indawo yam engcwele. Ndiye iNkosi.
Musani ukubuyela kulabo bathetha ngezinto eziphilayo, nakwabamangali; musani kungena kubo, ukuba nize ningabi nesono ngazo. Ndiye iNkosi uThixo wenu.
Uya kuhlala phambi kwamadoda amakhulu, uyamhlonela umntu omdala; uya kuxolela uThixo wakho. NdinguYehova.
Xa umntu othile ehlala nawe kwilizwe lakho, musa ukumncina.
Uthixo ohlala nawe, umele abe njengomntu owazalwa phakathi kwenu; uyithande njengokuba uyithanda wena ngokwakho; ngokuba nibe ngathixo ezweni laseYiputa. Ndiye iNkosi uThixo wenu.
Musa ukuxhaphaza xa ulinganisela ubude, ubunzima okanye inani.
Niyisebenzise imilinganiselo ethembekileyo, iziqingatha ezithembekileyo, nezilinganiso ezithembekileyo, ezimanzi namanzi ashushu. Ndiye iNkosi uThixo wenu, wamkhupha eYiputa.
Nizigcine izithembiso zam zonke, nemimiselo yam yonke, niyenze; mna nguYehova.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

Utsho ke uNdikhoyo kuYakobi, uthi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli: Nabani na phakathi kwabaSirayeli, nabani na ohlala ezweni lakwaSirayeli, onika umntwana wakhe kuMoloki, kufuneka afile; abantu belizwe baya kumbulala ngeethayile.
Ndiya kubeka isandla sam kumntu lowo, ndiwucime phakathi kwabantu bakhe; ngenxa yokuba wabeka unyana wakhe kuMoloki, waza wahlambalaza indawo yam engcwele, ukuze anike igama lam elingcwele.
Ke kaloku, ukuba abantu belizwe bajonge ngaphaya, xa lowo mntu enika unyana wakhe kuMoloki, bangawubulalanga;
ndiya kubuyela kumntu lowo, nosapho lwakhe; ndiya kumcima ebantwini bakhe, naye wonke umntu olandela uMoleki, ukuba ahambe phantsi kwesandla sakhe.

Ke kaloku, xa umntu ebhekisa kulabo bathetha ngezinto eziphilayo, nakwabenzi bezimanga, enyanzelisa ubundlobongela kum, alandele kubo; ndiya kubeka isandla sam kuloo mntu, ndimqulethe phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Nizingcwele ke, nibe ngcwele; ngokuba mna nguYehova uThixo wenu.
Gcinani imimiselo yam, niyigcine. Ndiye iNkosi owenza ukuba ningcwele.
Umntu onqula utata wakhe, nokuba ngumama wakhe, kufuneka aphele; unqula utata wakhe, nokuba ngumama wakhe; uya kufa.
Xa umntu eqhawula umtshato nomkakhe, nomkakhe womhlobo wakhe, kufuneka bafa bobabini, amadoda nabafazi.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu edibana nomkakhe kayise, ubeka umnqamlezo kuyise; bobabini baya kufa; ubomi babo buza kuba ngumonakalo kubo.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu edibana nenkosikazi yakhe, baya kufa bonke ababini; bayenze into engalunganga kakhulu; ukufa kwabo kuya kuba ngumonakalo wabo.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu edibana nomntu, njengokuba umntu ehlangana nowesifazane, bobabini basenza into engalunganga; baya kufa ngokuqinisekileyo. Ukufa kwabo kuya kuba ngumngeni wabo.
Ukuba umntu ezala indoda noyise, kulungile; kufuneka aqhutywe emlilweni yena nodade wakhe, ukuze kungabikho okubi phakathi kwenu.
