Xa umntu edibana nenyama yenkomo, kufuneka aphele; nenyama yenkomo ke kufuneka niyibulala.
Xa umfazi esiya kwinyama yenkomo, ukuze ahlangane nayo, ngoko ke mna nomntwana uya kubabulala; baya kufa ngokuqinisekileyo. Ukufa kwabo kuya kuba ngububi babo.

Ke kaloku, xa umntu ethatha udade wakhe, intombi yoyise, okanye intombi yomyeni wakhe, athabathe isibonda sawo, bafumane isibonda sawo; kuyinyani loo nto; baya kuthotywa phambi kwamadoda abo; udade wakhe wafumanisa isibonda sawo; uya kuba nesono.

Ke kaloku, xa umntu edibana nombhiyozo wesifazane ngexesha lokuphuma kwegazi lakhe, ke yena uvule umbhobho wokuphuma kwegazi lakhe, naye uvule umbhobho wegazi lakhe; baya kuqhutywa bobabini phakathi kwabantu babo.
Udade womyeni wakho, okanye udade woyise wakho, musa ukuwubona; kuba oko kuthetha ukuba umfazi othandekayo uya kunyanzeliswa. Bambini baya kuba netyala.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu edibana nomkakhe womyeni wakhe, umkakhe womkakhe ubhaptiziwe; baya kuthabatha isono sabo, baza kufa banganabantwana.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu ebhiyozela umfazi womzalwana wakhe, yinto engalunganga loo nto; umkhonze umzalwana wakhe; bangabi nabantwana.
Gcinani ngoko imimiselo yam yonke, nemimiselo yam yonke, nizisebenzele; ukuze ilizwe endinika lona ukuba lihlale kulo, lingakuxola.
Musani kuhamba ngokwemimiselo yohlanga endiwukhuphayo phambi kwenu; bazenza zonke ezi zinto, ngenxa yoko ndabaxolela.

Ndithi ke kuni, Niyithathe ilizwe labo libe yipropathi yenu; ndiya kukusinika ukuba libe lipropati yenu, ilizwe eliphumayo ubisi nenkukhu. Ndiye mna iNkosi uThixo wenu, owazihlulayo phakathi kwamazwe.

Niyiqonde ke ukuba kukho udidi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ezicocekileyo nezonakalisayo, phakathi kweentlanzi ezicocekileyo nezonakalisayo; ukuze nize ningabi nakuphikisa iimvakalelo zenu ngokudla ngazo zonke izinto eziphilayo, nangazo zonke iintlanzi, nangazo zonke izinto ezihamba phantsi, endizikhethele ukuba zingcolileyo.
Kuba mna, iNkosi, ndingcwele; ndinikhethela phakathi kwezizwe, ukuba nibe ntoni na kum.
Umntu, nokuba ngumfazi na, othetha ngezinto eziphilayo, okanye othetha ngezilingo, kufuneka abulawe; kufuneka abulawe ngamatye; ubomi babo buyingozi kwabo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Unxibelelane nababingeleli, oonyana baka-Aron, uthi kubo: Umbingeleli akayi kwenzakalisa yena ngokwakhe ngokutshisa umntu ofileyo phakathi kwabantu bakhe;
ngaphandle komhlobo wakhe ophakathi, utata wakhe, noyise wakhe, nonyana wakhe, nendodana yakhe, nomyeni wakhe,
okanye udade wakhe ongatshatanga, ohlala ecaleni kwakhe, ngenxa yokuba angatshatanga; ngoko ke yena unokuhlambalaza.
Akuyi kwenzakalisa yena ngokwakhe ngenxa yabantu abathandana nabo, ukuze angabi nelungelo lokwenza umsebenzi ongcwele.
Ababingeleli bangazihlathi iinwele zabo, bangazihlathi iziphelo zeenwele zabo, bangazihlathi iinwele zabo.
Bamele babe ngcwele kuThixo wabo, bangabi nesono igama lakhe; baya kuzinikela izipho eziqhutywa ngamandla zikaYehova, ukutya kukaThixo wabo; ngoko ke bamele babe ipatakatifu.
Umbingeleli akayi kuba nomfazi othile, okanye ongacocekanga, nokuba ngumfazi owaphulwe ngumyeni wakhe; ngokuba umbingeleli ungcwele kuThixo wakhe.
Uya kuba ngumbingeleli kuwe, ngokuba unikela isonka soThixo wakho; ube ngumbingeleli kuni; ngenxa yokuba ndingcwele mna iNkosi owenza ukuba ningabimbi.
Ukuba intombi yombingeleli ibhaptizwa, ibe yibhinqa, ibhaptiza utata wayo; kufuneka aqhutywe ngomlilo.

Umbingeleli omkhulu, othile phakathi kwabazalwana bakhe, owathi ioli yokupheka iqhutywa phezu kwentloko yakhe, waza wabekwa phantsi ukuba agqoke izihlangu zobubingeleli, angazikhuphi iinwele zakhe, angazicaphukisa izihlangu zakhe, ukuze abe neentlungu.
Akuyi kuqhagamshelana nomphefumlo ofileyo; akuyi kwenzakalisa ngokwakhe, nokuba nguyise, nokuba ngunina.
Akuyi kuphuma endlwini engcwele, aze alele, ukuze angabi nesono esingcwele soThixo wakhe; ngokuba ioli yokunqumla uThixo wakhe ikwimbiza yakhe. NdinguYehova.
Owesifazane oza kumnika umtshato kufuneka abe ngumkakhe.
Akuyi kuthatha ibhinqa elibi, okanye ibhinqa elitshatyalalisiweyo, okanye ibhinqa elingacocekanga, okanye ibhinqa elinobuxoki; kufuneka athathe ibhinqa elinobuxoki phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
ukuze angabi nobuxoki kubantwana bakhe phakathi kwabantu bakhe; mna ndinguYehova owenza ukuba abe ngcwele.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho uAron ukuthi, Kuzo zonke iintsuku zakho ezizayo, akukho namnye kubo oonyana bakho, onengxaki emlonyeni wakhe, oza kungena ukunikela isonka sikaThixo wakhe.
Akukho namnye onobungozi emlonyeni wakhe oza kungena; akukho namnye omnyama, okanye othambileyo, okanye oneentloko ezimdaka, okanye eneenwele ezimdaka,
akukho namnye onesandla okanye nenyawo elibi,
akukho mntu unesifuba esithe nkqo okanye oncinci kakhulu, akukho mntu unengxaki yelanga, isifo solusu esichaphazelayo, okanye izilonda, kwaye akukho mntu uneendawo ezifihlakeleyo ezinobungozi.
Akukho mntwana ka-Aron, umbingeleli, unengxaki emlonyeni wakhe, angafika anikezele izipho eziqhutywa ngamandla zikaYehova; kukho ingxaki emlonyeni wakhe, angafika alungiselele ukudla kukaThixo wakhe.
Uya kulula ukutya kukaThixo wakhe, nokutya okungcwele kakhulu, nokudla okungcwele.

Ke kaloku akayi kufutshane nesitayile, akayi kuthelekiswa nesibingelelo; ngokuba kukho intlungu emlonyeni wakhe, ukuze angabi nobulungisa kwiindawo zam ezingcwele; kuba mna ndinguYehova ozenzayo zingcwele.
Wathi ke uMoses loo nto kuAron, noonyana bakhe, kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho kuAron noonyana bakhe, ukuba bagcine izinto ezingcwele zabantwana bakaSirayeli, abazinikelayo kum; ukuze bangabi nesono igama lam elingcwele. Ndiye iNkosi.

Uthi kubo, Kuzo zonke iintsuku zenu ezizayo, ukuba kukho umntu othile phakathi kosapho lwakho, engekho mthethweni, afike kwiimpahla ezingcwele zabaSirayeli, abazinikelayo kuYehova, igazi elo liyakucinywa phambi kwam. NdinguYehova.

Ke kaloku, akukho namnye kubo oonyana baka-Aron onesifo sesikhumba, okanye onesifo sokuphuma emlonyeni wakhe, angadla izinto ezingcwele, de abe ucocekile. Nabani na onqumlayo into echaphazelekayo ngumfileyo, nabani na onesisu esiphumayo,
nokuba ngumntu onqumlayo into ehambayo, eyenza ukuba abe mnyama, nokuba ngumntu owenza ukuba abe mnyama ngandlela-thile;
uya kuba mnyama kude kube semini; angadla nantoni na yezinto ezingcwele, ngaphandle kokuba ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi.
Ke kaloku, xa ilanga liphuma, uya kuba ucocekile; emva koko angadla izinto ezingcwele, ngokuba yinyama yakhe.
Akayi kulila into ephilileyo, okanye ifileyo, ngenxa yokuba iyakuba yingozi kuye. Ndiye iNkosi.
Bagcine ke oombingeleli imimiselo yam, ukuze bangabi nobulungisa, baphile ngenxa yoko. Ndiye mna iNkosi obazingcweleyo.
Akukho namnye ngaphandle kwendlu kambingeleli oza kulila ezi zinto zingcwele; nokuba ngumkhenkce ohlala endlwini kambingeleli, nokuba ngumqeshwa osebenza ngemali, angazidla.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umbingeleli ethengise umkhonzi ngemali yakhe, lo mkhonzi uya kuzidla; nabazalwa endlwini yakhe nabo baya kuzidla isonka sakhe.
Ke kaloku, ukuba intombi yombingeleli itshatile nomntu ongenakuba ngumbingeleli, akayeki ukutya izipho ezikhethwayo zezinto ezingcwele.

Ke kaloku, ukuba unyana wombingeleli ethe waba ngumfazi, okanye ehlelwa, angabi nendodana, abuye aze ahlale endlwini yoyise, njengokuba wayencinci, ke yena angadla isonka soyise; kodwa akukho mntu ongaphandle kwendlu yakhe angadla nantoni na.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu edla isonka esingcwele ngokungaqondiyo, uya kunika umbingeleli isiqingatha saso sesonka esingcwele, aphinde ongeza isiqingatha sesihlanu.
Ababingeleli baya kwenza ukuba zibi izinto ezingcwele zabantwana bakaSirayeli, abazinikelayo kuYehova.
ukuba abantu baya kuzidla, ukuze kubekho ububi kubo; ngokuba mna ndinguYehova obazingcweleyo.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

Utsho uAron, oonyana bakhe, nabazalwana bonke bakaSirayeli, uthi kubo: Wonke umntu waseSirayeli, nokuba ungumkhenkce nakwaSirayeli, anganikela idini eliqhutywa limlilo kuYehova, nokuba ngumnikelo wakhe wesivivinyo, nokuba ngumnikelo wakhe osuka emlonyeni.
Kufuneka ibe yindoda yenkomo, okanye inkunzi yebhokhwe, okanye iinkunzi zeegusha, ingabikho ngxaki kuyo, ukuze ivunyelwe kuni.
Musani ukunikela nantoni na enokubi kuyo; ngokuba ayiyi kuvunyelwa ukuba ibe nani.

Xa umntu enikela umnikelo woxolo kuYehova, osuka kwibhokhwe, okanye osuka kumntwana webhokhwe, ukuze aphumeze idini lakhe, nokuba ngumnikelo wakhe wokunikela ngokukhululekileyo, kufuneka ibe yinyaniso, ukuba ithandeke; akubikho monakalo kuyo.

Musani ukunikela kuYehova inyama emnyama, okanye enqamlezeneyo, okanye enamachaphaza, okanye enezilonda, okanye ineentlungu, okanye eneentsholongwane; musani ukubeka nanye yazo phezu kwesibingelelo, ibe yisonka esiqhutywa ngumlilo kuYehova.

Unako ukunikela inkunzi yenkomo, okanye unyana webhokhwe, enomhlaza omde kakhulu, okanye onomhlaza omncinane kakhulu, njengomnikelo onikezelwa ngokukhululekileyo; kodwa akuyi kuvunyelwa ukuba ikhonjwe.
Musani ukunikela kuYehova inyama ethe yaphuka, okanye iqhutywe, okanye isuswe, okanye isike; musani ukwenza oko ezweni lenu.
Musani ukuzithabatha ezi zinto kumnye umntu, ukuba zibe yimifuno kaThixo wenu; kuba zinomonakalo kuzo, kukho into engalunganga ngazo; aziyi kuvunyelwa kuwe.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

Xa kuzalwa inkunzi yenkomo, okanye inkunzi yebhokhwe, okanye unyana webhokhwe, iya kuba neentsuku ezisixhenxe emntwini wayo; ukususela ngemini yesibhozo nangaphezulu, izakuthandeka njengesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi kuYehova.
Musa ukubulala inkomo okanye iinkunzi zebhokhwe ngosuku olufanayo xa zincinci.
Xa ninika umnikelo wokuthandazela kuYehova, mnikele ngendlela elungileyo, ukuze ibe yimfuneko kuwe.
Yadlalwe ngaloo mini; musa ukushiya nantoni na kuyo kude kube kusasa. Ndiye iNkosi.
Gcinani imimiselo yam, nizigcine. Ndiye ndinguYehova.
Musani kutshabalalisa igama lam elingcwele, ukuze ndibe mngcwele phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli. Ndiye iNkosi owenza ukuba ningcwele;
ndinikhuphe ezweni laseYiputa, ukuba ndibe nguThixo wenu; mna iNkosi.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Balala oonyana bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo, Ezi zimimiselo yam ekhethekileyo, imimiselo kaYehova, oza kuzibiza zibe ziintlanganiso ezingcwele.

Nisebenze iintsuku ezintandathu; kodwa umhla wesixhenxe nguSabbath, usuku lokuphumla olupheleleyo, ingqungquthela engcwele; musa ukwenza nantoni na yomsebenzi; luSabbath kaYehova kuwo onke amakhaya enu.
Ezi ziintsuku ezingcwele zikaYehova, imibhiyozo engcwele, oza kuzibiza ngexesha labo elimiselweyo.
Kwinyanga yokuqala, ngemini yeshumi elinesine lenyanga, iPasha kaYehova iya kuqala ngokuphuma kwelanga.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe wale nyanga, kusuku lweshumi elinesihlanu lwale nyanga, kuya kuba yimikhosi yeentlanzi ezingaphekiweyo kuYehova; nidle iintlanzi ezingaphekiweyo iintsuku ezisibhozo.
Ngomhla wokuqala, kubekho kuni isibingelelo esingcwele; musa ukwenza nantoni na yomsebenzi.
Ngeentsuku ezisixhenxe nilungiselele umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova; ngomhla wesixhenxe kubekho isibingelelo esingcwele; musa ukwenza nantoni na yomsebenzi.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Balala oonyana bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Xa niza kungena ezweni endilininika lona, niyigcinele imbewu yayo, niyiveze kumbingeleli intyatyambo yeentyatyambo zokuqala zembewu yenu.
Waza ke umbingeleli wotyhala loo mqolo phambi koYehova, ukuze ube ngumvuzo kuni; umbingeleli wotyhala loo mqolo ngomhla olandelayo kwesabatha.
Ke kaloku, ngaloo mini niwutshisa ngayo umqulu, nilungiselele inkunzi yenkomo eneminyaka emibini ubudala, ingabikhokobhaka kuyo-ke, ibe yidini eliqhutywa limlilo kuYehova.

Nceda niyinikezele nayo idini lesonka, elimalunga neshumi elinanye lamashekeli, lomgubo omsulwa oxutywe neoli, umnikelo owenziwe ngomlilo kuYehova, wevumba elimnandi; nedini lokusela, elimalunga neshumi elinanye lamashekeli, lewayini.

Musani ukutya isonka, nokuba yingqolowa eyotywe, nokuba yingqolowa ecocekileyo, kude kube ngaloo mini niyinikezele loo nto kuThixo wenu. Lo ngumthetho ohlala ubomi bakho bonke, kuzo zonke izixeko zenu;
Ngomhla olandelayo kwesonka sakusasa, ngomhla apho nizalise khona isiqulatho sengqolowa sokutywina, nibala iintsuku ezisixhenxe ezipheleleyo.
Babala iintsuku ezilishumi elinambini, kuze kube yimini elandelayo yesiSabbathi esixhenxe; ninike umnikelo wesonka sesonka esitsha kuYehova.

Nizithathe ezindlwini zenu iziqholo ezimbini zokutya okuqhutywayo, isiqholo ngasinye silungiselelwe isiqingatha setoni yesonka esilungileyo, siphekwe ngeenyama; zibe ngumnikelo wesono kuYehova, osuka kwinto yokuqala yenkomo yenu.

Nizilungiselele nesonka iinkunzi zeenkomo ezisixhenxe tu, ezineminyaka emibini ubudala, ezingabikho monakalo kuzo, nenkunzi yenkomo encinci enye, neenkunzi zeegusha ezimbini; zibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, kunye nemifuno yayo, namadini abo okusela, idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, livumba elimnandi kuThixo.
Nceda nilungiselele inkunzi yebhokhwe enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, neenkomo ezimbini ezineminyaka elishumi elinambini ubudala zibe zizipho zoxolo.
Umbingeleli uya kuzinyathela ezi nkunzi zeenkomo ezimbini, nesonka sezinto zokuqala, phambi koYehova, zibe ngumnikelo wokuzinyathela; zingcwele kuYehova, ziya kuba ziye kumbingeleli.
Ke kaloku, ngaloo mini, niza kubhengeza isibingelelo esingcwele; musa ukwenza nantoni na yomsebenzi oqhelekileyo. Lo ngumthetho wexesha elide kubo bonke oonyana benu, kuwo onke amakhaya enu.

Ke kaloku, xa nithe nikhulisa imbewu yephondo lenu, musa ukuxhaphaza kude kuphele isiphelo selizwe lakho, ningazikhuphi iziqhamo ezifayo; zinikele kumhlwempu nomkhenkce. Ndiye ndinguYehova uThixo wenu.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Balala oonyana bakaSirayeli, usithi, Kwinyanga yesixhenxe, ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga, kufuneka kubekho kuni isigqibo esingcwele, ingqungquthela engcwele, ukukhumbula ngokuphuka kweebhokhwe.
Musani ukwenza inkonzo eqhubekayo, ninike umnikelo owenziwe ngomlilo kuYehova.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Ngomhla wesixhenxe wale nyanga yesixhenxe, ngumhla wokuphiliswa, usuku lokuzilungisa; nibe nengqungquthela engcwele, nize nidle, ninike idini eliqhutywa ngamlilo kuYehova.
Musani ukwenza nantoni na yomsebenzi ngaloo mini; ngokuba ngumhla wokuphiliswa, ukuba nilungiswe kuYehova uThixo wenu.
Wonke umntu oza kuhlala engapheki ngaloo mini, lo mntu uya kususwa phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Yonke into eyenza inkonzo nantoni na ngaloo mini, ndiya kuyicima phakathi kwabantu bayo.
Musani ukwenza nantoni na yomsebenzi. Lo ngumthetho wexesha elide kubo bonke oonyana benu, kuwo onke amakhaya enu.
Kuye kube yintlanganiso yeSabbath yokuphumla kwenu, nize ningadli nantoni na; ukususela ngemini yesithoba yenyanga, ngobusuku bemini, niyigcine le ntlanganiso.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Balala oonyana bakaSirayeli, usithi, Ngomhla wesixhenxe wale nyanga yesixhenxe, ngomhla weshumi elinesihlanu wonyaka, kuya kubakho isikhumbuzo seentyatyambo kuYehova, imihla esixhenxe.
Ngomhla wokuqala, kubekho kuni isibingelelo esingcwele; musa ukwenza nantoni na yomsebenzi.

Kwiintsuku ezisixhenxe ninikele umnikelo womlilo kuYehova; ngomhla wesibhozo kubekho isibingelelo esingcwele, ninikele umnikelo womlilo kuYehova. Kuyintlanganiso ekhethekileyo; ningasebenzi msebenzi othile.

Ezi ziintsuku ezingcwele zikaYehova, oza kuzibiza zibe yimibhiyozo engcwele; nizinikezele kuzo izipho ezenziwe ngomlilo kuYehova: izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zesonka, nezibingelelo zokutya, nezibingelelo zokusela, imihla ngemihla.
Ezi zinto zingaphezulu kwezigqibelo zikaYehova, nakwiimpendulo zenu, nazo zonke izibingelelo zenu, nazo zonke iminikelo yenu esuka entliziyweni, nizinikezele kuThixo.

Ngomhla weshumi elinesihlanu wenyanga yesixhenxe, emva kokuba nigqibile ukulungiselela imbewu yelizwe, zinikele kuYehova iintsuku ezisixhenxe. Usuku lokuqala lusuku lokuphumla; usuku lwesibhozo lusuku lokuphumla.

Ngomhla wokuqala nizithathe iziqhamo ezilungileyo zezityalo, iintyatyambo zetafile, neentyatyambo ezibomvu, nezityalo zesiqhamo esiphuma emlanjeni; nibhiyozeleni ngothando phambi koYehova uThixo wenu iintsuku ezisibhozo.
Niyigcine ibe yimikhosi kuYehova, imihla esixhenxe ngonyaka ngamnye; ibe ngumthetho ophakamileyo kubo bonke oonyana benu. Kwinyanga yesixhenxe niyigcine.
Nihlale ezingxoweni iintsuku ezisixhenxe. Wonke umntu ozalwa eSirayeli ahlale ezingxoweni,
ukuze bakwazi oonyana benu emva kwenu, ukuba ndibamise oonyana bakaSirayeli behlala ezibhedleleni, xa ndabakhupha eYiputa. Ndiye iNkosi uThixo wenuipateni.
Wathetha ke uMoses kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli ngezi ntlanganiso zoYehova.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Uthi ke uMoses kuYakobi noYakobi unyana kaSirayeli, Utsho iNkosi uThixouThixo wakho, Yibakho ioli yeoli yeoli ecocekileyo, eyenziwe ngeoyile yeoli yeoli.

Kwitentile yokuhlangana, ngaphandle komgca ongaphambili kwebhokisi yomnqophiso, uAron uya kuzimisa izibane phambi koYehova, ukusukela kusasa ukuya emveni kwemini, ngokuqhubekayo; ibe ngumthetho wexesha elide kuwo onke amaqela enu.
Uya kuzilungisa izibane ezikwindawo yokukhanya yegolide ecocekileyo, zihlale zihamba phambi koYehova.
Nceda uthathe isonka esilungileyo, uyeke izitya ezilishumi elinambini, uzisebenzisela isidlo ngasinye isiqingatha setoni yesonka.
Yazibeka emqolobini, zibe zisithandathu kumqolo ngamnye, phezu kwetafile yegolide ecocekileyo phambi koYehova.
Uza kuyibeka ifuthe elicocekileyo kumgca ngamnye; ibe yinxalenye yokumbulo lwesonka, ibe ngumnikelo owenziwe ngomlilo kuYehova.
Ngosuku ngalunye lwesabatha kufuneka kubekwe umnikelo wokudla phambi koYehova, ngokuqhubekayo; ngumthetho ophakamileyo kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Le nto imele ibe nguAron nonyana bakhe; baya kuyidla endaweni engcwele; iyinto engcwele kakhulu, yezona zinto zinikezelwa ngomlilo kuYehova, lilungelo labo elihlala ixesha elide.
Ke kaloku kwabakho umntu, uyise wabaSirayeli, uyise wabaYiputa; waphuma ke phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; kwaqala ukungqubana emkhosini phakathi kwakhe nomfazi wesiSirayeli.
Wathetha ke unyana wale ndoda yaseSirayeli igama elingcwele likaYehova, waphulaphula. Baye bamthabatha kuye uMoses; igama lonina lalinguShelomithi, intombi kaDibri, wesizwe sikaDan.
Ke kaloku bamisa emgceni, de iNkosi awazise into abamele bayiyenze.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yikhuphe ngaphandle komzi-ndlu lo mprofeti; bonke abawuvayo babeke izandla zabo phezu kweentloko zakhe, inkundla yonke ibe ngumthi.
Uthi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli: Wonke umntu ophulaphulela uThixo wakhe, uya kuthatha isono sakhe.
Nabani na othetha ngegama likaYehova, kufuneka aphele; ibandla lonke limele ligweme ngamatye; nokuba ungumkhenkethi, nokuba ungumzalwana womhlaba, ukuba uthetha ngegama likaThixo, kufuneka afile.
Wonke umntu obulala omnye umntu kufuneka abulawa.
Nabani na obulala ikati yomnye umntu kufuneka ayibuyisele, ubomi ngobomi.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu ebulala umhlobo wakhe, kufuneka kwenzeke kuye njengokuba wenzayo yena;
ithambo elibi ngethambo elibi, iliso ngeliso, intloko ngentloko; nokuba yintoni na intlungu awayeyenzayo,kobenze ngayo-ke, kufuneka kwenziwe kuye.
Nabani na obulala inkomo, kufuneka ayibuyisele; kodwa nabani na obulala umntu, kufuneka aphele.
Umthetho owodwa umele ube kuwe, nokuba ungumkhenkce nakuba ungumzalwana; mna nguYehova uThixo wenu.

Wathetha ke uMoses kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli; bathabathela loo mntu waphulaphulelayo ngaphandle komzi-ndlu, bamwisela amatye, waza wafa. Bawenza oonyana bakaSirayeli njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo uMoses.
Wathetha ke iNkosi kuMoses emnqamlezweni kaSina, esithi,
Balala oonyana bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Xa niza kungena ezweni endilininika lona, eli lizwe liya kuphumla, ligcine isigqibo sikaYehova.
Iminyaka emithandathu uya kutyala izityalo zakho, uthabathe izityalo zakho zewayini, ugcine imbewu yazo.

Ke kaloku lo nyaka wesixhenxe umele ube yiSabhati yoxolo olupheleleyo lwelizwe, ibe yiSabhati kaYehova; musa ukutyala izityalo zakho kuloo minyaka ilishumi elinambini, nize nizigwebe izityalo zewayini zakho.
Musa ukuvuna into ekhulayo ngokuzenzekelayo, ungazikhuphi iziqhamo zezityalo zakho zewayini ezingenakutywinwa; ngunyaka woxolo olupheleleyo lwelizwe.
Yonke into ekhulisayo ilizwe kwisabatha layo, iya kuba yintsapho yenu yonke; kuni, nomkhonzi wenu, nomkhonzazana wenu, nomqeshwa wakho, nomkhenkce ohlala phakathi kwenu.
Ziye zibe yimifuno yezinto zakho eziphilayo, nezithixo zehlabathi ezweni lakho; zonke izinto zayo ezikhulayo ziya kudla.
Bhala iminyaka yesixhenxe yesonka, iminyaka esixhenxe iphinda-phindwa ngamaxesha asixhenxe; ibe yiminyaka emashumi mane anethoba.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga, ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga, niphucule isidumbu esinamandla; niphucule isidumbu ezweni lenu lonke, ngemini yokuxolelwa.

Niyingcwelele loo minyaka imashumi mahlanu, nikhuphe isibhengezo soxolo kulo lonke elasezweni, kubo bonke abahlali balo; ibe ngumnyaka weJubilee kuni; niya kubuyela ngamnye wenu ezweni leentsapho zakhe, nosapho lwakhe.

Unyaka weshumi elinesihlanu uya kuba ngumnyaka womthendeleko kuni; musa ukutyala, nize ningazikhuphi iziqhamo ezikhulayo ngokuzenzekelayo, nize ningazikhuphi iziqhamo zeentyatyambo zenkomo ezingatyiwa.
Yimini yeJubilee, ibe ngusuku olungcwele kuwe; ukutya kwakho kuzo zonke izinto ezikhulayo ezweni.
Ke kulo nyaka weJubilee, niya kubuyela ngamnye kuni ezweni leentsapho zakhe.
Xa uthengisa ilizwe kumhlobo wakho, okanye uthenga ilizwe kuye, musa ukuxhaphaza omnye komnye.
Ke kaloku, xa uthenga kumhlobo wakho, misela ixabiso lakho ngokwenani leminyaka eyadlulayo kwiJubilee ephelileyo; nanjengoko kuninzi lweentyatyambo eziseleyo, aze amisele ixabiso lakhe.
Ukuba kukho iminyaka emininzi esele ikhona, ixabiso liya phezulu. Ukuba kukho nje iminyaka embalwa esele ikhona, ixabiso liya phantsi. Into athengisayo kuwe yinani leentyatyambo.
Musani ukuxhaphaza omnye komnye, nize nikhathazeke kuThixo wenu; ngokuba mna ndinguYehova uThixo wenu.
Zigcineni izigqibo zam, nizigcine ngokungqongqo imithetho yam; nihlale nikhuselekile kuloo lizwe.
Ilizwe liza kunika imbewu yayo; niya kudla ngokweemfuno zeentliziyo zenu, nihlale khona ngokukhuselekileyo.
Ukuba nithi ke, Sidla ntoni kulo nyaka wesixhenxe, ukuba singatshazi, siyigcine imbewu yethu?
Ndiya kuzisa phezu kwenu ubutyebi bam ngomnyaka wesithandathu, ukuze ilizwe livelise iziqhamo zayo zeminyaka emithathu.
Unyaka wesibhozo, xa niza kulima, niya kuhlala nidla iziqhamo zakudala; kuze kufike isiqhamo sonyaka wesithoba, niya kuhlala nidla iziqhamo zakudala.
Ilizwe alithengiswanga ngonaphakade; ngokuba ilizwe lilungu lam. Niyimihlali, niyimihlali endlwini yam.
Kuzo zonke iindawo zelizwe lakho, kufuneka uvumele ukuba lithengiswe kwakhona.
Ukuba umntu uya kuba ngumfazi phakathi kwakho, aze athengise imbewu yakhe, yena umhlobo wakhe okhoyo uya kungena athenge into awayethengisile yona.
Ke kaloku, ukuba akukho namnye oza kuyithenga kuye; ke xa ekugqibeleni esenza ngcono, ibe nemali eyaneleyo yokuyithenga yena,
uya kubala iminyaka eyadlulayo ukususela ekuthengiseni kwakhe, abuyisele kumntu awayethengise kuye, ngokwexesha eliseleyo leminyaka; emva koko abuye ezweni lakhe.

Ke kaloku, ukuba akakwazi ukuyifumana iindleko zokuyithenga, le ndawo iya kuba nguwo lowo uyithengileyo kude kube ngunyaka weshumi elinesibini; ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibini iya kubuyiselwa, aze abuye ezweni lakhe.
Xa umntu ethengisa indlu emzini onezindlu zangasese, emva kokuthengiswa kwayo uya kuba nonyaka owodwa opheleleyo wokuyithenga; unyaka omnye uya kuba nelungelo lokuyithenga.

Ke kaloku, ukuba akufunyanwa phambi kokuba unyaka uphele, ikhaya elunxwemeni lomzi-ndlu luya kuba nguwo lowo walithengileyo ngonaphakade, nosapho lwakhe emva kwakhe; aluyi kubuyiselwa kwiminyaka yeshumi elinesibini.
Iindlu zasezidolophini ezingenamagquma ngazo zonke iinkalo, zifana nezityalo zesizwe; zingathengwa, ziya kubuyiselwa ngomnyaka weshumi elinesihlanu.
Ke kaloku amaLevi angazithengisa izindlu zabo, ezimizini yabo, ngonaphakade.

Ke kaloku, ukuba indlu yomLevi ithengiswe esinye sezixeko sabo, ingavunywanga, iya kubuya ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo; ngokuba izindlu zezixeko zabaLevi ziyindawo yabo yobundlobongela phakathi kwabantu bakaSirayeli.
Iindawo eziphakathi kwezixeko zabo azithengiswanga, ngokuba ziye zibe zinikwe kubo ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku, ukuba kukho umntu phakathi kwenu ovela ebantwini, akakwazi ukuxhasa ngokwakhe, ncedani yena; aze ahlale nawe, njengokuba ungumkhenkce nanjengomhlali.
Musa ukumhlawula umvuzo, ungawuthathanga umvuzo kuye; ukhathalele uThixo wakho, aze ahlale phakathi kwakho.
Musa ukumnika imali ngenzuzo, ungamthengi isonka sakhe ukuze uphumelele.
Mna ndinguYehova uThixo wenu, endinikhupha ezweni laseYiputa, ukuba ndikunike ilizwe laseKanan, ukuze ndibe nguThixo wenu.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umntu phakathi kwenu ethe wafa, wathengisa ngokwakhe kuwe, musa ukumenza asebenze njengomkhonzi.
Uya kumphatha njengomqeshwa-mali, nokuba ngumkhenkce ohlala nawe; aze akusebenzele kude kube ngunyaka weJubilee.
Ke yena nonyana bakhe baya kuphuma kuwe, babuye kusapho lwabo, bebuyela ezweni labazali babo.
Bami abakhonzi bam oonyana bakaSirayeli, endibakhuphe eYiputa; bangathengiswanga njengamakhonzi.
Musa ukuba ngukumkani phezu kwakhe ngobukrelekrele, ugcine uThixo wakho.
Abakhonzi bakho, amadoda nabasetyhini, baya kuvela ezizweni ezikufutshane nawe; kuzo niyithengele abakhonzi.
Ngabantwana bezihlwele ezihlala phakathi kwenu, nibathengise nabo; ngamadodakazi abo azalwa ezweni lakho, baya kuba yipropathi yenu.
Ungazishiya zibe yipropathi yabo abantwana bakho emva kwakho, babe ngabakhonzi bakho ngonaphakade; kodwa ungabi ngukumkani kubazalwana bakho, ooSirayeli.

Uthile ovela kwelinye ilizwe, nalowo uhlala phakathi kwenu, angaba mkhulu; ke xa umntu osuka kumaSirayeli, umzalwana wakho, ephelelwe lityala, athengise yena ngokwakhe kuloo mntu ovela kwelinye ilizwe, nalowo ovela kwindlu yaloo mntu.
Ke kaloku, emva kokuba ethengise yena ngokwakhe, uya kuba nelungelo lokubuyiselwa; omnye wabahlobo bakhe angawuthenga kwakhona.
nokuba ngukumkani wakhe, nokuba ngumyeni wakhe, nokuba yindodana yakhe, nokuba yinkosikazi yakhe, nokuba yintsapho yakhe; okanye ukuba ethe waphilile, angazithenga.

Ke yena nomthengisi wakhe baya kubala iminyaka, ukususela kulo nyaka athengiswe ngawo, kuye kunyaka weshumi elinesibhozo; ixabiso lokukhutshwa kwakhe liya kwenziwa ngokwenani leminyaka, njengokuba wahlawulwa ngazo iintsuku zomsebenzi.
Ukuba ihlala iminyaka emininzi, kufuneka ahlawule kwakhona inxenye enkulu yexabiso elithengwa ngalo.
Ukuba ke ihlala iminyaka embalwa kuphela kude kube ngunyaka weshumi elinanye, uya kuzibala, abuyisele intlawulo encinci, ngokweminyaka iseleyo.
Kufuneka athathwe njengomsebenzi oqeshwa unyaka nonyaka. Kufuneka uqiniseke ukuba umnini wakhe akawulawulanga ngokubi.
Ke kaloku, ukuba akufunyanwa ngenye yezo ndlela, uya kuphuma yena nabantwana bakhe ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibini.
Kuba oonyana bakaSirayeli ngumsebenzi wam; ngumsebenzi wam ke, ndiwakhuphe eYiputa. Ndiye iNkosi uThixo wenu.

Musani kwenza kuni imifanekiso engumqondiso; musani ukubeka endlwini yenu imifanekiso engumqondiso, namagqabi angcwele; musani nokubeka ezweni lenu imifanekiso engumqondiso, ukuze niyihlonele; ngokuba mna ndinguYehova uThixo wenu.
Zigcineni iintsuku zam zokuphumla, nizihlonele indawo yam engcwele. Ndiye iNkosi.
Ukuba nihamba ngemimiselo yam, niyigcine imiyalelo yam,
Ndiya kuzisa imvula yenu ngexesha layo; ilizwe liza kunika iziqhamo zayo, namatye asendle aza kunika ubisi lwawo.

Ixesha lenu lokuvuna ingqolowa liza kuhlala kude kube yixesha lokuvuna iziqhamo, nexesha lenu lokuvuna iziqhamo liza kuhlala kude kube yixesha lokulima; niya kuba nesonka esigcweleyo, nihlala ezweni lenu ngokukhuselekile.
Ndiza kuzisa uxolo ezweni; niya kuhlala niphumle, akukho mntu uya kunikhathaza; ndiya kuzisusa izinyama-zinyama ezibulalayo ezweni; akuyi kubakho umkhosi udlula ezweni lakho.
Niya kuthobela abathunywa benu; baya kufa ngeqhosha phambi kwenu.
Abahlanu kuni baya kuthobela ishumi, namakhulu enu aya kuthobela amawaka alishumi; abathunywa benu baya kukhutshwa ngekrele phambi kwenu.
Ndiya kukujonga, ndiya kukwenza ukuba ube mkhulu; ndiya kukunika oonyana abaninzi, ndiya kukwenza ube mkhulu; ndiya kukugcina umnqophiso wam nani.
Uya kuqhubeka ukutya imbewu yonyaka ophelileyo xa ufuna ukuyisusa ukuze wenze indawo yento entsha.
Ndiya kuyibeka indlu yam phakathi kwenu; andiyi kubuya ndisuka kuni,
Ndiya kuhamba phakathi kwenu; ndiya kuba nguThixo wenu, nibe ngabantu bam.

Ndiye mna iNkosi uThixo wenu, owenza ukuba niphume ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze ningabi ngabakhonzi babo; ndawuphula umnqamlezo wokhuni olunzima emqolo wenu, ndakwenza ukuba nihambe ngeentloko zenu ziphakamileyo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba ningandiphulaphuli, niyenze loo myalelo wonke,
ukuba nizixolele izigqibo zam, nokuba nizixolele imithetho yam, nokuba ningaze niyigcine yonke imimiselo yam, ukuze niphulaphule umnqophiso wam;

ndiya kukwenza oku kuni: ndiza kukuzisa uxinzelelo olukhawulezayo, iintsholongwane eziphazamisayo, nesifo esibulalayo, esiza kwenza ukuba amehlo akho anqande, nomphefumlo wakho unqande; niza kulima izityalo zenu ngokungabikho nto; kuba abathunywa benu baya kuzidla.
Ndiya kubuyela kuwe, abathunywa bakho baya kukunqoba; abo bakuxhalabisayo baya kukumkani phezu kwakho; niza kuhamba nakuba akukho mntu ukukhokela.
Ukuba, nangazo zonke ezi zinto, ningandiphulaphuli mna, ndiza kunisindisa ngokuphindaphindiweyo ishumi elinesibhozo ngenxa yezono zenu.
Ndiya kutshisa ukholo lwakho olukhulu; ndiya kuzilungisa izulu eziphezulu kwakho, zibe njengentsimbi, zingabi nemvula; nomhlaba phantsi kwakho ube ngubhedu.
Zonke iinzame zenu ziya kuba zingenanto; ngokuba ilizwe lenu alizukunika iziqhamo zalo, namatye alazinika utywala lwabo.
Ukuba ke niya kuhamba nangaphandle kwam, ningamthobeli mna, ndiza kunikhuphela izidumbu ezisixhenxe, ngokweempawu zenu.
Ndiya kuzithumela phakathi kwenu iintaka zomhlaba; ziya kuzisa abantwana benu, zisuse izilwane zenu, zibe zincinci kuwe; iindlela zakho ziza kuhlala zingasebenzi.
Ukuba ke, emva kwezi zinto zonke, nize ningabuyeli kum, niqhubekeni nokuhamba nam,
mna ke ndiya kuhamba ndichaphazeleke kuni; mna ke ndiya kukubetha niphindaphindwe kathathu ngenxa yezono zenu.
Ndiya kuzisa phezu kwenu umkhosi, ukuba nigwebe umnqophiso wam. Ke kaloku, xa niza kungena ezidolophini zenu, ndiza kusithumela isifo phakathi kwenu; niza kunikezelwa kumagosa enu.
Ke kaloku, xa ndiya kukucingela intonga yesonka sakho, abafazi abalishumi baya kulungiselela yonke isonka sakho kwisikhenkcisi esisodwa; baya kuyinika ngobunzima; nidla ke, kodwa ningabi neswe.
Ukuba, nangazo zonke ezi zinto, ningandiphulaphuli mna, nithi, Sihamba ngokuchasene nam;
mna ke ndiya kungena kuni ngoxolo lwam; ndiya kukuxelela niphinde niphinda-phindiwe ishumi elinesibhozo ngenxa yezono zenu.
Niya kulila inyama yabantwana benu nabentombi yenu.
Ndiya kuzibulala iindawo zenu eziphakamileyo, ndizitshixe izibingelelo zenu eziphakamileyo; ndiza kuzimisa iinkunzi zenu phezu kweenkunzi zezinto zenu ezingaphiliyo; ndiya kubuya ndize ndizixolele.
Ndiya kuzilungisa izixeko zenu zibe ziidolophu, ndizishiye iindawo zenu ezingcwele zingenanto; andiyi kuyonwabela ivumba elimnandi leentyatyambo zenu.
Ndiya kwenza ukuba ilizwe lakho libe yindawo engasebenziyo, ukuze abathunywa bakho abathi bahlale kuyo, babe ngamatye.
Ndiya kunisasaza phakathi kwezizwe, ndiyikhuphe ikrele lam, ndinukele emva kwenu; ilizwe lenu liza kuba lilahlekile, imimandla yenu iya kuba yimihlaba.
Ngazo zonke iintsuku eziya kuhlala khona ilizwe lilahlekile, nisezweni labatshaba benu, liya kuphumla kwiminyaka yesondlo sayo; iya kuphumla ilizwe, iya kuphumla isondlo sayo.
Zonke iintsuku zayo ezingenanto, iya kuba nayo intliziyo yokuphumla ayizange ibe nayo kwiminyaka yenu yeSabbathi, xa nihlala khona.

Ke bona abaseleyo kuni, ezweni labatshaba benu, ndiya tuthalisa; intshukumo yentyatyambo eqhutywa ngumoya iya kubabangela ukuba bahambe; baya kuhamba njengokuba behamba phambi kwekrele; baza bawela, nokuba akukho mntu ulandela.
Baza kugwetywa ngamnye ngomnye, njengokuba ehamba phambi kwekrele, nokuba akukho mntu ulandelayo; ningayi kukwazi ukumelana nabachasi benu.
Uza kufa phakathi kwezizwe, ilizwe labatshaba bakho liya kukulibazisa.
Abaseleyo kuni baya kuphelelwa lithemba ezweni labatshaba benu, ngenxa yobulungisa babo, yaye ngenxa yobulungisa beenkosi zabo.
Bathi ke baya kuvuma iimpazamo zabo, neimpazamo zabazalwana babo, ngenxa yobuxoki babo kum, nokuhamba kwabo ngokuchasene nam;
Ke kaloku, ukuba intliziyo yabo ephakamileyo ihlambuluke, bathabathe isigwebo sezono zabo;
ndiya kukhumbula umnqophiso wam noYakobi, nomnqophiso wam noIsake, nomnqophiso wam noAbraham; ndiya kukhumbula ilizwe.

Ke kaloku ilizwe liya kushiyeka lingenanto kubo, liyonwabele iintsuku zayo ezisixhenxe, ngelixa libe lingenanto ngaphandle kwabo; baza bathathe intlawulo yobulungisa babo, ngenxa yokuba beziqhenya imimiselo yam, babezixolela izigwebo zam.

Ke kaloku, nangazo zonke ezi zinto, xa bekwilizwe labatshaba babo, ndiya kubanga, ndiya kubancoma, ndiya kubaxolela, ndiye ndababulala ngokugqithisileyo, ndaphula umnqophiso wam nabo; ngokuba mna nguYehova uThixo wabo.
Ndiya kukhumbula, ngenxa yabo, umnqophiso wam nabazalwana babo, endibakhuphe ezweni laseYiputa, phambi kobuso beentlanga, ukuze ndibe nguThixo wabo; mna iNkosi.
Ezi ziyimimiselo, nemimiselo, nemimiselo-mthetho, awayethetha ngayo iNkosi ngentliziyo kaMoses, emnqamlezweni weSinayi, phakathi kwakhe nabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, sithi kubo: Xa umntu esenza isibingelelo esikhethekileyo, ukuba anikezele umntu kuYehova, angawuhlawula umlinganiselo wexabiso lakhe.
Ukuba ngumfazi oneminyaka emashumi mabini namakhulu amathandathu ubudala, ixabiso lakho liya kuba ziishekeli ezilishumi elinambini zesilivere, ngobunzima bendawo engcwele.
Ukuba ngumfazi oneminyaka elishumi elinambini ubudala, ixabiso lakhe liya kuba ziishekeli ezimashumi mathathu zesilivere.
Umntu oneminyaka emihlanu ukuya kwengama-20 ubudala, ixabiso elimiselweyo liyipesenti ezimashumi mabini zesilivere kunyana, neepesenti ezilishumi kwindoda.
Kubantwana abasuka kwinyanga enye ukuya kwiminyaka emihlanu ubudala, ixabiso elimiselweyo liyizinto ezintlanu zesilivere kunyana wesifazane nezinto ezintathu zesilivere kunyana wesifazane.
Umntu oneminyaka engamashumi asixhenxe nangaphezulu, ixabiso lakhe liya kuba ziishekeli zesilivere ezilishumi elinambini, ukuba ngumfazi, ziishekeli ezilishumi.

Ke kaloku, ukuba umntu unobuxoki kakhulu, angabi nako ukuhlawula ixabiso lakho, kufuneka anikezelwe kumbingeleli, umbingeleli amnike ixabiso lakhe. Umbingeleli uya kumnika ixabiso lakhe, ngokwento enokuyenza loo mntu owenza isibingelelo.
Ukuba isibingelelo siyinyama eyamkelweyo kuYehova, yonke loo nyama inikezelwe kuYehova, iya kuba yingcwele.

Akuyi kuyitshintshi, akuyi kuyiguqula, ilungileyo ibe yiyo engalunganga, okanye ingalunganga ibe yiyo elungileyo. Ukuba ke utshintshe inkomo enye ibe yiyo engalunganga, iya kuba ngcwele leyo inkomo, nento eyatshintshwa ngayo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba idini elilungiselelwe ngumbingeleli liyinyama engaphiliyo, enganikezelwa kuYehova, liya kuthunyelwa kumbingeleli.
Umbingeleli uya kuyigqiba ixabiso layo, ukuba lilungileyo nakuba libi; njengokuba umbingeleli egqibe ngayo ixabiso layo, iya kuba yile xabiso.
Ukuba umnini unqwenela ukuyithenga kwakhona, kufuneka ahlawule ixabiso layo elidityaniswe neshumi elinanye.

Xa umntu enikela indlu yakhe, ibe ngumnikelo ongcwele kuYehova, umbingeleli uya kuyigqiba ixabiso layo, nokuba lilungileyo nakuba libi; njengoko umbingeleli ayichazileyo loo xabiso, ngoko ke liya kuqikelelwa.
Ke kaloku, ukuba lowo wamnikayo unqwenela ukuyithenga kwakhona, uya kuyihlawula ixabiso layo, athabathe isiqingatha sayo, ibe yakhe.

Ukuba umntu enika iNkosi isiqhamo sendlu yakhe yosapho, ixabiso lakhe liya kuthethwa ngokwenani lembewu elifunekayo ukutyala kuyo: amashekeli amashumi amahlanu esilivere ngamakhulu amabini eetoni zembewu yesonka.
Ukuba enika indawo yakhe kunyaka weshumi elinanye, ixabiso elimiselweyo lihlala.

Ke kaloku, ukuba wanikela indawo yakhe emva komnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo, umbingeleli uya kusebenza ixabiso lakhe ngokwenani leminyaka eliseleyo kude kube ngunyaka weshumi elinesibhozo olandelayo; liya kunyuswa ixabiso lakho.
Ke kaloku, ukuba lowo wamnikayo umhlaba ufuna ukuwuthenga kwakhona, uya kuyihlawula ixabiso layo, athabathe isiqingatha sayo, ibe yakhe.
Ke kaloku, ukuba akayithengi kwakhona le ndawo, okanye ukuba ayithengise komnye umntu, ayinakuthethwa kwakhona.
Ke kaloku, xa isiqhamo somhlaba siphuma kwiminyaka ilishumi elinamibini addita, siya kuba singcwele kuYehova, njengokuba sisiqhamo esinikezelwe kuye ngokupheleleyo; iya kuba yintsapho yamabingeleli.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu enikela kuYehova isiqhamo sakhe esithengiweyo, esingaba yinxalenye yembewu yosapho lwakhe,
umbingeleli uya kusebenza ixabiso layo kude kube ngunyaka weshumi elinesibini; lo mntu uya kulihlawula ngaloo mini, ibe lidini elingcwele kuYehova.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinanye, iya kubuyela le ndawo kumntu wayithengayo, ibe yindawo yosapho lwakhe.
Zonke iindleko ezimiselweyo kufuneka zisetyenziswe ubunzima obusemthethweni bendawo engcwele, ubunzima obuncinci obumashumi amabini kwinxalenye nganye yesiliver.
Ke kaloku akukho namnye oza kunika umzali-mntwana wezinto eziphilayo njengomnikelo, ngokuba umzali-mntwana nguweNkosi; nokuba yinyosi, nokuba yinkunzi yebhokhwe, yiye iNkosi.

Ukuba yinyama engahlanjwanga, umnini uya kuyithenga kwakhona ngokuhlawula ixabiso layo elimiselweyo kunye neshumi elinalinye. Ukuba ayithengwa kwakhona, kufuneka ithengiswe ngexabiso layo elimiselweyo.

Ke kaloku, nantoni na umntu anikela ngayo ngokuzelepekileyo kuYehova kwimpahla yakhe, nokuba ngumntu, nokuba yinyama, nokuba yindawo yosapho lwakhe, ayithengwanga, ayithengiswanga; yonke into enikezelweyo ngokuzelepekileyo ngaloo ndlela ingcwele kakhulu kuYehova.
Akukho mntu onikezelwe ukuba aphelelwe lithemba, angathengwa; kufuneka afunyanwe.
Ishumi lezinto zonke ezivelisa ilizwe, nokuba yingqolowa yehlabathi, nokuba yimbewu yomthi, lilungu likaYehova; lingcwele kuYehova.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umntu efuna ukuthenga kwakhona enye yeshumi lakhe, kufuneka ahlawule ixabiso layo ngaphezu kwesihlanu.
Ishumi elinanye lezinto eziphilayo, iinkomo neentlanzi, zonke izinto eziphilayo ezidlula phantsi komthi womgcini-mvumi, ngokubala kwabo, ziya kuba zingcwele kuYehova.
Akuyi kubakho ukuba umnini wayo akhethe ezilungileyo phakathi kwezibi, akatshintshi nanye yazo; ukuba etshintshe enye, iya kuba yinqaba, nayo leyo itshintshwe ngayo; ayizukuthengwa.
La magunya athethe ngawo iNkosi kuMoses, kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, entlango yaseSina.
Num: Ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yesibini, ngomnyaka wesibini emva kokuba abantwana bakaSirayeli bephuma eYiputa, iNkosi wathi kuMoses, etentweni yokuhlangana, entlango yaseSina, esithi,
Babala bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngokweedolophu zabo, ngezindlu zabazali babo; babhale phantsi igama ngalinye lomntu ngamnye, ngomlomo wakhe,
bonke abaneminyaka emashumi mabini ubudala nangaphezulu, abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini kuSirayeli; nibazise wena noAron ngokwemikhosi yabo.
Kuza kubakho nomntu omnye kwisizukulwana ngasinye, abe ngukumkani weentsapho zakhe.
Lemi amagama eendoda eziya kuninceda: kuRubhen, uElisuri unyana kaShedeure.
KuSimeoni nguShelumiyeli unyana kaZurishaddai.
kuYuda nguNahshon unyana ka-Aminadabu.
Ku-Ishari nguNethaneli unyana kaSuwari.
KuZabulon nguEliyaba unyana kaHelon.
Oonyana bakaYosefu: kuEfrayim, uElishama unyana kaAmihudi; kuManase, uGamaliyeli unyana kaPedasuri.
KuBenjamin, nguAbidan unyana kaGideoni.
KuDan, nguAhiyezere unyana ka-Ammishadaya.
Ku-Ashere nguPagiyeli unyana kaOhran.
KuGadi nguEliyasafe unyana kaDeuyeli.
KuNafetali nguAhira unyana kaEnani.
Baye ke abo madoda akhethiweyo ekumkani, abe ziinkomo zeentsapho zabazali babo; babe ziinqanawa zokulwa zakwaSirayeli.
Bathi ke uMoses noAron, bathabathe la madoda abizwa ngegama;

babhiyozela ibandla lonke, ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yesibini; babala oonyana bakaSirayeli ngokweenkokheli zabo, ngokweendlu zabazali babo, bonke amadoda aneminyaka engama-mashumi mabini nangaphezulu, ngamagama abo, ngamnye ngegama lakhe.
Wababala ke uMoses esiqwini saseSina, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo.

Aba oonyana bakaRubhen, omkhulu kuSirayeli, bonke amadoda aneminyaka emashumi mabini ubudala nangaphezulu, abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, babhalwa ngegama ngalinye, ngamnye ngosapho lwakhe, ngokwezindlu zabazali bakhe.
Abo babalwa kubo, abasuka kwisizukulwana sikaRubhen, babe ngamawaka amane anamakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci amathandathu.

Aba oonyana bakaSimeon, ababhalwa kubo ngokwezinambuzane zabo, ngosapho lwabo, ngamakhaya abo, ngobudala babo obulishumi elinambini nangaphezulu, bonke amadoda aphumayo emkhosini, ngamagama abo, ngamnye ngegama lakhe.
Abo babalwa kubo, abasuka kwisizukulwana sikaSimeon, baba ngamakhulu amahlanu anamashumi asithoba amawaka, anamanci mathathu.

Aba oonyana bakaGadi, ababhalwa kubo ngokwezinambuzane zabo, ngosapho lwabo, ngamakhaya abo, ngobudala babo obulishumi elinambini nangaphezulu, bonke abafana abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, babalwa ngegama ngalinye.
Abo babalwa kubo, abasuka kwisizukulwana sikaGadi, babe ngamawaka anamanci mane anamakhulu amathandathu, anesihlanu.

Aba oonyana bakaYuda, ababhalwa kubo ngokwezinambuzane zabo, ngosapho lwabo, ngamakhaya abo, ngobudala babo obulishumi elinambini nangaphezulu, bonke amadoda aphumayo emkhosini, ngamagama abo, ngamnye ngegama lakhe.
Amanani abo ababalolwe kubo, eSizukulwana sikaYuda, amashumi asixhenxe anane amawaka anamanci amathandathu.
Aba oonyana baka-Issakare, ababhalwa kubo ngokwezinani zabo, ngamaqela abo, ngamakhaya abo, ngomnyaka wesibini nangaphezulu, bonke amadoda aphumayo emkhosini, ngamagama abo, ngamnye ngegama lakhe.
Abo babalwa kubo, abasuka kwisizukulwana sika-Isayakare, babe ngamawaka anamanci mane anamakhulu amahlanu.
Aba oonyana bakaZebulon, ababhalwa kubo ngokwezinani zabo, ngamaqela abo, ngamakhaya abo, ngomnyaka wesibini nangaphezulu, bonke amadoda aphumayo emkhosini, ngamagama abo, ngamnye ngegama lakhe.
Abo babalwa kubo, baseSizwe sikaZebulon, babe ngamawaka amashumi amahlanu anesixhenxe anamakhulu mane.

Aba oonyana bakaEfrayim, oonyana bakaYosefu, bonke amadoda aneminyaka engama-mashumi mabini nangaphezulu, abo bakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, baqulunqwe ngegama ngalinye, ngamnye ngosapho lwakhe, ngokwezindlu zabazali bakhe.
Abo babalwa kubo, abasuka kwisizukulwana sikaEfrayim, babe ngamawaka amane anamakhulu amahlanu.

Aba oonyana bakaManase, ababhalwa kubo ngokwezinambuzane zabo, ngosapho lwabo, ngamakhaya abo, ngobudala babo obulishumi elinambini nangaphezulu, bonke abafana abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, babalwa ngegama ngalinye.
Abo babalwa kubo, abasuka kwisizukulwana sikaManase, babe ngamawaka amashumi mathathu anambini anamakhulu amabini.

Aba oonyana bakaBhenjamin, ababhalwa kubo ngokwezinambuzane zabo, ngosapho lwabo, ngamakhaya abo, ngomnyaka wesibini nangaphezulu, bonke amadoda aphumayo emkhosini, ngamagama abo, ngamnye ngegama lakhe.
Amanani abo ababalolwe kubo, ezweni likaBhenjamin, amawaka amashumi mathathu anesihlanu anamakhulu amane.

Aba oonyana bakaDan, ababhalwa kubo ngokwezinambuzane zabo, ngosapho lwabo, ngamakhaya abo; bonke amadoda aneminyaka emashumi mabini ubudala nangaphezulu, onke aphumayo emkhosini, ngamagama abo, ngamnye ngegama lakhe.
Abo babalwa kubo, abasuka kwisizukulwana sikaDan, babe ngamawaka angamashumi amathandathu anesibini anamakhulu asixhenxe.

Aba oonyana baka-Asheri, ababhalwa kubo ngokwezinambuzane zabo, ngosapho lwabo, ngamakhaya abo, ngokweziqu zabo, ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibini nangaphezulu, bonke amadoda aphumayo emkhosini, babalwa ngegama ngalinye.
Abo babalwa kubo, abasuka kwisizwe sika-Asere, babe ngamawaka amane anamakhulu amahlanu.

Aba oonyana bakaNafetali, ababhalwa kubo ngokwezinambuzane zabo, ngosapho lwabo, ngamakhaya abo, ngobudala babo obulishumi elinambini nangaphezulu, bonke amadoda aphumayo emkhosini, ngamagama abo, ngamnye ngegama lakhe.
Amanani abo ababalolwe kubo, kwisizukulwana sikaNafetali, amashumi amahlanu anamakhulu mane, amawaka amathathu.
Abo ke ababalowe nguMoses noAron, ngamadoda amakhulu kaSirayeli alishumi elinambini, omnye endlwini nganye yosapho.
Bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, abaneminyaka emashumi mabini ubudala nangaphezulu, bonke abo bakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, ngokwezindlu zabazali babo.
Inani labo lonke lalingamakhulu amathandathu, amawaka amathathu, anamakhulu amahlanu, anamanci mahlanu.
Ke kaloku amaLevi, ngokwesizukulwana sabasetyhini babo, akayibhalwa phakathi kwabo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wathi kuMoses,
Musa ukubala isizukulwana sikaLevi, ungabafaki phakathi kwabo babalwa kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli.

Ke kaloku ubeke amaLevi phantsi kolawulo lwetenki engcwele, apho kugcinwa khona umthetho womnqophiso, nezixhobo zayo zonke, nazo zonke izinto zalo; bathabathe itenti engcwele, nezixhobo zayo zonke; bayenze umsebenzi wayo, babe ngamatye ajikelezayo.
Ke kaloku, xa isibingelelo sisiya kuhamba, abaLevi baya kuyikhupha; ke kaloku, xa imisa, abaLevi baya kuyibeka. Nabani na oza kuqhawula kuyo, kufuneka aphele.
Bathi oonyana bakaSirayeli babeke iintente zabo, umntu ngamnye emkhosini wakhe, nomfuziselo wakhe, ngokwemikhosi yabo.

Ke kaloku amaLevi athabathe iziqithi ezijikeleze itabernakele engcwele, apho kugcinwa khona umthetho womnqophiso; ukuze ingabikho inkanuko yam kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli. AmaLevi ke aya kuba ngumsebenzi wetabernakele engcwele.
Bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli bakwenza njalo, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo uMoses.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses noAron, wathi,
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli bathabathe iziqithi ezijikeleze itentile yokuhlangana, bengaphaya kwayo; umntu ngamnye athabathe iziqithi ecaleni kwemfazwe yakhe, ngemiqondiso yeentsapho zakhe.
Kwicala lasempumalanga, ecaleni lokuvuka kwelanga, iinkunzi zesizwe sethutyana sikaYuda ziya kubeka iintente zazo ngokwemikhosi yazo; uNahshon unyana ka-Aminadabhi ngukumkani wabaLevi.
Iqela lakhe, amawaka awo amashumi asixhenxe anane anamakhulu asixhenxe.
Ngasekunene kwabo, isizukulwana samaSirayeli; uNethaneli unyana ka-Suwari, abe ngukumkani wamaSirayeli.
Iqela lakhe, iinkwenkwezi zawo zimashumi amahlanu anane amawaka anamanci amane.
Ke kaloku kuya kufika isizwe sikaZebulon; uEliyaba, unyana kaHeloni, ube ngukumkani wabaLevi.
Iqela lakhe laba ngamawaka amashumi amahlanu anesixhenxe anamakhulu amane.
Abafazi bonke abakwithamsanqa likaYuda, ngokwemikhosi yabo, bangamakhulu amawaka, anamanci asibhozo anamashumi mane anesithandathu, anamakhulu amane. Baya kuphuma bakuqala.
Kwicala lasempumalanga, isiqithi somkhosi kaRubhen siza kwenza iintaba ngemikhosi yayo; nguElisuri unyana kaShedeure, umthetheli wamaSirayeli.
Iqela lakhe laba ngamawaka amane anamakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci mane anesithandathu.
Ngasekunene kwabo, isizukulwana sikaSimeon; uShelumiyeli unyana kaZurishaddayi abe ngukumkani wabaSimeon.
Iqela lakhe laba ngamawaka amashumi amahlanu anesixhenxe anamakhulu mathathu.
Ke kaloku liza isizwe sikaGadi; uEliyashafe, unyana kaRehuyeli, ube ngukumkani kwabaseGadi.
Amawaka omkhosi wakhe amashumi mane anesihlanu amawaka, anamakhulu amathandathu, anamanci mahlanu.
Oonyana bakaRubhen, bonke ababhaliswe esixekweni sakwaRubhen, ngokwemikhosi yabo, bamakhulu amahlanu anamashumi mabini ananye amawaka, anamanci amane anamashumi amahlanu. Baya kuhamba besibini.

Ke kaloku itentile yokuhlangana iya kuhamba, nomkhosi wamaLevi phakathi kwemikhosi; baya kuhamba ngokulandelana kwabo, njengokuba bemisa khona itente yabo, ngamnye endlwini yakhe, ngasemva kwebhanti lakhe.
Kwicala lasemagxamene, isiqithi somkhosi kaEfrayim siza kwenza iintlanganiso ngokwemikhosi yayo; uElishama unyana ka-Amihude ngukumkani wabaLevi.
Iqela lakhe lamashumi amane amawaka anamakhulu amahlanu.
Ngasekunene kwabo, isizukulwana sikaManase; uGamayeli unyana kaPedashuri, abe ngukumkani kwabaseManase.
Iqela lakhe, amawaka awo amashumi mathathu anambini anamakhulu amabini.
Ke kaloku ifike isizukulwana samaBhenjamini; nguAbhidan unyana kaGideoni, umlawuli wamaBhenjamini.
Iqela lakhe lamadoda limashumi amathathu anesihlanu amawaka anamakhulu amane.
Oonyana bakaEfrayim, bonke ababhaliswe esixekweni sakwaEfrayim, ngokwemikhosi yabo, bamakhulu asibhozo amawaka, anamakhulu mathathu.
Kwicala lasempuma, isiqithi somkhosi kaDan siza kwenza iintlanganiso ngemikhosi yayo; uAhiyezere, unyana ka-Ammishadaya, ngukumkani wabaLevi.
Iqela lakhe, iinkwenkwezi zawo zimashumi asixhenxe anesibini amawaka anamakhulu asixhenxe
Ngasekunene kwabo, isizukulwana sika-Ashe; uPagiyeli unyana ka-Ohrane abe ngukumkani kwabaseAshe.
Iqela lakhe, amawaka awo amashumi amane ananye anamakhulu amahlanu.
Ke kaloku isizukulwana samaNafetali; nguAhira unyana ka-Enani ubukumkani bamaNafetali.
Iqela lakhe laba ngamawaka amane anamakhulu amahlanu, anamanci mathathu.
Inani elipheleleyo lemikhosi kaDan ngumakhulu amahlanu anamashumi asixhenxe amawaka, anamakhulu amathandathu. Baya kuphuma baya kugqitywa ngeempawu zabo.

Baye ke abo oonyana bakaSirayeli, ababalolwe ngokweentsapho zabo; bonke ababalolwe kuzo zonke izibhedlele, ngemikhosi yabo, bamakhulu amathandathu, amawaka amathathu, anamakhulu amahlanu, anamanci mahlanu.
Ke kaloku amaLevi akayi kubanjwa phakathi kwabantu bakaSirayeli, njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Bakwenza ke oonyana bakaSirayeli konke oko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngawo uMoses; bamisa izikhephe zabo ngale ndlela, baphuma ngale ndlela, umntu ngamnye ngosapho lwakhe, nosapho lwamakhaya akhe.
Ezi ziintsapho zika-Aron noMoses, ngexesha iNkosi wathetha noMoses emnqamlezweni waseSinai.
Lemi amagama oonyana baka-Aron: uNadabhi umzali, no-Abihu, no-Elazare, no-Ithamari.
Baye ke abo oonyana baka-Aron, ababingeleli abanqunyiweyo, abagciniwe ukuba babe ngababingeleli.

Bafa ke uNadab noAbhihu phambi koYehova, xa babemnika umlilo ongafanelekanga, eYiputa yaseSinai; abazange babenabantwana. UElezare noItamari bakhonza njengombingeleli ngexesha lokuphila kukaAron uyise wabo.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yazisa isizukulwana sikaLevi, ubabeke phantsi kukaAron umbingeleli, ukuba basebenze kuye.
Baya kwenza umsebenzi wakhe, nomsebenzi webandla lonke, endlwini kaYehova yokuhlangana, besebenza kwindlu engcwele.
Bathi bagcine iimpahla zonke zetentile yokuhlangana, nemisebenzi yabo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, ukuba basebenze endlwini engcwele.
Yabanike ooLevi kuAron nabantwana bakhe; banikezelwe kuye ngokupheleleyo, besuka kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli.
Wamisa uAron noonyana bakhe, ukuba babe ngababingeleli bakho; nabani na osuka kwamanye amazwe, afike kuzinto ezingcwele, kufuneka afumane umhlaza.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yabona, ndibathathe abaLevi phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, ukuba babe yindawo yazo zonke izizalwana zabafazi bakaSirayeli; abaLevi babeni bam.
Kuba onke azalwa kuqala ngunyana wam; ngaloo mini ndiye ndawabulala onke azalwa kuqala eYiputa, ndazimisa ngokwam onke azalwa kuqala kuSirayeli, nokuba ngumntu nakuba yinyama: zinguYehova.
Wathetha ke iNkosi kuMoses embindini weSina, esithi,
Bhala ooLevi ngokweentsapho zabo, ngamaqela abo; bala bonke amadoda aneminyaka elishumi elinanye nangaphezulu.
Wababala ke uMoses, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo.
Ke kaloku oonyana bakaLevi: uGershoni, noKehati, noMerari.
Ezi ziintsapho zabantwana bakaGershoni: uLibni noShimehi.
Amaqela oonyana bakaKahati: nguAmram, noIshar, noHebron, noUziyele.
Amaqela oonyana bakaMerariya: uMaheli noMushi. Ezi ziifama zakwaLevi ngokweemfazwe zabo.
KuGershoni kwavela iintsapho zikaLibni noShimehi; ezi ziintsapho zabaGershoni.
Inani labo lonke lamabhinqa, aneminyaka elishumi elinanye ubudala nangaphezulu, yaba ngamawaka asixhenxe anamakhulu amahlanu.
Iintsapho zakwaGershoni zamisa iintaba ngasemntla, ngasemva kwetenki engcwele.
Ukumkani weendlu zakwaGershoni nguEliyasafe unyana kaLayeli.
Kwintsapho kaGershoni, endlwini yokuhlangana, kwakukho ulawulo lweentlango ezingcwele, netentyatyambo zazo, nophahla lwazo, nomgca womngxunya wentlango yokuhlangana;
nezitayile zendlu yangasemva, nesitayile somngxunya wendlu yangasemva ejikeleze itentyatyambo engcwele, nesibingelelo, neentambo; bazenza zonke izinto zomsebenzi.
Amaqela kaAmram, namaqela kaIshar, namaqela kaHebron, namaqela kaUziyele, asuka kuKahati; la maqela amaKahati.
Inombolo yabo, bonke amadoda aneminyaka elishumi elinanye ubudala nangaphezulu, yaba ngamawaka asibhozo anamakhulu asixhenxe; babe negunya lokugcina ingcwele.
Iintsapho zakwaKahati zazithiywa ecaleni lasempumalanga letente engcwele.
Umbingeleli weendlu zakwaKahati nguElizafan unyana kaUziyeli.
Babelawula ibhokisi yomnqophiso, netafile, nesiqalo selanga, nezibingelelo, neempahla ezisetyenziswayo endlwini engcwele, nesitayile; babephatha yonke imisebenzi yazo.
UElazar, unyana ka-Aron, umbingeleli, waba ngukumkani wamaLevi; waba ngumphathi wabo bonke abaphathayo iimpahla ezingcwele.
KuMerariya kwaba ngamaqela kaMaheli noMushi. Ezi ziifama zakwaMerariya.
Inani labo, bonke amadoda aneminyaka elishumi elinanye ubudala nangaphezulu, yaba ngamawaka amathandathu anamakhulu mabini.
USuriyeli unyana ka-Abhihayeli, ngukumkani weendlu zakwaMerariya; baya kwenza iintaba ecaleni letente engcwele, emazantsi.
Amadoda aseMerariya aye engqondweni yezitena zendawo engcwele, nezikhonkwane zazo, namatye ayo, neziseko zayo, nazo zonke izinto zalo; babesenza yonke imisebenzi yayo.
namakhonkco entlango ejikeleze kuyo yonke, neziseko zazo, nezingxowa-ntsontelo, neentambo.

UMoses noAron, noonyana baka-Aron, bamisa izikhephe ecaleni lasempumalanga letentyatyambo engcwele, phambi kwentyatyambo yokuhlangana, ijonge ukutshona kwelanga; babe negunya lokugcina indawo engcwele yabaSirayeli. Nabani na oza kuqhawula kuyo kufuneka afile.
Abafazi bonke bakaLevi, abaneminyaka elishumi elinambini ubudala nangaphezulu, ababalolwe nguMoses noAron ngokweemfazwe zabo, ngomyalelo kaYehova, babe ngamawaka amabini anamashumi mabini.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Bhala onke amabhinqa azalwa kuqala kumaSirayeli, eminyaka ilishumi elinamibini ezelwe nangaphezulu, wenze inani lamagama abo.

Yabathatha abaLevi kum, endaweni yazo zonke iziqalekiso zabantwana bakaSirayeli; nezinto eziphilayo zabaLevi, endaweni yazo zonke iziqalekiso zezinto eziphilayo zabantwana bakaSirayeli: mna nguYehova.
UMoses ke wababala bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli abazalwa kuqala, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo.

Inani elipheleleyo lamadoda azalwa kuqala, abeminyaka ilishumi elinambini ezelwe nangaphezulu, ababhalwa ngokwegama labo, yaba ngamawaka angamashumi amabini anesibini, anamakhulu mabini, anamanci asixhenxe namathathu.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Thatha ooLevi endaweni yazo zonke izizalwana zabantwana bakaSirayeli, nezinto eziphilayo zabaLevi endaweni yezinto zabo eziphilayo; babemi bam ooLevi. NdinguYehova.
Baninzi oonyana bakaSirayeli abazalwa kuqala, ngamakhulu amabini anamashumi asixhenxe anesithathu, kuneeLevi; ukuze babuyiselwe.
bathabathe iisekeli zesilivere ezintlanu ngasinye, ngobunzima bendawo engcwele; ibe ziisesekeli ezimashumi mabini ngasinye.
Imali yokubuyisa iinkunzi zebhokhwe ezingaphezulu, uyinike uAron nonyana bakhe.
Wathabatha ke uMoses imali kubo abazalwa kuqala, abo baninzi kunenani labo labaLevi abathatha indawo yabo.
Wathi kubo abazalwa kuqala kwabaSirayeli, athabathe isilivere elinamawaka amathathu anamakhulu amathathu, anamanci amathandathu anesihlanu, ngobunzima bendawo engcwele.
Wazinika ke uMoses lemali kuAron nonyana bakhe, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses noAron, wathi,
Bhala ooKehati phakathi kwabaLevi, ngokweefama zabo, ngezizwe zabo.
Bhala bonke amadoda asuka kuminyaka imashumi mathathu ezelwe, waya kwishumi elinesihlanu elineminyaka yobudala, abaphumayo ukuba basebenzele intetho yokudibana.
Lo ngumsebenzi wabo ooKehati endlwini kakumkani; baya kwenza umsebenzi wezinto ezingcwele kakhulu.
Ke kaloku, xa isihlwele sisiya, uAron nonyana bakhe baya kungena, bakhuphe ifenitshala engaphambili, bagubungele ngayo itekisi yomnqophiso.
Bayifake phezu kwayo intyatyambo yesikhumba esinombala ongwevu, bagubungele ngaphaya kwayo uboya obunombala ongwevu, babeke phantsi iintonga zayo.

Bathi, Ngasentla kwetafile yeentlanzi ezixhonywe phambi koNdikhoyo, bagubungele uboya obubomvu, babeke phezu kwayo izitya, neziqulatho, neebhotile, neengxowa zokudla; isonka esiqhubekayo sihlale phezulu kuyo.
Bazikhuphe phezu kwazo iingubo ezibomvu, bazigqume ngesikhumba esingwevu, bazifake izikhonkwane zayo.
Bathi bathathe uboya obunombala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, bagubungele isibambo selanga, nelanga laso, namagqabi ayo, nezitya zayo, nazo zonke iziqulatho zeoli ezisetyenziswa kuyo.
Baya kuyigubungela, nayo yonke isixhobo sayo, ngesakhelo sesikhumba esiqinileyo; baya kuyibeka phezu kophahla lokuthwala.
Bathi, phezu kwesibingelelo segolide, bagubungele uboya obubomvu, bayiqulethe ngesikhumba esingwevu, bafake izikhonkwane zayo.
Baze bathathe zonke izinto ezisetyenziswayo ekusebenzeni kwindawo engcwele, bazifake emgqomeni omnyama, zizigubungele ngesikhumba esingwevu, bazibeke phezu kophahla.
Bazisuse iinkungu ezisuka kwisibingelelo sentsimbi, bazibhengeze phezu kwayo ngempahla emthubi.

Bazibeke phezu kwayo zonke izinto ezisetyenziswayo kwisibingelelo, iintonga zomlilo, neengcongconi zenyama, neengxowa-mali, neebhotile; bazigqume phezu kwayo intyatyambo yesikhumba esinombala omhle, bazifake khona izibambo zayo.

Ke kaloku, xa uAron nonyana bakhe begqibile ukugubungela izinto ezingcwele, nazo zonke iimpahla ezingcwele, ukuba umkhosi uhambe, baya kungena ooKehati bazithwale; kodwa bangazithembi izinto ezingcwele, ukuze bangafa. Ezi zizinto zetentile yokuhlangana eziya kuzithwala iiKehati.

UElezare, unyana ka-Aron, umbingeleli, uya kuhlala engqondweni ioli yokukhanya, nefuthe elimnandi, nomnikelo wokudla oqhubekayo, neoli yokupheka; yena uya kuhlala engqondweni yonke into engcwele, nazo zonke izinto ezingaphakathi kuyo, indawo engcwele, nezithuthi zayo.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses noAron, wathi,
Musani ukucima iintsapho zakwaKehati phakathi kwabaLevi.
Niyenze le nto kubo, ukuze baphile, bangafanga, xa bedlula ezingcwele kakhulu: uAron nonyana bakhe baya kungena, bamise umntu ngamnye emisebenzini yakhe, nantoni na amele ayithwale.
Ke bona ooKehati bangangeni, bajonge izinto ezingcwele, nakwimizuzu embalwa, ukuze bangafa.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Babalo nabantwana bakaGershoni ngokweentsapho zabo, ngokweenkokheli zabo.
Bhala bonke amadoda asuka kuminyaka imashumi mathathu ezelwe, waya kwishumi elinesihlanu elineminyaka yobudala, abo baphumayo ukuba benze umsebenzi wetente yokudibana.
Le yimisebenzi yeentsapho zakwaGershoni, nemisebenzi yabo, nezithuthi zabo.
Baya kuzithabatha iziteyibhile zetentile engcwele, netentile yokuhlangana yona, nophahla lwayo, nophahla lwayo lwangaphandle lweenwele ezimdaka, nophahla lomngxunya wetentile yokuhlangana;

iziteyibhile zendlu yangasemva, ezijikeleze itente engcwele, nesihlalo somlilo, nesitheyibhile somngcelele wendlu yangasemva, neentonga zayo, nazo zonke izinto ezisetyenziswayo kule nkonzo; nabo baya kwenza yonke le nkonzo.
Wonke umsebenzi wamaGersoni, nokuba kuthuthwa kwempahla okanye ukusetyenziswa kwayo, kufuneka kwenziwe phantsi kolawulo luka-Aron nonyana bakhe; bathethe kubo ngokucacileyo into abamele bayithwale.
Lowo ngumsebenzi weentsapho zakwaGershoni endlwini yokuhlangana, phantsi kolawulo luka-Ithamari, unyana ka-Aron umbingeleli.
Bhala oonyana bakaMerariya ngokweefama zabo, ngosapho lwazo.
Bhala bonke amadoda asuka kuminyaka imashumi mathathu ezelwe, waya kwishumi elinesihlanu elineminyaka yobudala, abaphumayo ukuba basebenzele intetho yokudibana.
Lezi zizinto abaza kuzithabatha, zibe yinxalenye yomsebenzi wabo endlwini kaNdikhoyo: iithayile zetentile engcwele, nemibhobho yayo, nezikhonkwane zayo, neziseko zayo;

nezikhonkwane zendlu yangasemva ejikelezayo, neziqhoboshi zazo, nezibonda zazo, neentonga zayo, neempahla zayo zonke, nazo zonke izinto ezisetyenziswa ngazo; sithi kulowo ngegama lakhe into amele ayithwale.
Lo ngumsebenzi weendlu zakwaMerariya endlwini yokuhlangana, phantsi kolawulo luka-Ithamari, unyana ka-Aron umLevi.
Ke kaloku uMoses noAron, namadoda amakhulu emkhosini, babala ooKehati ngosapho lwabo, ngeentlanga zabo.
Babala bonke amadoda asuka eminyaka imashumi mathathu ezelwe, waya kwiminyaka ilishumi elinambini ezelwe, abaphumayo ukuba basebenze etentweni yokudibana.
Ababalowe ngokweefama zabo, babe ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci mahlanu.
La maqela onke amaKahati, asebenza endlwini kakumkani; uMoses noAron bababala, njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo ngoMoses.
Amadoda aseGershoni abalwa ngamaqela abo, ngosapho lwawo.
Abafazi bonke, abasuka kwiminyaka imashumi mathathu eya kuthi kumakhulu amahlanu eminyaka, abo bafikayo ukuba benze umsebenzi wetente yokuhlangana
ababalolwayo ngokweefama zabo, ngezindlu zabazali babo, babe ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu amathandathu, anamanci mathathu.
Bazo zonke iintsapho zakwaGershoni, ezisebenza endlwini yokuhlangana; uMoses noAron bababala, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo umthetho.
Abathe babalwa oonyana bakaMerariya, ngokweefama zabo, ngezindlu zabazali babo.
Abafazi bonke, abasuka kwiminyaka imashumi mathathu eya kuthi kumakhulu amahlanu eminyaka, abo bafikayo ukuba benze umsebenzi wetente yokuhlangana
ababalolwe ngokweemfazwe zabo, babe ngamawaka amathathu anamakhulu mabini.
La maqela onke oonyana bakaMerari; uMoses noAron bababala, njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngoMoses.
Ke kaloku uMoses noAron, nabathetheli bakaSirayeli, babala ooLevi bonke, ngokweefama zabo, ngokweenkokheli zeentsapho zabo.
Abafazi bonke abasuka kwiminyaka imashumi mathathu eya kuthi iye kwiminyaka ilishumi elinambini, abo bafikayo ukuba benze umsebenzi wokukhonza nokuthabatha endlwini yokuhlangana
baba ngamawaka asibhozo anamakhulu amahlanu, anamanci asibhozo.
Ngokuba iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngomlomo kaMoses, babalwa amadoda onke, banikezelwa umsebenzi wabo, nento abamele bayithwale; babanjwa ke ngoko, njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

Utsho uNdikhoyo kuMoses, uthi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, ukuba bakhuphe ngaphandle komkhosi wonke umntu oneentlungu zesikhumba, wonke umntu onesifo sokuphuma kwegazi emlonyeni wakhe, wonke umntu ongcolileyo ngenxa yokufa.
Nizikhuphe, amadoda nabasetyhini; nizikhuphe ngaphandle komkhosi, ukuze bangabi nesono kumkhosi; kuba mna ndihlala phakathi kwabantu bam.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bayikhuphe ngaphandle komkhosi; njengoko iNkosi wathetha nguMoses.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

Utsho ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, sithi kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli: Xa umntu, nokuba ngumfazi na, esenza into engalunganga kumyeni wakhe, ngayiphi na indlela, baya kukwenza inkohlakalo kuYehova; lo mntu uya kuba nesono.
Ke yena uya kuvuma isono sakhe, esenzayo; abuyisele ngokupheleleyo into yakhe engafanelekanga, aze afake kuyo enye yesihlanu sayo, amnike loo mntu awenzayo.

Ke kaloku, ukuba umphefumlo wakhe ufile, angabikho namnye omele athathe isibonda sakhe, isibonda sakhe siza kuba nguYehova, siya kunikezelwa kumbingeleli; sibe ngaphezu kwebhokhwe yomnquma eyamnikelayo umbingeleli, ukuze abe ngumsindisi kuye.
Zonke ezo zinto zingcwele ezikhethekileyo, oonyana bakaSirayeli abazisayo kumbingeleli, ziyakuba zakhe.
Izinto ezingcwele zomntu ngamnye ziya kuba ziye kuye ukuba azinike; kodwa into enikezelwa kumbingeleli, iya kuba ngumbingeleli.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, sithi kubo: Xa umntu enenkosikazi ephazamisa umfazi wakhe, ehamba ngaphaya kwakhe.

Ke kaloku, ukuba ubhidekile nomntu omnye, umyeni wakhe angaziyo loo nto; ke ngoko, ukuba ubhidekele emlonyeni wakhe, akuyi kubakho mntu owaziyo loo nto, akabikho namnye owaziyo loo nto, akabikho nomnye owaziyo loo nto.
Okanye inkanuko ifike kumyeni wakhe, aze amxelele umfazi wakhe, ukuba yena ke wanyamalala. Okanye inkanuko ifike kuye, aze amxelele umfazi wakhe, ukuba naye akanyamalala;

Kuzo zombini ezi zinto, umfazi uya kuzisa indoda yakhe kumbingeleli, athabathe nesonka sakhe sayo, esinye isiqingatha sekhilogram yobisi lwesiqhamo; angayitshisa ioli ngaso, angayibeka phezu kwayo incinezelo; ngokuba yisonka sokutya sokuzethemba, sisonka sokuveza into engalunganga.
Umbingeleli uya kumtsala umfazi, ambeke phambi koYehova.
Uza kubeka amanzi angcwele kwisitya somhlaba, aze athathe umgubo osuka phantsi kwetentile engcwele, awubeke emanzini.

Umbingeleli uya kumbeka umfazi phambi koYehova, akhuphe iinwele zakhe, abeke emlonyeni wakhe isibingelelo sezinto ezityebileyo sokuzithemba, isibingelelo esibangela ukuba kwenzeke into engalunganga. Umbingeleli uya kuba nezandla zakhe amanzi amabi, abangela ukufa.

Umbingeleli uya kumnqula lo mfazi, athi kuye, Ukuba akukho namnye wamkele wena, ukuba awubikho mntu owenza isono kuwe, ukuba ungabikho umthandi womyeni wakho, ukuze uthabathe isibhakabhaka, akufuneki kubekho nantoni na ngale manzi amdaka abangela ukufa.
Ke kaloku, ukuba uhambe phantsi komyeni wakho, ube nendoda enye ngaphandle komyeni wakho, uye wahlambalaza ngokwakho;

Ke yena umbingeleli uya kumnqula loo mfazi, athi kuye, UYehova akwenze igama lakho libe ngumbulelo kubantu bakho, abe ngumnqulo nobuxoki kubo, ayenze intliziyo yakho ibe phantsi, ibele lakho libe mkhulu.
Ke kaloku la manzi abangela ulamlo, afike entliziyweni yakho, ayenze isibeleko sakho sithe nkqo, ibele lakho litshise. Umfazi ke uthi, Amen; ibe njalo.
Umbingeleli uya kuzibhalela ezi zinto iinyembezi kwibhanti, aziqhoboshele ngamanzi amabi.
uyamxolela loo ndoda amanzi amabi, abangela ukufa; amanzi aya kudlula kuye, abe ngamanzi amabi.
Umbingeleli uya kuthatha emlonyeni womntu idini lesonka sokuzithemba, alizitshisa phambi koYehova, aze azise kwisibingelelo.
Uya kuthatha isandla sakhe esigcweleyo somnikelo wokudla, njengenxalenye emiselweyo, aze ayitshise phezu kwesibingelelo; emva koko uya kumnika umfazi amanzi okusela.

Ke kaloku, ukuba ubhidekile, waphelelwa ngumyeni wakhe; ke xa esela amanzi abangela ilahleko, aya kungena kuye, abe yintlungu ebuhlungu, ibe isibeleko sakhe sithe nkqo, nesibeleko sakhe siphelelwe, ibe igama lakhe liyilahleko phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Ke kaloku, ukuba lo mfazi akabi nenyameko, kodwa ucocekile, akuyi kubakho nantoni na emngciphekweni wakhe; uya kuzala.
Ke kaloku, lo ngumfundiso wobuxoki. Kuba xa umfazi ephelelwa ngumyeni wakhe, echaphazela ngokwakhe,
okanye xa kuthe kwathiwa ngumntu, ukuba uthandana nomfazi wakhe; ke uya kumbeka phambi koYehova; umbingeleli uya kwenza konke okuthethwa ngaloo mthetho.
Ke yena umfazi uya kuhlala ekhuselekile; ke yena umfazi uza kuthwala isono sakhe.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, sithi kubo: Lithethani nabantwana bakaSirayeli, nithi kubo, Xa umntu, nokuba ngumfazi okanye ngumntu, esenza isibingelelo esikhethekileyo, ukuba abe nguNazireli kuYehova,

Umele ahlale efihlakele kwiwayini, nakwezinye iziselo ezithambileyo; umele angcolisi iswekile eyenziwe ngewayini, nakwezinye iziselo ezithambileyo; umele angcokisi ijusi yeentyatyambo, angadle iintyatyambo, nokuba zitsha okanye zitshizi.
Ngazo zonke iintsuku zobuNazireli bakhe, angadla nantoni na ephuma kwisityalo seentyatyambo, nokuba yimbewu okanye iinwele.

Ngazo zonke iintsuku zobuxoki bakhe, akufuneki ukuba iinwele zomqolo zithabathe intloko yakhe; kude kube kugqityiwe ixesha lakhe elilungiselelwe iNkosi, uya kuba ngumbingeleli; kufuneka avumele iinwele zentloko yakhe zikhule.
Ngazo zonke iintsuku eziya kugqibwa ukuba abe ngumbingeleli kaYehova, angeke afike kumphefumlo ofileyo.
Ukuba utata wakhe, okanye umama wakhe, okanye unyana wakhe, okanye inkosikazi yakhe, bafa, akayi kuhlambalaza ngenxa yabo; ngokuba iNazirethi kaThixo iya phezulu entliziyweni yakhe.
Zonke iintsuku zobuNazireli bakhe, ungcwele kuYehova.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu efa ngaphaya kwakhe ngento engalindelekanga, ibe iinwele zakhe ezimde zithi zibi; ngomhla wokucoceka kwakhe uya kuzila intloko yakhe, ngomhla wesixhenxe.
Ngomhla wesibhozo uya kuzithabatha iintaka ezibini, okanye iintlanzi ezimbini ezincinci, aze aziveze kumbingeleli, emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana.

Umbingeleli uya kunikela enye ibe yidini lesono, nenye ibe yidini eliqhutywa limlilo, ukuze amlungisa phambi koYehova, ngenxa yobuxoki bakhe, ngenxa yokuba wadlula ekufaneni nomhlaza; ngoko ke umele angcwelele intloko yakhe ngaloo mini.

Uya kuphinda athabathe isibonda sakhe kuYehova imihla epheleleyo yegunya lakhe, aze athathe inkunzi yenkomo yomnyaka mnye ibe ngumnikelo wesono; iintsuku zangaphambili azibaloki, ngokuba imihla yakhe yokuthabathela isibonda yayingenakucoceka.
Lo ngumthetho weNazirethi, xa zigqityiwe iintsuku zeNazirethi yakhe; kufuneka athathelwe emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana.

Athabathe khona iminikelo yakhe kuYehova: inkunzi yenkomo yonyaka omnye, engabikho monakalo kuyo, ibe ngumnikelo womlilo; inkunzi yebhokhwe yonyaka omnye, engabikho monakalo kuyo, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; umnqamlezo, ongabikho monakalo kuwo, ibe ngumnikelo wesono.
Ke kaloku athabathe ibhotile yesonka esingenasiqhamo, iziqholo zesikhunta esixutywe neoli, neziqholo ezimxinwa zixutywe neoli, nomnikelo wazo wokudla, nomnikelo wazo wokusela.
Umbingeleli uya kuzinikela ngazo phambi koYehova, alungiselele idini lesono, nedini eliqhutywa ngumlilo.
Uyamnikela unyana womntu, ibe ngumnikelo woxolo kuYehova, kunye nebhotile yesonka esingenawo umgubo; naye umbingeleli uya kumnikela umnikelo wayo wesono, nomnikelo wayo wokusela.
Ke kaloku umNazireli, ekungeneni kwetentile yokuhlangana, kufuneka athabathe iinwele zakhe zeNazireli, aze azifake emngxunyeni phantsi komnikelo wokudla.

Ke kaloku, emva kokuba uNazireli awele iinwele zakhe, umbingeleli uya kuyibeka emlonyeni wakhe intamo ecocekileyo yomnquma, nomgubo owodwa ongenamxube wesonka osuka kwibhotile, nomxube omnye ongenamxube.

Umbingeleli uya kuzitshisa phambi koYehova, zibe ngumnikelo wokuziqhelanisa; zingcwele, ziye kumbingeleli, kunye neentliziyo ezishiyiweyo, nemilenze enikezelweyo; emva koko uNazireyi angasela iwayini.

Lowo ngumthetho weNazirethi, owenza isibingelelo, ngomnikelo wakhe onokuwunikela kuYehova ngenxa yobulungisa bakhe, ngaphandle kwayo yonke into enokuyenza isandla sakhe; nantoni na ayifumeneyo, kufuneka ayiphumeze ngokwemithetho yeNazirethi.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho kuAron noonyana bakhe, usithi, Ngale ndlela niza kubambisa oonyana bakaSirayeli. Nithi kubo,
UYehova akubhiyozele, akukhuselele.
UYehova aphumle kuwe, abe nobubele kuwe.
UYehova akubonele uncedo, akunike ubulungisa.
Ngale ndlela baya kubeka igama lam phezu kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; ndiya kubasindisa.
Ke kaloku, uMoses egqibile ukumisela itentile, wayiphazamisa, wayenza ibe ngcwele, nayo yonke into yayo; nesihlalo somlilo nazo zonke izinto zayo, wabaphazamisa, wazenza zibe ngcwele.
Ke kaloku abathetheli bakaSirayeli banikela ngaloo mini; abo ke babe ziintloko zeentsapho, abathetheli bezizwe, ababezilawula ezi zinto zamanani.

Bazisa isipho sabo kuYehova, izithuthi ezisixhenxe ezigqunyiweyo, neenkomo ezilishumi elinambini; isithuthi ngasinye ngamadoda amakhulu amabini, nenkomo nganye nganye; bazisa phambi kwetenki engcwele.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Zithatheni kubo, ukuze zisetyenziswe kumsebenzi wentinganiso yokuhlangana; nizinike kumaLevi, ngamalungu onke, ngokwemimiselo yabo yokusebenza.
Wathabatha ke uMoses izithuthi, neenkomo, waza wazisa kumaLevi.
Iimoto ezimbini, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezine, wabanika ooGershoni, ngokwenkonzo yabo;
iinqanawa ezine, neenkomo ezisibhozo, zaba oonyana bakaMerariya, ngokwemisebenzi yabo; basebenza phantsi kolawulo luka-Ithamari, unyana kaAron umLevi.
Ke kaloku ooKehati uMoses awazinika nanye; ngokuba babezilungisa izinto ezingcwele, bezithabatha ngasemqolo wabo.
Ke kaloku, xa idini elingcwele liqhutywa ngeoli, abathetheli bazisa izipho zokuzinikela kuyo; babeka izipho zabo phambi kwesibingelelo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Umlawuli ngamnye kufuneka anikezele umvuzo wakhe ngemini nganye, ukulungiselela isibingelelo.
Ngomhla wokuqala wanikela uNahshon, unyana ka-Amminadab, wesizwe sikaYuda, ngesipho sakhe.

Isonka sakhe sakuba sisitya esinye sesilivere, esiyishumi elinamashumi mathathu eeshekeli, nebhotile enye yesilivere, esiyishumi elinesixhenxe leeshekeli, ngokweshekeli yendawo engcwele; zombini zazigcwele ubisi olucoliweyo olwenziwe ngeoyile, ibe ngumnikelo wokudla.
Wanikela nebhotile enye yegolide, isisindo sayo seshekeli ezilishumi, egcwele uvumba;
inkunzi yenkomo enye, umkhweli omnye, unyana womntwana oneminyaka elishumi elinambini yomnikelo wokushiswa;
ibhokhwe enye ibe lidini lesono;

nesonka samadini oxolo, inkunzi yebhokhwe ezimbini, iinkomo ezintlanu, iintombi zegusha ezintlanu, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezineminyaka elishumi elinambini ubudala ezintlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo kaNahshon unyana ka-Aminadabu.
Ngomhla wesibini wanikela uNethaneli, unyana kaSuwari, ukumkani wakwa-Issakare.

Isonka sakhe sakuba sisitya esinye sesilivere, esiyishumi elinamashumi mathathu eeshekeli, nebhotile enye yesilivere, esiyishumi elinesixhenxe leeshekeli, ngokweshekeli yendawo engcwele; zombini zazigcwele ubisi olucoliweyo olwenziwe ngeoyile, ibe ngumnikelo wokudla.
Wanikela nebhotile enye yegolide, isisindo sayo seshekeli ezilishumi, egcwele uvumba;
inkunzi yenkomo enye, umkhweli omnye, unyana womntwana oneminyaka elishumi elinambini yomnikelo wokushiswa;
ibhokhwe enye ibe lidini lesono;

nesonka samadini oxolo, inkunzi yebhokhwe ezimbini, iinkomo ezintlanu, iintombi zegusha ezintlanu, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezineminyaka emibini ubudala ezintlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo kaNethaneli unyana kaSuwari.
Ngomhla wesithathu wanikela uEliyaba, unyana kaHelon, umlawuli wamaZabuloni, ngomnikelo wakhe.

Ngomhla wesithoba wanikela uAbidan, unyana kaGideoni, umthetheli weendoda zaseBhenjamin.

Ngomhla wesixhenxe wanikela uAhiyezere, unyana ka-Amishatayi, umphathi weendoda zaseDan.

inkunzi yenkomo enye, umkhweli omnye, unyana womntwana oneminyaka elishumi elinambini yomnikelo wokushiswa;

Ngomhla weshumi elinesibini wanikela uPagiyeli, unyana kaOhrani, ukumkani wabafazi baka-Ashere.

Wanikela nebhotile enye yegolide, isisindo sayo seshekeli ezilishumi, egcwele uvumba;
inkunzi yenkomo enye, umkhweli omnye, unyana womntwana oneminyaka elishumi elinambini yomnikelo wokushiswa;
ibhokhwe enye ibe lidini lesono;
nesonka samadini oxolo, inkunzi yebhokhwe ezimbini, iinkomo ezintlanu, iintombi zeegusha ezintlanu, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezineminyaka emihlanu ubudala. Lowo ngumnikelo kaPagiyeli unyana kaOkran.
Ngomhla weshumi elinesibini wanikela uAhira, unyana ka-Enani, umthetheli wamaNafetali.

Wanikela nebhotile enye yegolide, isisindo sayo seshekeli ezilishumi, egcwele uvumba;
inkunzi yenkomo enye, umkhweli omnye, unyana womntwana oneminyaka elishumi elinambini yomnikelo wokushiswa;
ibhokhwe enye ibe lidini lesono;
nesonka samadini oxolo, inkunzi yebhokhwe ezimbini, neenkomo ezintlanu, iinkunzi zeegusha ezintlanu, iintlanzi ezineminyaka emihlanu ubudala ezintandathu. Lowo ngumnikelo ka-Ahira unyana ka-Enani.

Lezo zizinto zabathetheli bakaSirayeli, zokulungiselela isibingelelo, ngomhla wokunqunyulwa kwayo ngeoli: izitya zesilivere ezilishumi elinambini, neziqwengana zesilivere ezilishumi elinambini, namacwecwe egolide alishumi elinambini.

Intonga nganye yesilivere yaba yishekeli elinamawaka amathathu, ibhotile nganye ibe yishekeli elinamashumi asixhenxe; zonke izitya zesilivere zaba ziishekeli ezilishumi elinambini, ngeshekeli engcwele.

Iibhotile zegolide ezilishumi elinambini, ezigcwele uvumba, isisindo sazo ngasinye saba ngamashekeli amabini, ngokweshekeli yendawo engcwele; zonke iibhotile zegolide zaba ngamashekeli amakhulu mabini.

Izinto eziphilayo zesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi ziingelosi ezilishumi elinambini, iinkunzi zeenkomo eziyishumi elinesibini, iintombi ezineminyaka emibini ubudala ezilishumi elinambini, nezipho zazo zokupheka; izimvu zezimvu ezilishumi elinambini zaba ngumnikelo wosono.

Iinyama zesonka soxolo zaba ziinkunzi zeenkomo ezimashumi mabini anane, nezimvu ezingamakhulu asixhenxe, neebhokhwe ezingamakhulu alisithandathu, neenkukhu ezineminyaka ilishumi elinamithandathu ezindala. Lowo ngumnikelo wokuzinikela kwesibingelelo emva kokuyitywina.

Ke kaloku, xa uMoses ephuma etentweni yokuhlangana, ukuba athethe naye iNkosi, wayeva ilizwi lithetha kuye phezulu kwisigqubuthelo esibekwe phezu kwetsimbi yomnqophiso, phakathi kwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezinemilebe emibini. Wathetha ke iNkosi kuye ngaloo ndlela.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Uthi kuAron, Xa umisa izibane ezisixhenxe, ziya kukhanya phambi kwesibambo selanga.
Wenza ke uAron njalo; wamisa izibane, ukuze zikhanya phambi kwesibambo selanga, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo uMoses.
Wayenza ibe yigolide, eyenziwe ngentsimbi engenasici, ibekwe phantsi kwayo, ibe ziintyatyambo zayo. UMoses wayenza ngokwesimo iNkosi wambonisayo.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yathi ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, Yamkela abaLevi phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, ubahlanze.
Oku kukuthi, ukuba bacocwe: uthabathe amanzi okuhlamba phezu kwabo; babe neentloko zabo zonke, bahlamba iimpahla zabo, bacoceke.
Bathi bathathe inkunzi yenkomo encinci, nesonka sayo sokudla, ingqolowa encinane eyotywe ngeoyile; uthabathe inkunzi yenkomo encinci yesibini ibe lidini lesono.
Yazisa amaLevi phambi kwetenki yokuhlangana, uhlanganise khona ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli.
Nciphisa ooLevi phambi koYehova; abantwana bakaSirayeli babeke izandla zabo kubo.
UAron uya kubanika abaLevi umnikelo wokuqhutywa kuYehova, esuka kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, ukuze benze umsebenzi kaYehova.
Babeke ke amaLevi izandla zabo phezu kweentloko zeentokhwe; ulungiselele enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, nenye ibe ngumnikelo womlilo kuYehova, ukuze alungise amaLevi phambi koThixo.
Yabeka amaLevi phambi kukaAron noonyana bakhe, athabathe abo balishumi elinambini, abe ngumnikelo wokuqhutywa kuYehova.
Ngoko ke uya kubahlula abaLevi phakathi kwabanye abantu bakaSirayeli, ukuze babe bamnye uLevi.
Ke kaloku, emva kokuba uzihlambulule, uze uzixhoboze zibe ngumnikelo wokuqhutywa, baya kungena amaLevi ukuba asebenze endlwini kaYehova.
Ke kaloku baya kuba ngumnikelo wam opheleleyo phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; ndibathathe ukuba babe nam, endaweni yazo zonke iintsana ezizalwa kuqala ebantwini bakaSirayeli.
Yonke into ezalwa kuqala kuSirayeli, nokuba ngumntu, nokuba yinyama, yinyani yam; ngaloo mini ndazibulala zonke izinto ezizalwa kuqala eYiputa, ndazimisela ukuba zinguye.
Ndibathathe abaLevi endaweni yabo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli abazalwa kuqala.

Ke kaloku, ndibanika ooLevi umnikelo kuAron noonyana bakhe, phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli bonke, ukuba basebenzele abantwana bakaSirayeli endlwini kakumkani, ukuze benze ukuxolelwa kwabo; ukuze kungabikho monakalo phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, xa befika kwindawo engcwele.
UMoses noAron, nebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, bawenza kubo ooLevi konke oko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngawo uMoses.
Ke kaloku abaLevi bacocwa, bahlamba iimpahla zabo; uAron wabanika ukuba babe ngumnikelo wokuqhutywa phambi koYehova, wabalungisa kuThixo wabo, ukuze bacocwe.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, bafika amaLevi ukuba asebenze endlwini yokuhlangana, phantsi kwesandla sika-Aron nonyana bakhe; njengokuba iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses, ngoko bawenza kumaLevi.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Leyo ke imithetho yabaLevi: Abafazi abaneminyaka emashumi mabini anesihlanu ubudala nangaphezulu baya kungena, ukuba basebenze endlwini yokuhlangana.
Xa beneminyaka engama-50 ubudala kufuneka baphume kumsebenzi wabo oqhelekileyo kwaye bayeke ukukhonza.
Baye bancedise abazalwana babo ekusebenzeni kwabo endlwini yokuhlangana; bona ke bangasebenzi; ngoko ke niya kwenza ukuba kube njalo ekusebenzeni kwabaLevi.
Ngomnyaka wesibini, emva kokuba abantwana bakaSirayeli bephuma eYiputa, ngomhla wesithathu wenyanga yokuqala, iNkosi wathi kuMoses esiqwini saseSinai, esithi,
Abantu bakaSirayeli bamele benze iPasha ngexesha layo elimiselweyo.
Niyigcine ngexesha layo, ngomhla weshumi elinesine wale nyanga, xa ilanga liphuma; niyenze yonke imimiselo yayo nemimiselo yayo.
Wathi ke uMoses kubantwana bakaSirayeli, ukuba benze iPasha.
Bayenza eYiputa, eSinayin, ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga yokuqala, xa ilanga liphuma; bayenze ke oonyana bakaSirayeli ngokwezinto zonke iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngazo uMoses.
Ke kaloku kwakukho amadoda athile, ayengacocekanga ngenxa yokuba athabathe umphefumlo womntu ofileyo; ngoko ke akakwazi ukwenza iPasha ngaloo mini. Bafika kuMoses noAron ngaloo mini.
