bathi, Singcolile ngenxa yokuba sitshise umntu ofileyo; kutheni ke ukuba sithintelwe ekubeni sinikezele umnikelo kaYehova ngexesha elimiselweyo phakathi kwabaSirayeli?
Wathi kubo uMoses, Nceda nilinde apha, ndibone ukuba iNkosi uya kunimisa ntoni.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Balala oonyana bakaSirayeli, usithi, Ukuba kukho umntu kuni nakweyiphi na intsapho yenu, ongekho mthethweni ngenxa yomhlaza, okanye ehamba uhambo olude, niyigcine iPasha kuYehova.
Kunyaka wesibini, ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga, xa ilanga liphuma, niyenze; niyidle inkunzi yenkomo nesonka esingenamxube, neziqhamo ezibi.
Musani kushiya nantoni na kuyo ukuya emveni kwemini, musani ukutshisa nantoni na yemithambo yayo; nizigcine zonke izithembiso zePasika.

Ke kaloku, xa umntu ecocekileyo, engahamba ngendlela, engayenzanga iPasika, lo mntu uya kucinywa phakathi kwabantu bakhe; akunikelanga umnikelo kaYehova kwixesha lakhe elimiselweyo; yena athabathe isono sakhe.

Ke kaloku, ukuba uthile ohlala phakathi kwenu efuna ukwenza iPasha kuYehova, kufuneka ayenze ngokwemimiselo yayo, nakwemithetho yayo; iya kuba yinyaniso loo nto kuye, nokuba ungumnye umntu ovela kweli lizwe.

Ngomhla wokubeka itentile engcwele, uvulindlela lwaluyigubungela le tabernakele yomthetho womnqophiso; ukususela emveni kwemini ukuya emveni kwemini, kwakukho ukubonakala komlilo kulufulekilelo lwetentile.
Kwaba njalo mihla le; icloudi yayigubungela ngemini, ngobusuku ukubonakala kwayo kwakufana nomlilo.
Ke kaloku, xa ifuthe linyuka lisuka phezu kwetentile, abantwana bakaSirayeli bahamba; apho ifuthe lihlala khona, abantwana bakaSirayeli bamisa iintaba.
Ngomyalelo kaYehova bahamba oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngomyalelo kaYehova bamisa iintaba; zonke iintsuku ezihlala khona ifuthe phezu kwetenki engcwele, bemisa iintaba.
Ke kaloku, xa ifuthe lihlala ixesha elide phezu kwetentile, oonyana bakaSirayeli baphulaphula ulizwi likaYehova, bangahamba.
Kwabakho amaxesha apho ifuthe lihlala phezu kwetentile imihla embalwa; ngomthetho kaYehova behlala emkhosini, ngomthetho wakhe behamba.
Kwabakho amaxesha apho ifuthe lihlala khona ukususela emveni kwemini ukuya emini; xa likhupha ngasekuseni, besiya; nokuba ngubusuku okanye ngobusuku, xa likhupha ifuthe, besiya.
Nokuba limini ezimbini, nokuba linyanga enye, nokuba linyaka omnye, ukuba ifuthe lihlala phezu kwetentile, oonyana bakaSirayeli bahlala ezindaweni zabo, bangahamba; ke kaloku, xa linyuka, bayahamba.
Ngomyalelo kaYehova bamisa iintaba, ngomyalelo kaYehova bahamba; baphulaphule umyalelo kaYehova, njengoko wayewiselayo ngesandla sikaMoses.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yenza iintsontelo ezimbini zesilivere, eziqhutywa ngesandla; zibe zisetyenziswa ukubiza isihlwele, ukuze zixelele izikhululo ukuba zingahamba.
Ke kaloku, xa kuqhutywa izithunywa ezibini, ibandla lonke lihlangane phambi kwakho kumngxunya wetente yokudibana.
Ke kaloku, xa kuqhutywa intsimbi enye kuphela, bahlangane phambi kwakho abathetheli, oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, xa iinkunzi zebhokhwe zivuza ngelizwi elinamandla, izizwe ezisenkundleni ecaleni lasempuma ziya kuhamba.
Xa isilumkiso siphuma kabini, izizwe ezisecaleni lasempuma kufuneka ziphume. Isilumkiso siya kuba sisilumkiso sokuhamba.
Ke kaloku, xa ubiza abantu ukuba bahlangane ndawonye, phefumla ngeebhokhwe, ungavumeli ukuba kubekho umsindo.
Oonyana baka-Aron, ababingeleli, baya kuzidubula izithunywa zentsimbi. Lo ngumthetho ohlala ixesha elide kuni, nakwazo zonke iintsapho zenu ezizayo.
Xa niphumani emkhosini, ezweni lenu, kunihlasela umqolo wakho owenza ubundlobongela kuwe, niza kutyhila izithunywa zentsimbi; iNkosi uThixo wenu uya kukukhumbula, aze akusindise emehlweni omabi akho.

Nakwientsuku zenu ezithandekayo, nakwiimikhosi yenu emiselweyo, nangemva kwenyanga nganye, niphule izidumbu phezu kwezibingelelo zenu eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zenu zoxolo; zibe ngukumbuso kuThixo wenu. Ndiye iNkosi uThixo wenu.
Ngomnyaka wesibini, ngenyanga yesibini, ngomhla wama-20 wonyaka, ifumene isibhakabhaka phezu kwetentile yomthetho womnqophiso.
Bahamba ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, besuka embindini weSinayi, besiya embindini weSinayi; sathi isibhakabhaka sihlala embindini weParan.
Lo ngumhla wabo wokuqala wokuhamba, ngokwemiyalelo kaYehova ngesandla sikaMoses.
Basuka kuqala amaqela emiyalelo yomkhosi, umkhosi kaYuda; uNahshon unyana ka-Aminadabhi waba ngukumkani walo mkhosi.
NguNethaneli unyana kaSuwari waba ngukumkani womkhosi wesizwe samaSirayeli.
NguEliyaba unyana kaHeloni, waba ngukumkani womkhosi wesizwe sikaZebulon.
Ke kaloku itentile engcwele yasuswa; basuka ke ooGershoni noMerariya, abayithabathayo.
Ke kaloku basuka amaqela emiyalelo yesizwe samaRubhen; uElisuri unyana kaShedeure waba ngukumkani womkhosi.
UShelumiyeli unyana kaZurishaddayi waba ngukumkani womkhosi wesizwe sikaSimeoni.
UEliyasafe unyana kaDehuyeli waba ngukumkani womkhosi wesizwe sikaGadi.
Basuka ke ooKehati, bethwala izinto ezingcwele; itente engcwele yabekwa phantsi phambi kokuba bafike.
Ke kaloku basuka amaqela emikhosi, ngophawu lwesixeko sikaEfrayim; noElishama unyana ka-Amihudi waba ngukumkani womkhosi.
UGamaliyeli unyana kaPedashuri waba ngukumkani womkhosi wesizwe sikaManase.
UAbidan unyana kaGideoni waba ngukumkani womkhosi wesizwe sikaBhenjamin.
Ke kaloku, ekupheleni kwabo bonke, basuka amaqela emiyalelo yomkhosi womkhosi kaDan, abe ngasemva kuwo onke amagatsha; uAhiyezere unyana ka-Ammishadaya waba ngukumkani walo mkhosi.
NguPagiyeli unyana kaOkran, waba ngukumkani womkhosi wesizwe sika-Ashere.
NguAhira unyana kaEnani waba ngukumkani womkhosi wesizwe samaNafetali.
Leyo ke imiyalelo yokuhamba kwemikhosi yamaSirayeli, xa besuka.

Wathi uMoses kuHobab, unyana kaRehuyeli, umkakhe uMoses, umMidiyani, Siyahamba siye kwindawo iNkosi wathi uya kusinika yona. Yiya nathi, siza kukusebenzela kakuhle; ngokuba iNkosi wathetha izinto ezilungileyo kumaSirayeli;
Wathi ke uHobab, Andiyi kuhamba; ndiya kubuyela ezweni lam, nakwilizwe lamaqela am.
Wathi ke uMoses, Nceda, musa ukusishiya; kuba wena uyayazi indawo yethu yokutyibilika emlilweni, ube ngumqondiso wethu.
Ukuba ke uya kungena nathi, siya kudibana nawe kuzo zonke izinto ezilungileyo iNkosi azenzayo.
Basuka ke emnqamlezweni kaYehova, bahamba iintsuku ezintathu; ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova yahamba phambi kwabo iintsuku ezintathu, ukubabalungiselele indawo yokuphumla.
Ifuthe likaYehova laliba phezulu kwabo ngemini, xa besuka emkhosini.
Ke kaloku, xa intonga yomnqophiso iphuma, uMoses wathi, Yiya phezulu, Nkosi, bakhutshwe abathunywa bakho; bahambe phambi kwakho abo bakuxolayo.
Ke kaloku, xa ihlala khona, wathi, Buya, Nkosi, kumawaka amaninzi kaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku abantu baqala ukuxoka ngenxa yobunzima babo. UYehova wabava; waza, akubona oko, waxhaphaza; umlilo osuka kuYehova wawungcwaba phakathi kwabo, watshisa iziphelo zesixeko.
Bathi ke abantu kuye uMoses; wathandaza uMoses kuYehova, waza umnxeba wawulahla.
Igama lendawo leyo labizwa ngokuba yiTabera; ngokuba umlilo osuka kuYehova wawutshisa phakathi kwabo.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli, abahlala phakathi kwabo, baqala ukufuna isonka; ke oonyana bakaSirayeli baqhubeka bekhala, bathi, Kungekhe sibe nenyama siyidle!
Siyazikhumbula iintlanzi, esidla ngazo simahla eYiputa, neentyatyambo, nee-melon, neentyatyambo ze-lemon, neentyatyambo zesonka, neengcambu.
Ke kaloku ngoku silahlekile ukutya kwethu; singabona nantoni na ngaphandle kwaloo mana.
I-manna yayifana neentyatyambo ezincinci zesiqhamo se-coriander, inkangeleko yayo ibifana notywala olumnyama.

Ke kaloku abantu bahamba, beyiqoqa; bayitshisa ngemibhobho yesandla, okanye bayitshise ngamatye, bayicoce emakhayeni, okanye bayilungiselele imifuno ethe tyaba; ibe yintyatyambo yayo njengentyatyambo yobisi.
Ke kaloku ngemini, xa umhlwa ehla phezu komkhosi, i-manna yawela nayo.
Wava ke uMoses ukuba zonke iintsapho zivuya, umntu ngamnye emngxunyeni wetente yakhe. UYehova waxhaphaza kakhulu, uMoses waba neentloni.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, Kutheni na ukuba ndinikhokelele le nto ibuhlungu, mkhonzi wakho? Ndiyenze ntoni na, ukuze uzive unyanzeleka, ukuba ubeke kum umthwalo wabo bonke abantu?

Ndiye ndabazala na abantu aba bonke, ndibangenise ehlabathini, ukuba utsho nam ukuba ndiwathabatha emlonyeni wam, njengokuba umxolelayo ethwala umntwana omncinci, ukuya kweli lizwe, owalithetha ooyise babo?
Ndiya kufumana phi inyama kubo bonke abantu aba? Bathi kum, Nisinikele inyama ukuba siyidle.
Andikwazi ukuthwala aba bantu bonke mna kuphela; kuba lukhulu kakhulu ubunzima kum.
Ukuba ndiya kwenza njalo kum, mnikele ke ngoku, ukuba uthandana nam; musa kundishiya ndijonge ingozi yam. Wathi iNkosi kuYakobi:

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yazisa kum amadoda angamashumi asixhenxe aphakathi kwabakhulu bakaSirayeli, oomfazi owaziyo ukuba ngamadoda amakhulu, nabalawuli phakathi kwabantu; ubaveze endlwini yokuhlangana, bahlale khona nawe.
Ndiya kuhla, ndithetha nawe khona apho; ndiza kuthatha kumphefumlo okho phezu kwakho, ndiwubeke kubo; baya kukuthwala nawe umthwalo wabo bonke abantu, ukuze ungayithwali wena kuphela.

Uthi kubo abantu, Nizingcweleni, niyilungiselele imini, xa nidla inyama; iNkosi wava intloko yenu, esithi, Ndiyakuthanda ukuba sibe nenyama yokutya! Kwakungcono kuthi eYiputa. Ke ngoko, ngoku iNkosi uya kukunika inyama, niyidle.
Musani ukuyidla imini enye, okanye imihla emibini, okanye imihla emihlanu, okanye imihla elishumi, okanye imihla emashumi mabini;
kodwa iinyanga ezipheleleyo, de ziphume emlonyeni wenu, nizixolele; ngenxa yokuba ningamthobeli iNkosi ophakathi kwenu, naphezu koko nanikheni kuye, nisithi, Siphuma njani eYiputa?
Wathi uMoses, Namhlanje ndimi phakathi kwamawaka angamakhulu amathandathu ahamba ngeenyawo; wena ke usithi, Ndiya kubanika inyama ukuba bayidle iinyanga zonke.
Ingaba kuya kuthethwa ngazo zonke iinkomo nezimvu? Ingaba iya kuthethwa ngazo zonke iintlanzi zaselwandle? Ingaba iya kuthethwa ngazo zonke iintlanzi zelwandle?
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Ingaba amandla am ancinane kakhulu? Ngoku uya kubona ukuba ilizwi lam liza kubakho na, okanye alizukubakho.
Waphuma ke uMoses, wabaxelela abantu amazwi kaYehova; wahlanganisa abathetheli babo abamashumi asixhenxe, wawabeka ecaleni kwetenki.

Wahla ke iNkosi kwifuthe, wathetha noMoses; wathabatha emphefumlweni osuka kuMoses, wawabeka phezu kwabathetheli abamashumi asixhenxe. Ke kaloku, xa umphefumlo waba phezulu kwabo, baprofetisa, kodwa abaye bayiphinda le nto.
Ke kaloku kwabakho amadoda amabini asele emkhosini, uElada noMedada; babemi kuluhlu lwabathetheli, kodwa bebengaphumanga etentweni. Wathi uMoya waba phezu kwabo nabo, baprofetisa phakathi komkhosi.
Ke kaloku umntu omncinane wabaleka, wamxelela uMoses, esithi, UEldade noMedade baprofetisa emkhosini.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa, unyana kaNun, umkhonzi kaMoses ukususela ekubeni ngumntwana, waphendula wathi, Musa, nkosi yam, ubathintele.
Wathi ke uMoses, Ingaba unayo inkanuko kum? Ndinqwenele ukuba bonke abantu bakaYehova babe ngabaprofeti; ukuba iNkosi abe ngumphefumlo wakhe kubo bonke.
Wabuyela ke uMoses, namadoda amakhulu kaSirayeli, endlwini yesixeko.
Wathumela iNkosi umoya, wazisa iinkomo ezisuka elwandle; zazikhupha phantsi zijikeleze yonke inqaba, ngaphaya kwendlela yemihla ngemihla, ngapha nangaphaya; zaba yimiqulu encinane emhlaba.

Ke kaloku abantu baphuma yonke loo mini nobusuku, nosuku lonke olulandelayo, beqoqa iinkomo; akukho namnye wabaqokelelayo ngaphantsi kweelitha ezilishumi elinambini; bazibhengeza zishushu phezu komhlaba jikelele endlwini yokulwa.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa inyama ikhona emlonyeni wabo, phambi kokuba bayitshise, iNkosi wagweba abantu, wababulala ngomhlaza omkhulu kakhulu.
Ke kaloku igama lendawo leyo labizwa ngokuba yiKibrothi-hataava, ngenxa yokuba bathabathela khona abantu abafunayo ukudla.
Basuka ke abantu eKibrothi-hataava, bahamba besiya eHazerothi, bahlala khona.
Ke kaloku uMiriyam noAron bathetha ngoMoses, ngenxa yomfazi waseKushi awayewamkela; ngokuba wayewamkela indoda yaseKushi.
Bathi, UYehova uthetha njani ngesandla sikaMoses kuphela? Akathethi na nathi? Wazi iNkosi amazwi abo.
Ke kaloku uMoses waba ngumntu othambileyo kakhulu; wayethambileyo kunabo bonke abantu bomhlaba.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wathi kuMoses, noAron, noMiriyam, Ngaphaya kwenu nithathu, phumani etentweni yokuhlangana. Baphuma ke bona abathathu.
Ke kaloku wahla iNkosi emholweni wefuthe, wahlala emehlweni etentile; wayalela uAron noMiriyam; bafika ke bonke ababini.
Wathi ke iNkosi, Nceda nicinge ngale nto ndithethayo: Xa kukho umprofeti phakathi kwenu, mna, iNkosi, ndiya kubonakala kuye ngemiboniso, ndithetha naye ngephupha.
UMoses, umkhonzi wam, akabi njalo; ungumntu othembekileyo endlwini yam yonke.
Ndithetha naye ngobuso nobuso, ngokucacileyo, hayi ngeengcamango; yena ke ubona ubuso bukaYehova. Ngaba ke ningaze nikhathazeke ukuba nithethe ngomkhonzi wam uMoses?
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxoka kakhulu kubo, waya.
Ke kaloku, xa ifu lenyuka lisuka phezu kwetentile, kwabonakalisa ulusu lukaMiriyam ulwaphulo-mthetho olumhlophe njengekhephu. Wajika uAron waya kuye, wabona ke ukuba ulusu lwakhe lulwaphulo-mthetho.
Wathi kuMoses, Nceda, nkosi yam, musa ukusibeka phezu kwethu isono esinjalo, sisenzayo ngokungaphaya kokuqonda.
Musani ukumenza ukuba abe njengonyana ozalwa efileyo, enesiqingatha senyama yakhe sidlalwe.
UMoses wathandaza kuYehova, esithi, Thixo, mncede uphilise.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Ukuba umyeni wakhe wayemxolela emlonyeni wakhe, akabikho ekhohlakeleyo iintsuku ezisixhenxe? Uyibeke ngaphandle komkhosi iintsuku ezisixhenxe; emva koko uya kungena.
Ke kaloku uMiriyam wagcinwa ngaphandle komkhosi iintsuku ezisixhenxe; abantu ke abasukanga, de wambuyisele.
Emva koko, abantu basuka eHaserothi, bamisa iintaba emhlabathini omnyama waseParan.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yithumelele abantu ukuba bajonge ilizwe laseKanan, endililinika oonyana bakaSirayeli; niyithumelele inkulungwane nganye yeentsapho zabazali babo.
Wabathumela ke uMoses ezweni elingaziwayo laseParan, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo; bonke babe ngabathetheli phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Lemi amagama abo: kwisizwe sikaRubhen, nguShamuwa unyana kaZakhuri.
Kwisizwe sikaSimeoni, nguShafati unyana kaHori.
Kwisizwe sikaYuda, nguKalebe unyana kaYefune.
Kwisizwe sika-Isakare, nguIgali unyana kaYosefu.
kwisizwe sikaEfraim, uHosheya unyana kaNun.
Kwisizwe sikaBhenjamin, nguPalti unyana kaRaphu.
Kwisizwe sikaZebulon, nguGadiyeli unyana kaSodi.
Kwisizwe sikaManase, kwisizukulwana sikaYosefu, nguGadi unyana kaSushi.
Kwisizwe sikaDan, nguAmiyeli unyana kaGemali.
Kwisizwe sika-Asere, nguSethure unyana kaMikayeli.
Kwisizwe sikaNafetali, nguNahhi unyana kaVofsi.
Kwisizwe sikaGadi, nguGeweli unyana kaMakhi.
Lawona magama amadoda athunyelwe nguMoses ukuba ajonge ilizwe; uMoses wabiza igama likaHosheya, unyana kaNun, ngokuba nguYoshuwa.
Wabathumela ke uMoses ukuba bajonge iKanani, wathi kubo, Yiya phezulu ezweni laseNtshona, kwilizwe elincinane elisentshonalanga, nifike entliziyweni yentaba.
Yabonani ilizwe ukuba linjani, nibone ukuba abantu abahlala kulo banamandla na, nokuba bancinane na, nokuba baninzi.
Ingaba ilizwe labo elihlala kulo lilungileyo na, okanye libi? Ingaba imimandla yabo yimikhosi evulekileyo na, okanye ikhuselwe ngamatye?
Ingaba le mhlaba intle na, okanye incinci? Ingaba kukho izityalo kuyo, okanye ayikho? Buzakeleni, niyibuyisele eminye imifuno yelizwe. Yaye lixesha lokuqala kweentyatyambo zeentyatyambo.
Baye ke benyuka, bahlolisise ilizwe elisuka emasikweni aseZin ukuya kuRehobhi, elunxwemeni lweHamati.
Baya phezulu ezweni laseNtshona, bafika eHebron, apho behlala khona uAhimani, noSheshai, noTalmai, oonyana bakaAnaki. IHebron yakhiwa iminyaka esixhenxe phambi koSoan waseYiputa.

Ke kaloku bafika eNtaba ka-Eshkole, bathabathe isiqhamo esinomqolo omnye weentyatyambo zenkomo; babezithabatha phakathi kwabo abantu ababini, bezigxotha emlonyeni wabo; babezithabatha neentyatyambo zegranate, nezitye.
Igama lendawo leyo labizwa ngokuba yiNtaba ka-Eshkole, ngenxa yesiqhamo sabaSirayeli ababesicima khona.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezimashumi mane, babuya bekhangela ilizwe.
Bafika ke kuMoses noAron, nebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, eKadeshe, entlango kaParan; baphendula kubo nabo bonke ibandla, bababonisa ubisi lwelizwe.
Bathi kubo uMoses, Siyaye kuloo lizwe, apho usithumelele khona; ngokuqinisekileyo lilizwe eliphumayo ubisi nenkukhu; le ke intyatyambo yalo.
Ke kaloku abantu abahlala kuloo ndawo banamandla, namachibi abo anezikhephe, amakhulu kakhulu; sabona khona oonyana bakaAnaki.
I-Amaleki ihlala eNtshona; i-Heti, neYebhusi, ne-Amoreyi zihlala ezweni eliphakamileyo; i-Kanana ke ihlala eduze kolwandle, naphezu komlambo weJordan.
Ke kaloku uKalebe wamisa abantu phambi koMoses, wathi, Siya phezulu ngoku, siyithathe ilizwe; kuba singakulifumana.
Bathi ke amadoda athabathela naye, Asikwazi ukuhlasela abo bantu; ngokuba banamandla kunathi.
Bathi ke kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngelizwe labo elibonileyo, sithi, Ilizwe lethu elibonileyo lidla abantu bayo; bonke abantu ababonayo kuloo ndawo baphakamileyo kakhulu.
Sabona khona namadoda amaninzi, oonyana bakaAnaki, asuka kumandoda amaninzi; saziva sifana neengcongconi ngaphaya kwabo, saziva sengathi siyababona.
Ke kaloku ibandla lonke lavuma ngelizwi elikhulu ngaloo busuku, abantu balili.
Bathi oonyana bakaSirayeli bonke kuMoses noAron; basithi kubo ibandla lonke, Siyakuthanda ukuba siphile eYiputa, okanye sifile kuloo mfula.
Ingaba iNkosi usifaka njani kuloo lizwe, ukuba sifa emkhosini? Abafazi bethu nabantwana bethu baya kuthabatha isibonda; akusayi kuba ngcono ukuba sibuye eYiputa?
Bathi ke ngamnye kuye omnye, Sikhetheni umphathi, sihambe siye eYiputa.
Ke kaloku uMoses noAron bahlangula izandla zabo ehlabathini, phambi kwebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli elixhonywe.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa, unyana kaNun, noKalebe, unyana kaYefune, amadoda amabini ajonge ilizwe, waluka izitya zakhe.
Bathi kubo bonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, bathi, Ilizwe lethu elidlulayo, salingcwatywa, lilizwe elilungileyo kakhulu.
Ukuba iNkosi uthandana nathi, uya kusingenisa kuloo lizwe, alisinike lona, ilizwe eliphumayo ubisi nomvuzo.
Ke kaloku, musa ukunyamezela iNkosi, nize ningabakholele abantu baloo lizwe; kuba siza kuwadla njengesonka. Ukhuselo lwabo luphelile, iNkosi ke uya kusixhasa. Musani ukubaxolela!
Ke kaloku ibandla lonke lathetha ukuba libatyumze amatye. Wabonakala uzuko lukaYehova endlwini yokuhlangana kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli.

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Kuza kuthatha ixesha elingakanani na ukuba le ndoda indise umphefumlo wayo kum? Kuza kuthatha ixesha elingakanani na ukuba ingathembeki kum, ngenxa yezimanga zam zonke endizenzayo phakathi kwabo?
Ndiya kubabulala ngomhlaza, ndibasindise; ke mna ndiya kukwenza wena ube nguhlanga olukhulu, nolunamandla kunale.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, AbaYiputa baya kuyiva loo nto; wena wakhupha aba bantu phakathi kwabo ngobuchule bakho.

Bathi kubo bonke abantu abahlali kule lizwe; beva ke ukuba wena, Yehova, uphakathi kwabo bonke abantu, ukuba ubonakala ngamehlo akho, ukuba ifumene lakho lihlala phezu kwabo, ukuba uhamba phambi kwabo emnqamlezweni wefumene mihla le, emnqamlezweni womlilo busuku.
Ukuba uya kubabulala bonke abantu ngaxeshanye, amazwe awaziyo into yakho aya kuthetha, athi,
Kuba iNkosi akakwazanga ukuwangenisa la maqela ehlabathini, awayethetha ngalo kubo; ngoko ke wababulala emlilweni.
Ke ngoko, Nkosi, nceda ubonakalise ukuba lukhulu ubutyebi bakho, njengokuba uthi:

UYehova ukhawulezayo ukuxoka, unobubele obuninzi, olungisa ububi nobugwenxa; akayi kushiya umnqamlezo ungagwetywanga; ephulaphulisa abantwana isono sabazali babo, kuye kosuku lwesithathu nolunesihlanu.
Nceda, usixolele ububi balo mntu; ngokuba uzuko lwakho lukhulu kakhulu, njengokuba usazixolela nabo ukususela ekuphumeni kwabo eYiputa, de kube ngoku.
Wathi iNkosi, Ndiya kubaxolela, ngokwelizwi lakho.
Ke kaloku, ndiphila mna, nokuba ihlabathi lonke liza kuthethwa ngobuhle bukaYehova,
Akukho namnye kubo uya kuyibona le lizwe; babone ubuhle bam, nemiqondiso yam endiyenzayo eYiputa nasendleni; banamxelela iintsuku ezilishumi, bangandivumeli.
Akukho namnye kubo oza kuyibona le lizwe, endithe ndathetha ngalo kubazalwana babo; akukho namnye kubo oza kuniphulaphula, oza kuyibona.
Ke kaloku umkhonzi wam uKalebe unengqondo enye, walandela mna intliziyo yakhe yonke; ke ndiya kumngenisa ezweni ebelikhangelayo, iziqhamo zakhe ziya kuyifumana ibe yindawo yabo.
Kuba ama-Amaleki nama-Kanana ahlala emazantsi elwandle; ke ngoko, buyelani namhlanje, nihambe entlango ngendlela yoMlambo oMthubi.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses noAron, wathi,
Ndathi, Ndiza kuhlala ndedwa ixesha elingakanani na eli bandla libi, elinqumlayo kum? Ndiziva iinqumlayo zabantwana bakaSirayeli kum.
Uthi ke kubo, Ndiphila mna, utsho iNkosi, ukuba, njengokuba ndandiva amazwi enu, ndiya kunikwenza.
Nabo bonke abathe babalwa phakathi kwenu, abaneminyaka engama-mashumi mabini ubudala nangaphezulu, abaneentloni kum, iinkunzi zenu ziya kuhlala kulo mfula.
akuyi kungena ilizwe endithe ndathi ndiza kunimisa kulo; uKalebe unyana kaYefune, noYoshuwa unyana kaNun kuphela abaya kuyingena.
Nithi, Abantwana benu baya kuthatha inqanawa; ke mna ndiya kubazisa kuloo ndawo, baza kuyidla loo mhlaba niwuxolele.
Ke nina, iinkunzi zenu ziya kugwa kuloo mfula.
Abantwana benu baya kuba ngamagcisa kuloo mfula iminyaka emashumi mane; baya kuthatha isono senu, kuze kube liphela igazi lenu kuloo mlambo.
Ngeentsuku ezimashumi mane, nize niyihlolisise loo lizwe, unyaka ngamnye ube yiminyaka elishumi elinambini, nizithabatha iziphoso zenu; ukuze nikwazi ukuba intliziyo yam injani kuni.
Nditsho mna iNkosi; ndiya kuzisenza ezi zinto kulo lonke eli bandla libi, elinxibelelene kum; kule ndawo iphela baya kupheliswa, baya kufa apha.
Ke kaloku, bebuya abo madoda awawuthumeleleyo uMoses ukuba ahlolisise ilizwe, babangela ukuba lonke ibandla lilumke kuye, lithetha ngokubi ngaloo lizwe.
Ke kaloku abo madoda, abagxekileyo eli lizwe, bahlaselwa ngumkhuhlane, babafa phambi koYehova.
UYoshuwa unyana kaNune, noKalebe unyana kaYefune, baphila kuphela phakathi kwabafazi bonke abathe baphuma bekhangela ilizwe.
Wathetha ke uMoses kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli amazwi kaYehova; babe buhlungu kakhulu.
Ke kaloku bavuka kusasa, besuka ecaleni kwenduli. Bathi ke, Siphelelwe lithemba; ngoko ke, sihambe siye kwindawo awayesithi iNkosi ukuba siyayo.
Wathi ke uMoses, Niyiphulaphule ntoni na imimiselo kaYehova? Oku akuyi kuphumelela.
Musani ukunyuka; kuba iNkosi akakho nani, ukuze niqhutywe phambi kwabachasi benu.
I-Amaleki ne-Kanani zikho khona phambi kwenu, niza kubulawa emfazweni; ngokuba niyenzile isandla sam, ningamthobeli iNkosi, yena akayi kuba nani.
Ke kaloku, bathabathe isigqibo sokunyuka besiya phezulu komnqamlezo wenduli; uMoses notywala lomnqamlezo kaYehova abasukanga emkhosini.
Ke kaloku abaAmaleki, nabaKanani, ababehlala kuloo ndawo inkulu, bahla, babahlasela, bababulala, besiya eHorma.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, sithi kubo: Lithethani nabantwana bakaSirayeli, nithi kubo, Xa niza ezweni endilininika lona ukuba likhaya lenu,

ninike iNkosi izipho eziqhutywa ngamandla, ezisuka kwiinkomo zenu nakwiintyatyambo zenu; ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, okanye ibe yidini, ukuze nigcine isibingelelo senu, nokuba sisondlo esikhululekileyo, nokuba ziintlanganiso zenu, njengevumba elimnandi kuYehova.
Wonke umntu ozisa umnqophiso wakhe, athabathe nomnqophiso wesonka esivela kuYehova, ngaphezu kweemitha ezilishumi elinambini zesinyithi esiqinileyo, sixutywe nelitha enye yeoli.
Nonyana ngamnye womnikelo wokushiswa, okanye wesonka esibiyelweyo, ulungiselele ilitha enye yewayini, ibe yidini lokusela.
Umele ulungiselele umsondezo wesonka esitsha, kunye nomnqamlezo omnye, isiqingatha selitha yobisi elingenanto, elixutywe nesiqingatha selitha yeoli;
newayini engaphezu kweelitha ezilishumi elinambini, ibe ngumnikelo wokudla; ibe yivumba elimnandi kuYehova.
Xa ulungiselela inkunzi yenkomo, ibe yidini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, okanye ibe lidini elincinane, ukuze ugcine isibingelelo, okanye ibe lidini loxolo kuYehova;
bathabathe kunye nenyama yenkomo umnikelo wesonka, ngaphezu kweekhilogram ezilishumi elinambini zesinyithi esiqinileyo, sixutywe neoli, ngaphezu kwamalitha amabini.
Nceda ulungiselele ilitha ezimbini zewayini, ibe ngumnikelo wokudla; ibe lidini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, libe yivumba elimnandi kuYehova.
Oku kuya kwenziwa ngenkomo nganye, nomnquma ngamnye, nomntwana ngamnye webhokhwe.
Yenza njalo ngenyama nganye, nokuba ininzi kangakanani na oyilungiselele.
Wonke umntu ozalwa kuloo lizwe uya kuzisenza ezi zinto ngale ndlela, xa enikela ngesonka esiqhutywa ngumlilo, ivumba elimnandi kuYehova.

Ke kaloku, ukuba kukho umkhenkce ohlala phakathi kwenu, nabani na ohlala phakathi kwenu iminyaka emininzi ezayo, aze anikezele idini eliqhutywa ngamandla, liyivumba elimnandi kuYehova; njengokuba nisenzayo nani, ke yena ayenze.
Kuza kubakho umthetho owodwa kulo mkhosi, kuni nakumkhenkce ohlala phakathi kwenu; ngumthetho wokuphilayo kuzo zonke iintsapho zenu eziphumayo. Umkhenkce noye nifana phambi koYehova.
Imithetho nemiyalelo efanayo iya kuba nani, nalowo uhlala phakathi kwenu.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Balala oonyana bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Xa niza kungena ezweni apho ndiya kukuthabatha khona,
Ke kaloku, xa nidla isonka saleyo lizwe, niyibeke ecaleni, ibe ngumnikelo othile kuYehova.
Kuzo zonke iziqhamo zesidlo sakho, zinikele umnikelo wesonka esikhethekileyo; njengokuba ninika umnikelo wesonka esikhethekileyo kwisityalo sengqolowa, zinikele.
Kuzo zonke iintsuku ezizayo, nizinike iNkosi isonka esikhethekileyo, esivela kukuqala kodonga lwenu.
Ukuba ke niza kwenza into engafanelekanga, ningayilungisa nanye yazo zonke ezi zamkelo iNkosi awawisela kuMoses;
ngawo onke amasiko iNkosi awawisela phezu kwenu ngesandla sikaMoses, ukususela ngaloo mini iNkosi wathetha ngayo, naphezu kwayo yonke imihla.

Ke kaloku, ukuba intsapho yonke isenza oko ngokungaziyo, iya kunikela intsapho yonke inkunzi yenkomo enye ibe ngumnikelo womlilo, ube ngumphunga omnandi kuYehova, nomnikelo wayo womnquba, nesonka saso, ngokwemiyalelo; nomntwana webhokhwe omnye abe ngumnikelo wosono.

Ke yena umbingeleli uya kwenza isigwebo sebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli phambi koYehova; baya kuxolelwa, ngokuba kwakuyingozi. Baye banikela kuYehova idini labo eliqhutywa ngamanzi, nedini labo lesono ngenxa yengozi yabo.
Kuza kuthotywa lonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, nalowo uvela kwelinye lizwe ehlala phakathi kwabo; ngokuba bonke abantu babengumonakalo.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu esenza isono ngokungaqondiyo, athabathe inkunzi yebhokhwe yonyaka omnye, ibe ngumnikelo wesono.
Umbingeleli uya kumlungisa umntu phambi koYehova, ngenxa yesono sakhe esingenanto esisenzayo; uThixo uya kumlungisa phambi koYehova, aze amxolele.
Umthetho lowo uya kubakho kubo bonke abathi baphelelwe ngumnqweno, nokuba ngumfazi ozalwa eSirayeli, nokuba ungumkhenkce ohlala phakathi kwabo.
Ke kaloku wonke umntu owenza isono ngokuzithemba, ngobuxoki obucacileyo, nokuba ungumntu ozalwa ezweni lethu, nokuba ungumkhenkce, enze isono kuYehova; lo mntu uya kuthotywa kubomi bakhe.
Wayixhaphaza ilizwi likaYehova, wayiphula umyalelo wakhe; lowo mntu uya kususwa ngokuqinisekileyo; ulwaphulo-mthetho lwakhe lukho kuye.
Ke kaloku, xa oonyana bakaSirayeli besenyuvesi, kwafunyanwa umntu eqokelela imithi ngemini yeSabbathi.
Abamfumanayo eqoqa imithi, bamthabatha waya kuMoses noAron, nebandla liphela.
Ke kaloku bamisa phantsi kwengxowa, kuba akuzange kucace ukuba kwenzekani kuye.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Umntu lowo kufuneka aphele; ibandla lonke limele ligwebe ngeethayile ngaphandle komkhosi.
Yathi ke ibandla lonke liwukhuphe ngaphandle komzi-ndlu, liwuthabathe ngeethayile, waza wafa; njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, sithi kubo: Lixesha elizayo liphela, nize niyenze iziqhobosheli ezingcambu zeengubo zenu, nomsonto oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kwisiqhobosheli ngasinye.

Ziye zibe zizikhumbuzo zenu, ukuze nizibone, niziqaphele zonke imithetho kaYehova, nizigcine; ukuze nize nize ningahambi ngokuthanda kwentliziyo yenu, nokuthanda amehlo enu, okuthetha ukuba mna ndimxolele.
ukuze niyikhumbula imimiselo yam yonke, niyenze, nibe ngcwele kuThixo wenu.
Ndiye mna iNkosi uThixo wenu, wamkhupha ezweni laseYiputa, ukuba abe nguThixo wenu; ndiye mna iNkosi uThixo wenu.
Ke kaloku uKora, unyana ka-Ishar, unyana kaKahati, unyana kaLevi, waba mkhulu; naye wadibana naye uDathani noAbironi, oonyana bakaElibha, noOn, unyana kaPeleti, wesizwe samaRubeni.
Basuka benyuka bahlasela uMoses, namadoda angamawaka amabini anamashumi mahlanu eSirayeli, abizwa ngokuba ngabagxeki, abakhethiweyo yibandla.
Bahlangana noMoses noAron, bathi kubo, Niya ngaphezu kwendlela; ibandla lonke lingcwele, bonke ngabanye, iNkosi ke unguye nabo; ngaba nizibeka njani izandla zenu ngaphezulu kwabantu bakaYehova?
Ke kaloku, xa uMoses emaziyo loo nto, wehla ngobuso bakhe phantsi.

Wathetha ke kuKora, neqela lakhe lonke, wathi, Ngomso iNkosi uya kubonisa ukuba ngubani na owakhe, nokuba ngubani na ongcwele; lowo uya kumnika ithuba lokuba afike kuye; onokumkhethayo uya kumnika ithuba lokuba afike kuye.
Le nto ke, wena uKore, neqela lakho lonke, niyenze; nithathe iziqhoboshi.
Namhlanje nizibeke phezu kwazo umlilo nefuthe phambi koYehova; lo mntu ukhethayo iNkosi uya kuba nguwo ongcwele; nina, abaLevi, nihamba kude kakhulu.
Wathi ke uMoses kuKora, Nxibelelani, niLevi.

Ingaba akubi nto kuni, ukuba uThixo kaSirayeli wahlula phakathi kwenu naphakathi kwebandla, wamnika ithuba lokuba nifike kuye, ukuze nisebenze endlwini engcwele kaYehova, nihlale phambi kwebandla, nibancedise?
Wakufutshane nawe, nabazalwana bakho bonke, ooLevi; nifuna ke ukuba ngababingeleli nani?
Ngokuqinisekileyo kuYehova uThixouThixo, wena nosapho lwakho lonke, nihlangane ndawonye. UAron ngubani na, ukuba nimxolele?
Wathumela ke uMoses, wabiza uDathani noAbironi, oonyana bakaElibha; bathi ke, Asiyi kungena.
Ingaba akuncinci na ukuba usikhuphe ezweni eliphumayo ubisi nenyama, ukuze ususwe emlilweni? Ufuna ke ngoku ukuba ngumlawuli wethu?

Uthe ke iNkosi kuye: "Akukho nanye into oyenzayo ukuba sifike kuloo lizwe lidla ngobisi nomvuzo, ukuze siyithathe ibe yipropathi yethu, nokuba ziindawo zomhlaba okanye izityalo zewayini. Ingaba ucinga ukuba uya kubaxhalabisa abo bantu? Asiza kufika."
Ke kaloku uMoses waxhaphaza kakhulu, wathi kuYehova, Musa ukuthobela isonka sabo; andithathenga nanye inkunzi yebhokhwe kubo, andizange ndiyenze into embi kumnye wabo.
Wathi uMoses kuKore, Uhlale wena neqela lakho lonke phambi koYehova namhlanje; nawe nabo, noAron naye.
Nithathe ngamnye isuti yakhe, nifake kuyo uvumba; nizibeke phambi koYehova, izisuti ezimakhulu amabini, anamanci mahlanu; nawe noAron nizibeke izisuti zenu.
Wathabatha ke umntu ngamnye isuti yakhe, wabeka ngaphakathi kuyo umlilo, nesuti; bahlala phambi koMoses noAron emngxunyeni wetente yokudibana.
Ke kaloku uKora wahlanganisa iqela lakhe lonke phezu kwabo, emnyango wetente yokuhlangana. Wabonakala uzuko lukaYehova kwintsapho yonke.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses noAron, wathi,
Yathi ke uNdikhoyo, Yihlani phakathi kwalabo bantu, ukuze ndibasindise ngaxeshanye.
Ke kaloku uMoses noAron bahlangula izandla zabo ehlabathini, bathi, Thixo, Thixo onika umoya kuwo onke aphilileyo, ngaba ngenxa yokuba umntu omnye walungisa uya kuxoka phezu kwebandla lonke?
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Uthi ke kuhlanga, Yiya nisuka phakathi kweentlango zikaKora, noDathani noAbironi.
Wavuka ke uMoses, waya kuDathani noAbironi; abathetheli bakaSirayeli balandela.
Wathi ke kuye ibandla, Nxibelelanise phakathi kweentlango zalabo bantu ababi; musa ukutshisa nantoni na yabo, ukuze nize nilahleke ngenxa yezono zabo zonke.

Ke kaloku abantu basuka phakathi kweentlanganiso zikaKora, noDathane noAbiron, zijikeleze; uDathane noAbiron ke waphuma, wahlala emehlweni eentlango zabo, nabafazi babo, nabantwana babo, neentombi zabo.
Wathi ke uMoses, Ngale nto niyazi ukuba nguYehova owayendithumeleleyo ukuba ndiyenze zonke ezi zinto; ukuba andizange ndenze ngamandla am.
Ukuba aba bantu bafa ngokufa okuqhelekileyo, njengokuba bonke abantu befa, ke ngoko iNkosi akandithumelele.

Ke kaloku, ukuba iNkosi enze into entsha yonke, ukuba ihlabathi livuleke, libethe kubo nazo zonke izinto zabo, bathabathele phantsi bephilile kumhlaba wokufa; ke ngoko niyazi ukuba la madoda aphulaphule iNkosi.
Ke kaloku, xa uMoses egqibile ukushumayela loo mazwi onke, ihlabathi phantsi kwabo laluka.
Wavula umhlaba, wawela kubo nakwiindlu zabo, nabo bonke abantu bakaKori, nazo zonke izinto ababenazo.
Baya phantsi bephilile, nabo bonke ababo, kumhlaba wokufa; ihlabathi lazivala phezu kwabo, baphela phakathi kwebandla.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu bakaSirayeli abajikeleze kubo, beva ilizwi labo, babaleka, besithi, Umhlaba uya kusinikela nathi.
Waphuma umlilo endlwini kaYehova, watshisa amadoda angamakhulu amabini, anamanci mahlanu, anikelayo umnquba.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Uthi kuElayasare, unyana kaAron umLevi, ukuba athabathe amacwecwe omlilo emlilweni, akhuphe iikhabhoni ezifudumeleyo kude; kuba amacwecwe angcwele.

Ezi ziintloko zabafazi abaphelelwe ngumphefumlo wabo; zenza ngazo iziqhoboshi ezincinci, ukuze zigubungele isibingelelo; ngokuba zafunyanwa phambi koYehova, zazingcwele; zibe ngumqondiso kubo bonke abantwana bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uEleyazare, umbingeleli, wathabatha iintonga zentsimbi, ezithunyelwe ngabafazi abaqhutywe, waza wazenza zibe ziibhokhwe zokugubungela isibingelelo.

Waba ngumbulelo kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, ukuba akukho namnye, ngaphandle komntwana ka-Aron, oza kungena ekufumaniseni uvumba phambi koYehova, ukuze angabi njengoKori nosapho lwakhe; njengoko iNkosi wathethayo kuEleyazare ngesandla sikaMoses.
Ke kaloku, ngemini elandelayo, ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli limele uMoses noAron, besithi, Niwabulala abantu bakaYehova.
Ke kaloku, xa ibandla lithe ladibana noMoses noAron, bajonge endlwini yokuhlangana; kwathi ke, ngaphaya koko, icloudi yayigubungela, uzuko lukaYehova lwabonakala.
Waye ke uMoses noAron phambi kwetenki yokuhlangana.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yathi ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, Yiya phantsi phakathi kwalabo bantu, ukuze ndibasindise ngaxeshanye. Bahlangula ngobuso babo emhlabeni.

Wathi uMoses kuAron, Yithathe isuti yakho yomlilo, uyifake kuyo umsi osuka kwisibingelelo, uyibeke phezu kwayo intyatyambo yomlilo; khawuleza ufike kwintlanganiso, ubalungise phambi koThixo; kuba uzuko lukaYehova luphuma, isifo esibulalayo siqalile.
Wakwenza ke uAron njengoko watshoyo uMoses, waya phakathi komkhosi; ke kaloku isifo saqala kuqala phakathi kwabantu; wabeka phezu kwawo umnquba, wabalungisa abantu kuThixo.
Wahlala phakathi kwabafileyo nabaphilayo; isifo saphela.
Amawaka anamanci mabini anamakhulu asixhenxe abantu abafa ngaloo ntlungu, ngaphandle kwabo bafa ngenxa kaKora.
Wabuyela ke uAron kuMoses, emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana; ngenxa yokuba isifo saphela.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho oonyana bakaSirayeli, uthabathe kubo iintonga ezilishumi elinambini, nganye yazo ibe yindodana yokumkani wesizwe seentsapho zabazali babo; ubhale igama lomntu ngamnye kwintambo yakhe.
Kwintonga kaLevi ubhale igama likaAron; intonga nganye ibe yindodana yomntu ngamnye wesizukulwana seentsapho zabazali bakhe.
Zibeke kwitentile yokuhlangana, phambi kwebhokisi yomnqophiso, apho ndiza kudibana khona nawe.
Umnqamlezo womntu endiwukhethileyo, uya kwenza imbewu; ngoko ke ndiya kugqiba ngale ndlela inkanuko yabantwana bakaSirayeli kuwe.
Wathetha ke uMoses kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli; abathetheli babo bamnika iintonga ezilishumi elinambini, intonga nganye yabathetheli beentlanga zabo: intonga kaAron yayiphakathi kwabo.
Wazibeka ke uMoses iintonga phambi koYehova, endlwini yomnqophiso womthetho.

Wafika ke uMoses ngemini elandelayo, waya kwitentile yomnqophiso womthetho; wabona ukuba intambo ka-Aron, yesizukulwana sikaLevi, yakhula, yakhupha iziqhamo, yavula iintyatyambo, yavelisa amaqanda aphilileyo.
Wazisa ke uMoses zonke iintonga phambi koYehova, wazibonisa oonyana bakaSirayeli; babezibona, bathabathe umlawuli ngamnye intonga yakhe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yibuyisele intonga kaAron phambi kwebhokisi yomnqophiso; uyigcine khona ibe ngumqondiso kubo baphulaphuli bomthetho, ukuze ziphele iinyembezi zabo kum, bangafa.
Wakwenza ke uMoses, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli kuMoses, Siyafa thina; silahlekile, siyalahlekile sonke.
Nabani na oza kungena endlwini engcwele kaYehova, uya kufa; siya kufa na bonke?
Wathi iNkosi kuAron, Wena, noonyana bakho, nendlu yakho yosapho lwakho, nizithabatha zonke iimpazamo zendawo engcwele; wena nonyana bakho kuphela nizithabatha zonke iimpazamo zenkonzo yenu yamadini.

Abazalwana bakho, isizukulwana samaLevi, isizukulwana soyise wakho, uthabathele kubo, ukuba basebenze nawe; babethe ngqo kuwe, bakuncedise, xa wena nonyana bakho nisebenza phambi kwetenki yomnqophiso womthetho.
Baya kusebenza phambi kwenu, bagcine ukhuseleko lwetentile yonke; kodwa bangangeni kwizithuthi ezingcwele, nasesibingeleli, ukuze bangafa nabo, niye nani.
Baya kudibana nawe, bahlale begcina umsebenzi wetente yokuhlangana, besenza yonke imisebenzi yayo; akukho mntu wangaphandle oza kukufutshane.
Niyigcine ingcwele, niyigcine isibingelelo; ukuze ingxabano yam ingabikho kwakhona phezu kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Ndiyabona ukuba mna ndibathathe abazalwana benu, amaLevi, phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; bakuba ngumnikelo kuni, banikezelwe kuYehova, ukuze benze umsebenzi wetente yokuhlangabeza.

Ke wena, nawe oonyana bakho, ningaba ngababingeleli ngezinto zonke eziphathelele isibingelelo, nakwizinto ezingaphakathi komgca wophahla; ndininika iinkonzo zenkonzo yobubingeleli njengesipho. Nabani na oza kudlula kwindawo engcwele, kufuneka aphele.

Wathi iNkosi kuAron, Ndiyabona, ndinimise phezu kwezinto endizinikelayo, zonke izinto ezingcwele zabaSirayeli, ezindizisayo; ndazinika wena nabantwana bakho, zibe yinxalenye yakho ngonaphakade; ngokuba ukhonjisiwe.

Yiyakho le nxalenye yazo zonke izinto ezingcwele kakhulu, ezingaqhutywanga ngomlilo: yonke into abayinikelayo kum, nokuba ngumnikelo wokudla, nokuba ngumnikelo wesono, nokuba ngumnikelo wokunqunyulwa; zingcwele kakhulu, zibe zakho nabantwana bakho.
Ukutya okungcwele kakhulu uya kuzidla; wonke umfana uya kuzidla, uzigcine zingcwele.

Le nto ke iya kuba yakho: iinkunzi zeenkomo, ezisuka kuzo zonke izibingelelo zokungqungquthela zabantwana bakaSirayeli; ndizinika kuwe, nawe oonyana bakho nabentombi zakho, zibe yinxalenye yenu ephakamileyo. Wonke umntu ococekileyo endlwini yakho angazidla.
Ndiya kukunika nazo zonke izinto ezilungileyo zeoli yeoli, newayini entsha, nengqolowa, izinto zokuqala zokuvuna kwabo, abazinika kuYehova.
Zonke iziqhamo zokuqala zelizwe labo, abazinikelayo kuYehova, ziya kuba zakho; wonke ococekileyo endlwini yakho angazidla.
Zonke izinto zakwaSirayeli ezinikezelwe ngokupheleleyo kuYehova, ziya kuba zakho.

Yonke into ezalwa kuqala ngumntu, nakwizinto eziphilayo, ezinikezelwa kuYehova, iya kuba yakho; kodwa yonke into ezalwa kuqala ngumfazi, nayo yonke into ezalwa kuqala zizinto eziphilayo ezingahlanjwanga, uya kuyithenga ngemali.
Xa beneminyaka emine ubudala, baya kuthengwa ngexabiso labo, ngamashekeli amahlanu esilivere, ngomlinganiselo wendawo engcwele, abe ziishekeli ezimashumi mabini.

Ke kaloku, akufuneki ukuba uthenge kwakhona umntwana wokuqala webhokhwe, okanye wemvu, okanye wengulube; zingcwele. Uza kuzitshisa igazi labo phezu kwesibingelelo, uze uwuthule umgubo wabo, ibe lidini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, libe yivumba elimnandi kuYehova.
Intlanzi yawo iya kuba yakho; njengokuba isibeleko esiqhutywayo, nemilenze ekunene, ibe yakho.

Zonke ezo zinto zikhethwayo, ezinikezelwa ngazo izinto ezingcwele, abazinikelayo oonyana bakaSirayeli kuYehova, ndizinika kuwe, nawe oonyana bakho nabentombi zakho, ibe yinxalenye yenu ngonaphakade; kukukumkani komnqophiso wesonka ohlala ixesha elide phambi koYehova, umnqophiso ongapheliyo kuwe nosapho lwakho emva kwakho.
Wathi iNkosi kuAron, Akuyi kubakho indawo yakho ezweni lakwaSirayeli, akuyi kubakho inxalenye yakho phakathi kwabantu; mna ndiye inxalenye yakho nelifa lakho phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Ndiya kubanika ooLevi ishumi lezinto zonke ezweni lakwaSirayeli, ibe lilifa labo, ngenxa yomsebenzi wabo owenzayo endlwini kaYehova.
Babantu bakaSirayeli bangafikanga ngaphambili etentweni yokuhlangana, ukuba bangathi bathathe isono, babafa.

AbaLevi kuphela abaya kwenza umsebenzi wetente yokuhlangana, bona baya kuyithabatha intlungu yayo. Kuye kube ngumthetho ophakamileyo kuwo onke amaqela enu; bangabi namaLevi nelizwe phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.

Ke kaloku, ishumi labantwana bakaSirayeli, elinikezelwa nguYehova njengomnikelo ongenisiweyo, ndilinika amaLevi libe lilifa labo; ngenxa yoko ndithi, Akuyi kubakho mhlaba wabo phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

Uthethe kuLevi, usithi kubo, Xa nifumana ebantwini bakaSirayeli ishumi elinesixhenxe endilininike lona njengelifa lenu, niya kunika isiqingatha seshumi saleyo ishumi elinesixhenxe, ibe yintlawulo kaYehova.
Umnikelo wakho uya kubalwa kuwe, njengokuba yingqolowa evela kwindawo yokuthambisa, nokuba yiwayini evela kwiglasi.
Ngale ndlela ke niza kunika isonka esikhethekileyo kuYehova, kuzo zonke izixhenxe ozifumanayo kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli; niyinike uAron, umbingeleli, isiqingatha sikaYehova.
Kuzo zonke izipho zenu, nizinikezele izinto ezilungileyo, ezingcwele kakhulu, zibe ngumnikelo othile kuYehova.
Uthi ke kuLevi, Xa ninika inxalenye elungileyo, le nto iseleyo iya kuba yintlawulo yenu, njengento ephuma kwindawo yokugquma iziqhamo, nento ephuma kwisitya sewayini.
Ungazidla naphi na, nina neentsapho zenu; le yimali yenu ngenxa yomsebenzi wenu endlwini kaYehova.
Ukuba unikela ngento elungileyo, awuyi kuba nesono ngenxa yayo; musa ke ukuhlambalaza izinto ezingcwele zabantwana bakaSirayeli, ukuze ungafa.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses noAron, wathi,

Lo ngumthetho iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngawo, esithi, Utsho kubantwana bakaSirayeli, ukuba bakulethe kuwe inkunzi yenkomo emnyama, engabikho buhlungu kuyo, ingabikho namnye umonakalo kuyo; ingabikho ifakwe ngenqanawa.
Yinisele uEleyazare, ukumkani; bayikhuphe ngaphandle komkhosi, bayifile phambi kwakhe.
UElezare, umbingeleli, uya kuthatha igazi layo emlonyeni wakhe, alilitshisa ngeendlela ezisixhenxe phambi kwetenki yokuhlangana.
Ke kaloku inkunzi yebhokhwe iya kuqhutywa phambi kwakhe; isikhumba sayo, nenyama yayo, negazi layo, nenkunkuma yayo, iya kuqhutywa.
Umbingeleli uya kuthatha umthi we-cedar, ne-hysop, nentambo engwevu, ayezibeka phakathi komlilo apho inkunzi yenkomo iqhutywa khona.
Ke yena umbingeleli uya kuzihlamba iimpahla zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi; emva koko angaya entsimini, aze abe mnciphiso kude kube semini.
Ke kaloku lowo uyitshisayo inkomo, uya kuzihlamba iimpahla zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, aze abe mncipha kude kube semini.

Umntu ococekileyo uya kuqoqa uthuli lwenkomo, alungise ngaphandle komkhosi, kwindawo ecocekileyo; zibe zigcinwe kwintlanganiso yakwaSirayeli, ukuba zisetyenziswe emanzini okuhlamba. Lidini lesono eli.

Lo mntu uthabatheyo iinkungu, uya kuhlamba izihlangu zakhe, aze abe mnciphisi kude kube semini; ibe ngumthetho wexesha eliphakamileyo kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, nakwabakhenkethi abahlala phakathi kwabo.
Wonke umntu otshisa into efileyo, uya kuba mncipha iintsuku ezisibhozo.
Uya kuhlamba ngamanzi ngomhla wesithathu, nomhla wesixhenxe, aze abe mhle; kodwa ukuba akahlambanga ngomhla wesithathu, nomhla wesixhenxe, akayi kuba mhle.

Wonke umntu otshisa into efileyo, angazihlamba izandla zakhe, uyenza inqambi itentile engcwele kaYehova; lo mntu uya kususwa kumaSirayeli. Kuba amanzi okuhlambela awangcwatywa phezu kwakhe, ngoko ke ungumnqamlezo; inqambi yakhe iya kuhlala phezu kwakhe.
Lo ngumthetho, xa umntu efa kwitentile; wonke lowo uphumayo kwitentile, nalowo ungaphakathi kuyo, uya kuba mncipha iintsuku ezisibhozo.
Yonke ibhotile evulekileyo, engenasitshixo esenziweyo phezu kwayo, iya kuba yinyamalala.
Nabani na othi, emehlweni ehlabathini, athabathe umntu obulawa ngeqhwa, okanye umfazi, okanye ithambo lomntu, okanye isibingelelo, uya kuba mncipha iintsuku ezisibhozo.
Ke kaloku, xa esonakalisayo sicocekile, uya kubeka inkunkuma yesonka sokumnqula isono esiqhutywa ngamanzi emlonyeni webhotile, uthele phezu kwayo amanzi ashushu aphumayo.

Umntu ococekileyo uya kuthatha isiqhamo se-hyssop, amise emanzini, athabathe amanzi etentweni, nakwizinto zonke ezingaphakathi kuyo, nakubantu abakhoyo khona; naye onqumlayo ithambo lomntu, okanye umntu obulawayo, okanye umfazi, okanye indawo yokufa, athabathe amanzi.

Lo mntu ococekileyo uya kutywina lowo ungcolileyo ngomso wesithathu, nomso wesixhenxe; ngomhla wesixhenxe uya kumlungisa; lo mntu ococekileyo uya kuzihlamba iimpahla zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, aze abe mhlophe ngemini.
Ke kaloku umntu oza kubi, akayi kucoceka, igazi elo liya kususwa kwintlanganiso; ngokuba lalibazisa indawo engcwele kaYehova. Amanzi okuhlamba awaqhutywanga phezu kwakhe, abe mkhulu.
Lo ngumthetho wabo ophakamileyo: lowo utyhutyha amanzi okuhlambela kufuneka ahlamba iimpahla zakhe; nalowo uncamathisela amanzi okuhlambela, uya kuba mncipha kude kube semini.
Yonke into ayiyi kuyitshisa loo mntu ongcolileyo, iya kuba yingozi; nalowo uyitshisa leyo, uya kuba yingozi de kube sebusuku.
Yafika ke yonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli elunxwemeni lwaseZin, ngomhla wesithathu wenyanga yokuqala; bahlala eKadeshe. Wafa khona uMiriyam, wabanjwa.
Akukho manzi kwintlanganiso; abantu badibana noMoses noAron. Bathi ke iNkosi kuye:
Bathetha noMoses, besithi, Kungenxa yokuba sakufa, xa abazalwana bethu befa phambi koYehova.
Nibathumelele njani abantu bakaYehova kuloo mfula, ukuze sife apha nathi nezinto zethu eziphilayo?
Uthini na ukuba nisisikhuphe siphuma eYiputa, nisingenise kuloo ndawo inobungozi? Akukho mbewu apha, ayikho imifi, ayikho izityalo zeentyatyambo, ayikho iigranate; akukho namanzi okusela kuwo.
Basuka ke uMoses noAron ebantwini, bafike emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana; bahlangula ngobuso babo emhlabeni; wabonakala kubo uzuko lukaYehova.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yithathe intonga, uyihlangane ibandla, wena noAron unyana wakho; nithethe nelitye phambi kwamehlo abo, liphumeze amanzi ayo; nikhuphe amanzi elitye, ukuze ibandla lidle, nezithixo zazo nazo.
Wayithatha ke uMoses intonga esuka kwindawo yayo phambi koYehova, njengoko wamwisela umthetho iNkosi.
UMoses noAron bahlanganisela abantu phambi kodonga; uMoses wathi kubo, Ncokolani, nina abakhohlakeleyo; ngaba siza kukuzisa amanzi kulodonga?
Waphakamisa uMoses isandla sakhe, wabetha isikwere kabini ngentsimbi yakhe; kwaphuma amanzi amaninzi, badla intlanganiso nenyama yabo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses noAron, Ngokuba ningandikholwanga, ukuba ndibonakalise ubungcwele bam phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, ngoko ke niza kungena le ndawo inkulu ezweni endilibazisa lona.
Yaye ke loo manzi nguMeriba, ngenxa yokuba oonyana bakaSirayeli bathetha khona noYehova; wabonisa ukuba ungcwele kubo.
Wathumela ke uMoses abathunywa kukumkani waseEdom, eKadeshe, bathi, Utsho lo mzalwana wakho uSirayeli, uthi, Uyazi zonke iintlungu ezithe zadlula kuthi.
Ke kaloku abazalwana bethu bathabathela eYiputa, sahlala khona iminyaka emininzi; abaYiputa basiphatha kakubi nathi namadodana ethu.
Sathi ke kuye iNkosi, wathetha nathi, wathumela isithunywa, waza wasikhupha eYiputa; ngoko sikho apha eKadeshe, emzini ophakathi kwelizwe lakho.

Nceda, sivumele ukuba sihambe ngelizwe lakho; asiyi kuhamba ngezityalo zakho, nokuba ziinkomo zakho, asiyi kunywa amanzi ebhentshi nganye; sinokuhlala kwindlela enkulu kakumkani; asiyi kutshintshela ekunene nakwesobunxele, de sidlule ngelizwe lakho.
Wathi ke uEdom kuye, Akuyi kubakho ukudlula kwenu apha; ukuba nihamba, siza kuphuma sizihlasele ngeqhwa lethu.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli kuye, Siza kuhlala kwindlela evulekileyo; ukuba sidla amanzi akho, thina nabantwana bethu, siya kuhlawulisa; sinokuhamba nje ngeenyawo zethu, akukho nto.
Ke kaloku uEdom wathi kubo, Akuyi kubakho ukudlula kwenu. Waphuma ke uEdom ukuba ahlangane nabo, enemikhosi emikhulu nenamandla.
Ke kaloku amaEdom akazange avumele amaSirayeli ukuba ahambe kwelakhe ilizwe; ngoko ke amaSirayeli atshintshile kuwo.
Basuka ke eKadeshe, bafika emnqamlezweni kaHori, bonke abaSirayeli.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses noAron, entlango kaHori, ekumda weEdom, esithi,

UAron uya kufa, aza kudityaniswa nabantu bakhe abafileyo; akayi kungena ezweni endilibazisa kulo oonyana bakaSirayeli; ngokuba niye nani namadodana am, nani namadodana am, ningamthobeli umyalelo wam ngamanzi eMeriba.
Bathabathe uAron noElazare unyana wakhe, bafike emnqamlezweni kaHori.
Yikhuphe iingubo zikaAron zababingeleli, uyigqoke uElazar, unyana wakhe; aze uAron aphele khona, ahlangane nabantu bakhe.
Wakwenza ke uMoses njengoko wamwiselayo iNkosi; banyuka phezulu emnqamlezweni kaHori, phambi kobuso bonke bebandla.
Ke kaloku uMoses wamsusa uAron iimpahla zakhe, wazisa kuElazare unyana wakhe. Wafa ke uArone khona phezulu emnqamlezweni wentaba; bahla ke uMoses noElazare emnqamlezweni.
Yabona ke ibandla lonke ukuba uAron wafa, bathandaza kuAron iintsuku ezimashumi mathathu bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaKanan wase-Arad, owayehlala eNtshonalanga, wayeva ukuba abantu bakaSirayeli bafika ngendlela yase-Atarimi; wahlasela amaSirayeli, wathabathela abanye kubo.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli abulale umnqophiso kuYehova, athi, Ukuba uya kubanika esi sizwe esandla sethu, siya kuzibulala izixeko zabo.
UYehova wabaphulaphula amaSirayeli, wabeka abaKanani phambi kwabo; bathabathela bonke, nabo namachibi abo; ngoko ke kwabizwa igama lendawo leyo ngokuba yiHorma.
Basuka ke oonyana bakaSirayeli emnqamlezweni wentaba kaHore, behamba ngendlela yolwandle oluMnyama, ukuba bajikeleze ilizwe laseEdom. Ke kaloku abantu baba neentlungu zengqondo ngenxa yendlela.
Bathetha ngoThixo noMoses, besithi, Nisikhuphe njani eYiputa, ukuba sife kuloo mfula? Akukho nkukhu namanzi apha; siyazixolela loo nto ibuhlungu yokudla.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wathumela phakathi kwabantu iintaka ezinobungozi, zazibulala abantu; kwafa ke amaSirayeli aninzi.
Bafika ke abantu kuMoses, besithi, Siphelelwe lityala, ngokuba sathetha ngoYehova nowe; thandaza kuYehova, ukuba asuse kuzo ezi ntaka kuthi. Wathandaza uMoses kubo bonke abantu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yenza ibhokhwe eyenziweyo, uyibeke phezulu komnqamlezo; umntu onqunyiweyo ajonge kuyo, aze aphile.
Ke kaloku uMoses wenza ibhokhwe yentsimbi, wayibeka emlonyeni; xa umntu ekhatywa yibhokhwe, ejonge ibhokhwe yentsimbi, wayephila.
Bahamba ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bamisa itente eObhothi.
Basuka eObhothi, bamisa iintaba eIye-Abarim, emlanjeni ojongene neMowabi, ngasentshona kwelanga.
Basuka khona, bamisa itente eNtaba kaSeredi.
Basuka apho, bamisa iintaba ngaphesheya komlambo iArnoni, esiqwini esifika kwilizwe lama-Amori; uArnoni ungumda phakathi kweMowabhi noAmaori.
Ngoko ke, iBhayibhile yamaMfazwe kaYehova ithi, NgeWahebi eSupha, neentlambo zaseArnoni,
nakwiindawo eziphakamileyo zeentlambo, ezifikela emzini ka-Ar, zibekwe kumda weMowabhi.
Basuka khona bafika eBheri, apho iNkosi wathi kuMoses, Zibophelela abantu ndawonye, ndibanike amanzi.
Wathi ke uSirayeli lo mculo lowo, Utsho ukuba: Yiza phezulu, inqanawa, Yize kuyo.
Nqulethe iingoma zesibhedlele, abathetheli basikhwele, oonyana bakakumkani namadoda amakhulu elizwe, basikhwele ngamatye abo, namatye abo okuhamba. Basuka emlanjeni baya kuMatana;
ukusuka eMatana waya eNahaliyeli; ukusuka eNahaliyeli waya eBhamoti.
Basuka eBamoti, bahamba befika emlanjeni waseMowabi, apho phezulu komnqamlezo wePisga ujongene nesiqithi.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli athumela abathunywa kuSihon, ukumkani wamaAmori, esithi,

Musani ukusivumela ukuba sihambe ngelizwe lakho; asiyi kungena ezweni naliphi na, nokuba yimithi yeentyatyambo, asiyi kusela amanzi emfuleni naphi na; siya kuhlala kwindlela enkulu kakumkani, de sidlule ngelizwe lakho.

Ke kaloku uSihon akazange avumele amaSirayeli ukuba ahambe kwelakhe ilizwe; wathabatha uSihon wonke umkhosi wakhe, waphuma waya emasikweni, wahlasela amaSirayeli. Wafika ke eYahazi, wahlasela amaSirayeli.
AmaSirayeli amhlasela emfazweni, wathabatha ilizwe lakhe lisuka kumlambo uArnoni, waya kumlambo uYabhoki, ukuya ezweni lakwaAmmon; ngokuba umda wama-Ammon wawukhuselekile.
AmaSirayeli athabathe onke amadolophu eAmori, ahlala kuwo, namaHeshboni neentlambo zayo zonke.
Ke kaloku iHeshboni yayikumzi kaSihon, ukumkani wamaAmoreti; wayeye wahlasela ukumkani wakwaMowabi owangaphambili, waza wamthabatha lonke ilizwe lakhe, waya emlanjeni weArnon.
Ngenxa yoko bathi ababhali, Yiya eHeshboni; Umzi kaSihon uphinde ubuyiselwe, uphinde uqiniswe.
Kuba umlilo waphuma eHeshboni, umnqamlezo emzini kaSihon; watshisa i-Ar yaseMowabhi, nabathetheli beendawo eziphakamileyo ngaseArnoni.
Kubuhlungu kuwe, uMowabhi! Uphelile, mna Thixo kaKemoshi! Washiya oonyana bakhe bahambe, waza wazisa iintombi zakhe kuSihon, ukumkani wama-Amoreti.
Ke kaloku siyabathutha; iHeshboni yaqhutywa, iye kwiDiboni; sayithutha iNofa, eya kufika eMedebha.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli ahlala ezweni lamaAmori.
Ke kaloku uMoses wathumela abantu ukuba bahlolisise iYazeri; bathabathe izixeko zayo, bakhupha amaAmori ahlala kuyo.
Ke kaloku babuyela, benyuka ngendlela eya eBhashani. Waphuma uOg ukumkani waseBhashani, naye wonke umkhosi wakhe, ukuba athabathe intshayelelo kubo eEdrei.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Musa ukumkhokela; ngokuba ndimnikela phambi kwakho, yena nabantu bakhe bonke, nelizwe lakhe; wenze kuye njengokuba wenza nguSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori, owayelawula eHeshbon.
Bawubetha ke uOgi, nabantwana bakhe, nemfazwe yakhe yonke; akazange ashiye mntu ophilayo; bathatha ilizwe lakhe.
Basuka ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bamisa iintaba ezindleleni zaseMowabhi, ecaleni komlambo iYorodani, ngaseJerikho.
Wabona ke uBalaka, unyana kaSipore, zonke izinto azenzayo amaSirayeli kumaAmori.
Ke kaloku abantu bakaMowabhi bakhathazeka, ngenxa yobuninzi bamaSirayeli; abaMowabhi baphoxeka ngenxa yabantwana bakaSirayeli.

Bathi ke amaMowabhi kumadoda amakhulu eMidiyani, Oku kungenxa yokuba iqela eli lidla zonke izinto ezikufutshane nathi, njengokuba inkunzi yenkomo ilila iziqhamo zasendle. UBalaka unyana kaSiporu wayekumkani wamaMowabhi ngaloo mini.

Wathumela abathunywa, wabiza uBhileham, unyana kaBeore, ohlala ePethore, ngaseMlambo iEfrayim, ezweni lakhe lokuzalwa. UBhalaka waphendula wathi, Ilizwe lonke liphuma eYiputa; bona, ligubungela phezulu kwehlabathi, lihlala kum.

Nceda ke ngoku, ndizalela le ndoda mna; kuba inamandla kakhulu kum; mhlawumbi ndiya kukwazi ukuyibulala, ndiyikhuphe ezweni. Kuba ndiyazi ukuba lowo uyamsindisa uya kuba ngumsindisi, nolowo uyamsindisa uya kuba ngumsindisi."
Basuka ke abakhulu bakaMowabhi nakwaMidiyani, bethabatha ngesandla sabo iindleko zomprofeti; bafika kuBhileham, bamxelela uBhalaki.
Wathi kubo uBhileham, Bukelani apha le busuku; nokuba yintoni na ilizwi eliya kumphendulayo iNkosi, ndiya kukuphendula. Bahlala ke naye abathetheli bakaMowabi.
Wafika uThixo kuBhileham, wathi, Zithini na ezi ndoda zikho nawe?
Wathi uBhileham kuThixo, UBalaka, unyana kaSipore, ukumkani wakwaMowabi, wamthumela kuye, esithi,
Ndithi, Ilizwe liphuma eYiputa, ligubungela ubuso behlabathi; ke ngoko, ndiza, ndimcaphukisa; mhlawumbi ndiya kukwazi ukuwahlasela, ndibakhuphe.
Wathi ke uThixo kuBhileham, Musa ukuya nabo; musa ukucaphukisa abo bantu; ngokuba babhaptizwe.
Wavuka ke uBhileham emveni kwemini, wathi kumadoda amakhulu kaBhalaki, Yiya ezweni lenu; ngokuba iNkosi akafuni kundivumela ukuba ndihambe nani.
Baye ke abathetheli bakaMowabhi babuyela kuBhalaki, bathi, UBhileham akafuni kungena nathi.
Ke kaloku uBalaka wathumela abanye abathetheli, abaninzi kunabo bangaphambili.
Bafika kuye uBhileham, bathi kuye, Oku kusithiwa nguBalaka unyana kaSipore, Ndithi, Nceda, kungabikho nto izakuthintela ukuba ungangeni kum.
Ndiya kukunika umnikelo omkhulu kakhulu, ndiya kwenza nantoni na oyithethayo. Nceda, ndizalela le ndoda kum."

Waphendula ke uBhileham, wathi kubakhonzi bakaBhalaki, Ukuba uBalaka andinika indlu yakhe igcwele isilivere negolide, andikwazi ukwenza nantoni na engalunganga umthetho kaYehova uThixo wam, inkulu nancane.
Ke ngoko, hlalani apha namhlanje, njengokuba bahlala khona abo; ndibone ukuba iNkosi uya kundithetha ntoni na.
Wafika uThixo kuBhileham ngaloo busuku, wathi kuye, Ukuba abantu aba baye ukubiza wena, yiya nabo; kodwa wenze oko ndiza kukuxelela.
Wavuka ke uBhileham ngasekuseni, wamisa isikhephe sakhe esinqeni, waya nabakhulu bakaMowabi.
Ke kaloku uThixo waxoka, ngokuba wayehamba; iingelosi zikaYehova zathi zisendlela, ukuze ziyivale indlela yakhe. UBhalamu wayehamba ngeeseyile zakhe, nabakhonzi bakhe ababini naye.
Ke kaloku i-eselini yabona umbingeleli kaYehova, ehlala kwindawo yokuhamba, enekrele emlonyeni wakhe; wajika waya kwelaselwandle. UBhileham wambetha ukuze ambuyisele kwindawo yokuhamba.
Wahlala ke umbingeleli kaYehova kwindawo ethe nkqo phakathi kweentyatyambo zewayini ezimbini, ezinamadonga ngaphaya naphaya.
Ke kaloku inkunzi yebhokhwe ibona isithunywa sikaYehova, yaxinana nedonga, yatshisa inyawo likaBhileham phezu kwalo; waqhubeka ke eyambetha.
Wahamba ke umbingeleli kaYehova, wahlala kwindawo enqamlezeneyo, apho kwakungekho ndawo yokujika ngasekunene nakwesobunxele.
Yabona ke inkunzi yebhokhwe isithunywa sikaYehova, yalala phantsi kukaBhileham; waba nobuxoki uBhileham, wayibetha ngentambo yakhe.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wayivula inkunzi yebhokhwe indlebe, yathi kuBhileham, Ndinikwenzele ntoni na, ukuba ndimdubule ngokuthathu?
Wathi ke uBhileham kuyiselisi, Ungenza ntoni na kum? Makhe kubekho ikrele esandla sam, ndakubulala ngoku.
Yathi inkunzi yebhokhwe kuBhileham, Andinguye na inkunzi yebhokhwe yakho, owayihamba ngayo yonke imihla kude kube ngaloo mini? Ndikhe ndakwenza ngaphambili oku kuni? Wathi, Akunjalo.
Wavula ke iNkosi amehlo kaBhileham, wabona isithunywa soThixo esihlala endlela, sinesklabho esandleni sakhe. UBhileham waba phantsi ngobuso bakhe emhlabeni.
Wathi kuye umbingeleli kaYehova, Yintoni na loo nto ubetha ngayo isilwanyana sakho izihlandlo ezithathu ezi? Ndaza ndayimisa indlela yakho; ngokuba indlela ohamba kuyo ingalunganga ngamehlo am.
I-esile yambona, yabuya isuka kum le minyaka mithathu; ukuba ingabi yabuya isuka kum, ke ngoku ndiya kukubulala wena, kodwa ndiya kumshiya aphile yena.

Wathi uBhileham kuye isithunywa sikaYehova, Ndikhe ndenze isono; andizange ndiyazi ukuba uya kuhlala kwindawo yokuhamba ukuze undithintele. Ke ngoko, ukuba akuthandeki kuwe, ndiya kubuyela ekhaya lam.
Wathi umbingeleli kaYehova kuBhileham, Yiya namadoda; kodwa oko ndiza kukuxelelayo, lowo uya kuwuthetha. Waye ke uBhileham nabathetheli bakaBalaka.
Wava ke uBalaka ukuba uBhileham ufika, waphuma waya kumnqamleza eMowabhi, emzini okwindlela yaseArnoni, entliziyweni yelizwe lakhe.
Wathi uBalaka kuBhileham, Andikuthumelini na umyalezo wam, ndikucele ukuba ufike? Kutheni le nto ungafikanga kum? Ingaba andikwazi ukukunika intlawulo elungileyo?
Waphendula uBhileham, wathi kuBalaka, Yabona, ndifike kuwe ngoku; kodwa ngaba ndingathetha nantoni na? Oko uThixo abeka emlonyeni wam, oko ndiyenzileyo.
Wahamba ke uBhileham noBalaka waya eKiriyati-husothi.
Ke kaloku uBalaka wanikela iinkomo nezimvu, wamnika inyama uBhileham, namadoda amakhulu ahamba naye.
Wathi ke uBalaka kusasa, wamthabatha uBhalamu waya eBamoth-bhaali, eziphakamileyo zikaBhali; wabona khona uBhalamu inxalenye yabantu bakaSirayeli.
Wathi ke uBhileham kuBhalaki, Yakha kum apha izibingelelo ezisixhenxe, ndilungiselele iinkunzi zeenkomo ezisixhenxe, nezimvu ezisixhenxe.
Wakwenza ke uBalaka njengokuba wathi uBhileham; banikela inkunzi yenkomo nenyama yomnquma kwisibingelelo ngasinye.

Wathi ke uBhileham kuBhalaki, Thina apha phantsi kwesonka sakho esiqhutywa ngamanzi, ndize ndihambe; mhlawumbi iNkosi uya kumnqamla; nantoni na ayandibonisayo, ndiya kukuxelela. Wasuka ke ecaleni komthi omnyama.
Wadibana uThixo noBhileham; wathi kuye uBhileham, Izibingelelo ezisixhenxe ndizilungiselele, ndanikela inkunzi yenkomo nenyama yomgubo kwisibingelelo ngasinye.
Wabeka iNkosi ulwimi emlonyeni kaBhileham, wathi, Yiya kuBalaka, uthethe naye ngoku.
Wabuya ke uBhileham, wafumana uBhalaki ehlala phantsi kwesonka sakhe esiqhutywa ngamanzi, naye namadoda amakhulu onke aseMowabhi.

Wathetha ke uBhileham isithunywa sakhe, wathi, UBalaka wandithabatha ukusuka eAram; ukumkani wakwaMowabi wandithabatha evela kumatye asempuma. Wathi, Yaza, sithi, zulalisa kum uYakobi; yaza, thetha ngaseSirayeli.
Ndithi njani ke ukuba ndilamle lowo uThixo angalamleli? Ndithi njani ukuba ndithethe ngaloo nto iNkosi angathethi ngayo?
Ndibabona ukusuka phezulu kwezityalo, ndibajonga ukususela kumahlathi; babantu abahlalayo ngaphaya kwelizwe labo; bangazi ukuba baya kuba ngamazwe.

Nguwuphi oza kubabala abantu bakaYakobi? Baninzi njengamasuntswana omhlwa; nguwuphi oza kubabala inxalenye yesixhenxe samaSirayeli? Ndifa ndifana nalabo abasenza into elungileyo, Isiphelo sam sifana nabo.
Wathi uBalaka kuBhileham, Uthini na loo nto undiyenzayo? Ndinikhokele apha ukuba ndibhaptize ooonodoli bam; ke wena awuzange wenze ntoni na ngaphandle kokubabhaptiza.
Waphendula uBhileham, wathi, Andifanelekanga na ukuba ndijonge, ndithethe oko iNkosi amisa emlonyeni wam?
Wathi ke uBalaka kuye, Nceda, ndiza nawe kwindawo enye, apho ungababona khona; kodwa uya kubabona kuphela inxalenye yabo, awubaboni bonke; uthabathe khona apho, unqule kubo.
Ke kaloku uBalaka wamthabatha waya esidlangalaleni sikaZofim, phezulu emnqamlezweni wePisga; wakha khona izibingelelo ezisixhenxe, wanikela inkunzi yenkomo nomvuzo kwisibingelelo ngasinye.
Wathi uBhileham kuBalaka, Thina apha phantsi kwesonka sakho esiqhutywa ngamanzi; ke mna ndiya kudibana noYehova apho.
Wadibana iNkosi noBhileham, wabeka ulwimi emlonyeni wakhe, wathi, Yiya kuBalaka, uthethe kuye njalo.
Wabuyela ke uBhileham, wafumana uBhalaki ehlala phantsi kwesonka sakhe esiqhutywa ngamanzi, namadoda amakhulu aseMowabhi. Wathi kuye uBaleki, Utsho ntoni na iNkosi?
Wathetha ke uBhileham isithunywa sakhe, wathi, Nyuka, Balaki, udibanise; phulaphula kum, unina kaSipore.
UThixo akanguye umntu, ukuba abe ngumntu okhohlakeleyo; akanguye mntu, ukuba atshintshe ingqondo yakhe. Ingaba uthembisa, akawufezeki? Ingaba uthetha, akawuphumeleli?
Yabona, ndathiwa ukuba ndibhaptize; uThixo wabhaptiza, andikwazi ukuwutshintsha.
Akafumani nantoni na engalunganga kuYakobi, akabona nantoni na engalunganga eSirayeli; iNkosi uThixo wabo uya kuba nabo; baya kwenza umculo wokuba ngukumkani wabo.
UThixo wawakhupha eYiputa; Waba ngamandla enkunzi yebhokhwe yakhe, yena.
Akukho mmangaliso oza kusebenza kuYakobi, nakuphi na ukutyhila okuchaphazela uSirayeli; ngoku baya kuthetha ngoYakobi noSirayeli, bathi, Yabona into ayenze uThixo.
Yabona, abantu bavuka befana nelili; bavuka befana nelili; bangaphumli, de baphile iintaka zabo, basele igazi lalabo ababulalayo.
Wathi ke uBalaka kuBhileham, Ukuba awuyi kubabulali, awuyi kubabhaptizi na.
Waphendula ke uBhileham, wathi kuBalaka, Andikuxelelenga na ukuba, Yonke into ethethayo iNkosi kufuneka ndiyenze?
Wathi ke uBalaka kuBhileham, Yiya, ndikuthathe kude kubekho enye indawo; mhlawumbi Thixo uya kuyithanda loo nto, ukuba ungamlamla khona.
Ke kaloku uBalaka wamthabatha uBhileham, waya esiphelweni senduli kaPehore, ejonge eYiputa.
Wathi ke uBhileham kuBhalaki, Yakha kum apha izibingelelo ezisixhenxe, ndilungiselele iinkunzi zeenkomo ezisixhenxe, nezimvu ezisixhenxe.
Wakwenza ke uBalaka njengokuba wathi uBhileham, wanikela inkunzi yenkomo nomvuzo kumqolo ngamnye.
Wabona ke uBhileham ukuba kulungile kuYehova ukubhaptiza amaSirayeli; akazange ahambe ekhangela iimfihlakalo, njengokuba wayekhe wenza ngaphambili; wabuyela, wajonge emlanjeni.
Waphakamisa uBhileham amehlo akhe, wabona amaSirayeli ethe tyaba ngokwesizukulwana saso; wafika kuye umoya kaThixo.
Wathetha ke uBhileham umyalezo wakhe, wathi, Lo ngumyalezo kaBhileham, unyana kaBeore, Umyalezo womntu obona ngamehlo akhe,
Uthi lowo ephulaphule amazwi kaThixo, obona umbono woMntu Onamandla onke, owela phantsi ngamehlo akhe avulekileyo:
Zihle kangakanani na iikhabhathi zenu, oonyana bakaYakobi, nezindlu zenu, oonyana bakaSirayeli!
Basasazeka njengamahlathi, njengamagqabi ecaleni komlambo, njengeentyatyambo ze-aloe ezityelwe nguYehova, njengeentyatyambo zeediliya eduze kwamanzi.
Amanzi aya kuphuma emabhotileni abo, imbewu yabo iya kuba nendawo eninzi yamanzi; ukumkani wabo uya kuba mkhulu kuna-Agagi, ubukumkani babo buza kuphakama.
UThixo wabakhupha eYiputa, Wabanika amandla afana nenyama yenkomo; Baya kuzidla iintlanga, abachasi babo; Baza kuzitshisa izihlunu zabo, baya kuzibulala ngamaqhosha abo.
Bahlala bephumla njengelion, njengelilion ebhityileyo; ngubani na oza kubakhulisa? Wonke lowo ubhaptizelayo, abe ngumsindisi; onke lowo ubalazayo, abe ngumsindisi.
Ke kaloku uBhalaki waxoka kakhulu kuBhileham, wabetha izandla zakhe ngoxolo, wathi kuye, Ndakubiza ukuba ubaleke abathunywa bam; ke wena uyayibhaptiza le mihla mithathu.
Ke ngoko, phuma apha, uye endlwini yakho; ndathi ndiya kukunika umvuzo omkhulu; ke iNkosi wakuthintela kumvuzo wakho.
Waphendula uBhileham, wathi kuBalaka, Andithethinga na kubathunywa abawuthumelayo ndithi,

Ukuba uBalaka andinika indlu yakhe igcwele isilivere negolide, andikwazi ukuphula umthetho kaYehova, ukuba ndiyenze into elungileyo nantoni na engalunganga ngokwam; oko iNkosi athethayo ndiya kukuthetha.
Ke mna ngoku ndiya kubuyela kubomi bam; ndiza kukuxelela into abayenzayo abo bantu kubomi bakho, kwiintsuku ezizayo.
Wathetha ke uBhileham umyalezo wakhe, wathi, Lo ngumyalezo kaBhileham, unyana kaBeore, Umyalezo womntu obona ngamehlo akhe,
ilizwi lomntu ophulaphule amazwi kaThixo, onolwazi oluvela kuThixo Ophezulu, obona umbono ovela kuThixo Onamandla onke, onyukayo ngamehlo akhe avulekileyo:

Ndimbona, kodwa akunjalo ngoku; ndimjonge, kodwa akakho phezulu. Inkwenkwezi iya kuphuma eYakobi, isandla sokumkani siza kunyuka eSirayeli; uya kuzitshisa iintloko zikaMowabhi, nezihlunu zabantu bonke baseSheti.
UEdom uya kuqhutywa, uSeyire, umkhonzi wakhe, uya kuqhutywa; ke uSirayeli uya kukhula.
Uza kuphuma umlawuli eYakobi, uyasibulala isiphelo somzi-ndlu.
Wabona ke uBhileham ama-Amaleki, wathetha lo myalezo, esithi, Amaleki waba ngukuqala phakathi kwezizwe; kodwa ekugqibeleni uya kulahleka kude kube kude.
Wabona amaKeni, wathetha lo myalezo, wathi, Indlu yakho ikhuselekile, njengentlabathi ebekwe phezulu ezityeni.
Ke nina, aKenithi, niza kuqhutywa ngamanzi, xa uAsiriya ekufumaneni ukuba ningabikho.
Wathetha ke lo myalezo, esithi, Oo, ngubani na oza kuphila xa uThixo esenza oku?
Iinqanawa ziya kuvela emazantsi eSirayeli; ziza kutshisa uAsiriya noHebhere, baza bapheliswa nabo ngonaphakade.
Wavuka ke uBhileham, wabuyela endlwini yakhe; uBalaka ke wahamba indlela yakhe.
Ke kaloku, xa amaSirayeli ehlala eShitiyine, amadoda aqala ukudibana namabhinqa aseMowabhi.
Ke kaloku ababhinqa abo bayababiza ukuba balungiselele izibingelelo kuThixo wabo; abantu ke badla izibingelelo, baba ngumbulelo kuThixo wabo.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli adibana noBhaali wePeori; iNkosi waxoka kakhulu kumaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wathi kuMoses, Ncamathisela bonke abathetheli bezizwe, ubalwe, ubatshise phambi koYehova emveni kwemini; ukuze inkanuko yobuxoki beNkosi itshintshwe kumaSirayeli.
Wathi ke uMoses kubagwebi bakaSirayeli, Ubulalane mntu ngamnye namadoda akhe athabathela kuBhaali kaPeori.
Ke kaloku, xa uMoses nebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli belili emngxunyeni wetentyatyambo yokuhlangana, kwafika umntu omnye waseSirayeli wazisa indoda yaseMidiyani kwitente yendlu yakhe, phambi kwabo.
Wakubona ke loo nto uPhenesha, unyana ka-Eleazar, unyana ka-Aron ukumkani; wavuka ephakathi komkhosi, wathabatha isikebhe esikwisandla sakhe.
Walandela lo mntu waseSirayeli, waya kwitenki, wabeka isithunywa sakhe phakathi kwabo bobabini, phakathi komntu nowesifazane; saphela ke eso sifo esibulalayo ebantwini bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku abantu abamashumi mabini anane amawaka babesele befa ngenxa yesifo.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

UPhinehasi, unyana ka-Elazare, unyana ka-Aron ukumkani, wanqumla intliziyo yam ebantwini bakaSirayeli; waba nobulumko phakathi kwabo, ukuba agcine ubukumkani bam phakathi kwabo, ukuze ndibasuse abantwana bakaSirayeli entliziyweni yam.
Uthi ke kuye, Ndiza kwenza naye umnqophiso wam woxolo.
Kuye kube ngumnqophiso kuye, nosapho lwakhe emva kwakhe, ukuba babe ngababingeleli ngonaphakade; ngenxa yokuba wayemthanda uThixo wakhe, wabalungisa ooSirayeli phambi kukaThixo.
Umfazi waseSirayeli, owafa nowesifazane waseMidiyani, waba nguZimri unyana kaSalu, umphathi wendlu yamafama eSimeoni.
Igama lomfazi waseMidiyani obulawayo nguKozbi, intombi kaTsuri, owayengumphathi wendlu yamafama eMidiyani.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Bathi ke uNdikhoyo kuYakobi: Yiba namaMidiyani njengeenkunzi zakho, bahlasele.

Ngokuba bakwenza ukuba nibe ngabachasi benu, xa bekuzama ukunikhohlisa, ukuze nikhonza uBhaali kaPeori, noKozbi, intombi yomphathi waseMidiyani, umhlobo wabo, owafa ngaloo mini yentsholongwane ngenxa kaPeori.
Wathetha ke iNkosi kuMoses, noElazare, unyana ka-Aron umbingeleli, emva kobhubho obulalayo, esithi,
Babala ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, ngokweemfazwe zazo; babalo bonke amadoda aseSirayeli aneminyaka emashumi mabini ubudala nangaphezulu, aphumayo emfazweni.
Wathetha ke uMoses noElazare, umbingeleli, kubo abantu ezindaweni eziphakamileyo zaseMowabhi, ngaseYordan, ecaleni kweYericho, esithi,
Bala bonke amadoda aneminyaka emashumi mabini ubudala nangaphezulu, njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses. Baye ke aba oonyana bakaSirayeli abaphuma eYiputa:
URubhen waba ngunyana wokuqala kaSirayeli. Iintsapho eziphuma kuRubhen: nguEnoki, intsapho yamaHanokhi; nguPalu, intsapho yamaPaluli;
kuHeshroni, iqela labaseHeshroni; kuKarmi, iqela labaseKarmi.
Ezi ziintsapho zakwaRubhen; ababalolwayo kubo babe ngamawaka amane anamakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci mathathu.
Unyana kaPalu nguEliyaba;

Oonyana bakaElibha: nguNemuyeli, noDathani, noAbironi. Lowo Dathani noAbironi waba ngabaphathi abakhethiweyo bebandla, abo bahlasela uMoses noAron; babephakathi kweqela likaKorha, xa behlasela iNkosi.
Wavula umhlaba, wabathwala nabo noKore; bafa bonke abahlobo bakhe, xa umnxeba watshisa amadoda angamakhulu mabini anamashumi amahlanu. Baye babe ngumqondiso.
Ke kaloku oonyana bakaKora abafi.
Iintsapho zakwaSimeon: nguNemuyeli, intsapho yabaseNemuyeli; nguYamini, intsapho yabaseYamini; nguYahini, intsapho yabaseYahini;
nguZera, isini samaZerahiti; nguShawuli, isini lamaShauliti.
Ezi ziintsapho zikaSimeon; ababalolwayo kubo babe ngamawaka amabini anamashumi mabini anesibini, anamakhulu mabini.
Iinkundla zakwaGadi: nguSephon, inkundla yamaSefoni; nguHagi, inkundla yamaHagi; nguShuni, inkundla yamaShuni;
ngoOzini, iqela leOzini; ngoEri, iqela leEriti;
ku-Arode, usapho lwaba-Arode; ku-Areli, usapho lwaba-Areliti.
Ezi ziintsapho zikaGadi; ababalolwayo kubo babe ngamawaka amane anamakhulu amahlanu.
Bafa oonyana ababini bakaYuda ezweni laseKanan, uEri noOnan.
Iintsapho zakwaYuda: kuShela, intsapho yabaseShelani; kuPerezi, intsapho yabasePerezi; kuZerha, intsapho yabaseZherahini.
Amaqela aphumayo kuPerezi: eHeshroni, amaqela eeHeshroni; eHamuli, amaqela eeHamuli.
Ezi ziintsapho zikaYuda; ababalolwayo kubo babe ngamawaka amashumi asixhenxe anesithandathu, anamakhulu amahlanu.
Iintsapho ezisuka kuIssakare: eTola, intsapho yamaTholayi; ePuwa, intsapho yamaPhunayi;
ngoYashubhi, usapho lwabaYashubhi; ngoShimroni, usapho lwabaShimroni.
Ezi ziintsapho zika-Issakare; abo babalwa kubo babe ngamawaka angamashumi amathandathu anane anamakhulu mathathu.
Amaqela asuka kuZebulon: eSeredi, amaqela eeSeredi; eElon, amaqela eeEloni; eYahleyeli, amaqela eeYahleyeli.
Ezi ziintsapho zikaZebulon; abo babalwa kubo babe ngamawaka angamashumi amathandathu anamakhulu amahlanu.
Iintsapho ezisuka kuYosefu, zisuka kubo oonyana bakhe uManase noEfrayim.
Amaqela aphuma kuManase: eMahiri, amaqela eMahiri; uMahiri waba nguyise kaGiliyadi; eGiliyadi, amaqela eeGiliyadi.
Ezi ziintsapho zakwaGiliyadi: kuYezere, intsapho yamaJezeri; kuHeleki, intsapho yamaHeleki;
ku-Asriyeli, usapho lwaba-Asriyeli; ku-Shekem, usapho lwaba-Shekemi;
nguShemida usapho lwabaShemidayi; nguHeferi usapho lwabaHeferi.
UTselofehadi, unyana kaHefer, akazange abe nabantwana amadodana, kodwa wayeneentombi; lawona magama abo: nguMahala, noNowa, noHogla, noMileka, noTirsa.
Ezi ziintsapho zikaManase; ababalolwayo kubo babe ngamawaka amashumi amahlanu anesibini anamakhulu asixhenxe.
Amaqela aphumayo kuEfrayim: eShutela, amaqela eeShutelayi; eBekere, amaqela eeBekeri; eTahani, amaqela eeTahani.
Ku-Eran unyana kaShutela, kusapho lwaba-Erani.
Ezi ziintsapho zikaEfrayim; ababalolwayo kubo babe ngamawaka amashumi mathathu anesibini anamakhulu amahlanu. Ezi zonke zizintsapho zakwaYosefu.
Amaqela aphumayo kuBhenjamin: eBela, amaqela eeBelayithi; eAshbeli, amaqela eeAshbelithi; eAhiram, amaqela eeAhirami;
kuShephupham, usapho lwabaShufami; kuHufam, usapho lwabaHufami.
Amaqela aphuma kuArde noNaman, oonyana bakaBhela: nguArde usapho lwabaArdi; nguNaman usapho lwabaNaamini.
Ezi ziintsapho zikaBhenjamin; abo babalwa kubo babe ngamawaka amane anamakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci mahlanu.
Iqela eliphuma kuDan: lisuka eShuham, iqela lamaSuhami; ezi ziifama zikaDan.
Bonke oonyana bakaShuhami babe ngamawaka angamashumi amathandathu anane, anamakhulu amane.
Amaqela asuka ku-Asere: eYimna, amaqela eeImniti; eIshivi, amaqela eeIshiviti; eBeriya, amaqela eeBherithi.
Iintsapho zikaBheri: nguHebhere, intsapho yamaHeberi; nguMalkiyeli, intsapho yamaMalkiyeli.
Ke kaloku uAshere wayenenkosikazi, igama layo nguSera.
Ezi ziintsapho zika-Asere; abo babalwa kubo babe ngamawaka alisihlanu anamakhulu mathathu, anamanci amane.
Amaqela asuka kuNafetali: eYasheyeli, amaqela eeYasheyeliti; eGuni, amaqela eeGuniti;
Kuye uYezere, kusapho lwabaJezeri; kuShileme, kusapho lwabaShilemi.
Ezi ziintsapho zikaNafetali; ababalolwayo kubo babe ngamawaka amashumi mane anesihlanu, anamakhulu amane.
Amanani onke amadoda aseSirayeli, ababalolwe kuwo, ayemakhulu amathandathu, amawaka amathathu anamakhulu asixhenxe.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yahlulani ilizwe phakathi kwezi ntsapho, ibe yindawo yabo, ngokwenani legama labo elibalolwayo.
Nceda ninike isizukulwana esikhulu isizukulwana esininzi, nesizukulwana esincinci isizukulwana esincinane. Isizukulwana ngasinye siza kuthatha isizukulwana sayo ngokwenani labo ababalolwayo.
Ke kaloku ilizwe kufuneka lihlukaniswe ngokutyhala iziqendu; isizukulwana ngasinye seentsapho zabazali bayo siza kufumana inzala yayo, ngokweegama lezizukulwana zabo.
Inxalenye nganye iya kuhlukaniswa ngoqhawulo-mtshato phakathi kweentsapho ezikhulu nezincinci.
Ezi ziintsapho zabaLevi ababalolwayo: kuGershoni, intsapho yamaGershoni; kuKahati, intsapho yamaKahati; kuMerariya, intsapho yamaMerari.
Ke kaloku ezi ziintsapho zeLevi: intsapho yamaLibhi, nentsapho yamaHebhoni, nentsapho yamaMaheli, nentsapho yamaMushi, nentsapho yamaKorhi. UKehati waba nguyise kaAmram.
UYokebedi, umfazi ka-Amram, waba ngunyana kaLevi, wazalwa kwindlu kaLevi eYiputa; wamzala uAmram oonyana ababini, uAron noMoses, nendodana, uMiriyam, udade wabo.
UAron wazala uNadabhi, noAbihu, noElezare, noItamari.
Ke kaloku uNadabhi noAbhihu bafa, xa benikela kuYehova umnxeba ongafanelekanga.

Amanani amaLevi amadoda, eminyaka ilishumi elinambini ezelwe nangaphezulu, aye ngamawaka angamashumi mabini anathathu; abazange babalolwe phakathi kwabanye oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngokuba kungekho mhlaba wabanikezelwa phakathi kwabo.
Lowo mntu wababala uMoses noElazare umbingeleli, xa bebala oonyana bakaSirayeli ezindaweni eziphakamileyo zaseMowabhi, ngaseYordan ecaleni kweYericho.
Akukho namnye kubo wababalayo uMoses noAron, umbingeleli, esiqwini saseSinayi.
Kuba iNkosi wayethe kubo bonke abantu abo, Baza kufa bonke kuloo ndawo iphela. Akukho namnye wabo oseleyo, ngaphandle kukaKalebe unyana kaYefune, noYoshuwa unyana kaNun.

Zafika ke iintombi zikaZelofehadi; uZelofehadi ube ngunyana kaHefere, unyana kaGiliyadi, unyana kaMakhire, unyana kaManase, kusapho lukaManase, unyana kaYosefu. Amagama eendodana zakhe: nguMahla, noNowa, noHogla, noMilka, noTirsa.
Baye babekwa phambi koMoses, noElazare umbingeleli, namadoda amakhulu, nebandla lonke, emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana, besithi,
Ubaba wethu wafa ezweni elibi; yena akazange abe liqela likaKori, labo babhiyozela iNkosi; wafa ngenxa yesono sakhe, akazange abe nabantwana.
Kutheni na ukuba igama loyise lwethu liphele phakathi kweqela lakhe, ngokuba akazange abe nonyana? Sinike ilizwe phakathi kwabahlobo boyise wethu.
Wazisa uMoses inkundla yabo phambi koYehova.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, esithi,
Zonke iintombi zikaZelofehadi zilungile; kufuneka ubanike ilizwe phakathi kwabazalwana bakayise, njengentsapho yabo. Babanike intlawulo kayise.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Xa umntu efa angabakho unyana wakhe, niyinike ilizwe lakhe intombi yakhe.
Ukuba ayisekho intombi yakhe, niyinike ilizwe lakhe kubazalwana bakhe.
Ke ukuba angabakho bazalwana, niyinike ilizwe lakhe bazalwana bakayise.

Ke kaloku, ukuba utata wakhe akazange abe nabazalwana, niyinike imbewu yakhe kumhlobo wakhe osondeleyo kusapho lwakhe, aze ayibe yipropathi yakhe; ibe ngummiselo nomthetho kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya phezulu kuloo mnqamlezo weAbarimi, ubone ilizwe endilibambise lona oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, emva kokuba uyibone, uya kufa nawe, uhlangane nabantu bakho abafileyo, njengokuba wakufa uAron umzalwana wakho.
Kuba niyiphulaphule loo myalelo wam, ukuba ndibe ngumbingeleli phakathi kwabo ngamanzi, xa ibandla lindixolela emasikweni kaZin. Yaye loo manzi yiMiriba eKadeshe, emasikweni kaZin.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova,
UYehova, wena uThixo onika umphefumlo kubo bonke abaphilayo; nceda ubeke umntu phezu kwalo mkhosi.
Wabasusa emfazweni, wababuyisela endlwini yabo; ukuze abantu bakaYehova bangabi ngathi iinkunzi zeegusha ezingena mlawuli.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yamkela uYoshuwa, unyana kaNun, umntu onemoya ngaphakathi kwakhe, uyibeke isandla sakho phezu kwakhe.
Yabeka phambi kuka-Elazare umbingeleli, nangabo bonke ababingeleli, uyimisele ukuba abe ngukumkani phambi kwabo.
Nceda unciphise kuye igunya lakho, ukuze lonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli liwuthobe.
Uya kuhlala phambi kuka-Elazare, umbingeleli, ukuba abuze ilizwi likaYehova ngeUrim; ngomthetho wakhe ke uya kuphuma nokungena uYoshuwa, nabo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, ibandla lonke.
Wakwenza ke uMoses njengoko wamwiselayo iNkosi; wathabatha uYoshuwa, wambeka phambi koElazare ukumkani, nangalo lonke ibandla.
Wabeka izandla zakhe phezu kwakhe, wammisa ukuba abe ngukumkani, njengoko iNkosi wathetha ngaye ngoMoses.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yimise umthetho oonyana bakaSirayeli, usithi, Yabonani ukuba nindinikezele izipho zam ngexesha labo elimiselweyo, isonka sam sezinto eziqhutywa ngamandla, njengevumba elimnandi kum.

Uthi kubo, Lo ngumnikelo womlilo oza kuwunikela kuYehova: iinkunzi zeenkomo ezimbini ezineminyaka elishumi elinambini ubudala, ezingabikho monakalo kuzo, mihla ngemihla, ibe yidini eliqhutywa ngamandla.
Umele ulungiselele inkunzi yenkomo enye kusasa, nenye xa ilanga liphuma.
Ngenye nganye yazo, zinikele umnikelo wesonka omalunga nekhilogram enye nesiqingatha somgubo omsulwa, ugxininiswe nelitha enye yeoyile yeolives eqhutywe.
Eli lidini eliqhutywa ngamandla, elingenakuphelelwa, eliya kwenziwa emnqamlezweni kaSinayi, idini eliqhutywa ngamandla, livumba elimnandi kuYehova.
Nomnikelo wokudla wenyama yenkomo nganye, ubeke ilitha enye yewayini elingenanto; uyithele kuYehova kwindawo engcwele.

Inyama yenkomo yesibini uyilungiselele xa ilanga liphuma, nesonka sayo esifana nomnikelo wokudla, nesonka sayo sokunqunyulwa, njengokuba kusekuseni; ngumnikelo owenziwe ngomlilo, uvumba elimnandi kuYehova.

Ngemini yeSabatha nilungiselele iintombi ezimbini ezineminyaka elishumi elinambini ubudala, zingabikho monakalo kuzo; nomnikelo wayo wokudla, ilitha zesinyithi esiqinileyo esixutywe neoli, nomnikelo wayo wokusela.
Eli lidini eliqhutywa ngomlilo ngeSabatha nganye, ngaphezu kwedini eliqhutywa ngomlilo eliqhubekayo nomnikelo walo wokusela.
